list:
* Behind the generals' hut
* Next to the western hut
* Up a ladder at the entrance of the camp

* Pull levers A and B up.
* Enter door 1 to reach the north-east room and pull lever D up.
* Enter door 1 to return to the main room and pull levers A and B down.
* Enter doors 3, 4, and 5 to reach the north-west room and pull levers E and F up.
* Enter doors 6 and 7 to reach the north-east room and pull lever C up.
* Enter doors 7 and 6 to reach the north-west room and pull lever E down.
* Enter doors 6, 8, and 3 to reach the main room.
* Enter door 9 and grab the oil can.

* Take the chicken to the other side, since the fox and grain are the only pair that actually get along.
* Drop the chicken, then come back and grab the fox.
* Take it to the other side then grab the chicken and drop the fox. Then take the chicken back to the start.
* Grab the grain, drop the chicken, and take the grain across the bridge.
* Drop the grain, then go back to the beginning for the chicken and take it across.

* Cupric ore powder
* Cupric sulphate
* Gypsum
* A tin
* 4 vials of liquid (upon examining them they will be revealed as vials of 'Dihydrogen Monoxide')
* Tin ore powder
* A knife, chisel, or bronze wire (only one is needed)
* A metal spade

* To get past the first door, take the metal spade and use it on the Bunsen burner on the table to remove the wood, leaving a metal spade head.
* Use the spade head on the stone door. Do not click Pull-spade yet.
* Use the cupric sulphate on the door.
* Add one of the vials of liquid. This will make the spade expand, trapping it in the hole. It can then be pulled to open the door.
* To get past the second door use the gypsum on the tin then the vial of liquid on the tin to get a clay substance
* Next, find the key chained to the western wall and use the tin of clay on it to get an imprint.
* Add the cupric ore powder and tin ore powder to the tin.
* Use the tin on the Bunsen burner to make a bronze key.
* Use the knife, chisel, or bronze wire on the tin to scrape the key out.
* Take your key and unlock the door.

* Talk to Duke Horacio upstairs in the castle.
* Talk to any man or woman (a man is located around the room next to Duke Horacio).
* Take Zanik outside the castle. (When you first leave the castle, there will be a brief dialogue where Zanik talks about seeing the sun for the first time. You must click through this dialogue in order to proceed with the quest. You may have to bring her back into the castle and out to get the message, but it happens automatically.)
* Talk to the Lumbridge Sage, outside the Lumbridge castle.
* Talk to Father Aereck in the church just opposite the castle.
* Take her to see a level 2 Goblin (there's several across the bridge, just east of the castle). Try to get Zanik to walk into the goblin. If Zanik doesn't automatically talk when in close range of a goblin, log out then back in.
* Talk to either the general store manager or the assistant; Zanik will buy off a bucket, hammer and a newcomers map.

* The one by Brimstail, if you haven't killed it already.
* One around the main gate (south-east from Brimstail's cave).
* One by the spirit tree in the center of the Tree Gnome Stronghold.
* One by the giant tortoises north-west of the Grand Tree (in the pen north of the swamp).
* One at the top of the Grand Tree, by the prison.
* One by King Narnode (you may have to range or mage this one, as it can get stuck behind a trapdoor; if it's stuck and you forgot a ranged weapon, try going down the trapdoor and coming back up).

* First, find the Sailor on the second westernmost dock and select the "talk" option on him. Speak about the exotic flower (Merchants Trial option). He has it, but wants a romantic ballad composed for him.
* Talk to Olaf the Bard. He will ask you to get him a pair of new sturdy boots. He wanders outside at the northeast side of the longhouse.
* Go to the clothing store to the west of the market and ask Yrsa about them. She will agree to make the boots only if Brundt the Chieftain produces a fiscal statement that lowers the taxes on the stores.
* If you talk to Brundt the Chieftain in the longhall, he will tell you that the clan will be able to afford it if Sigli the Huntsman will give him a tracking map showing the best places to hunt monsters.
* Go south of the longhall. Sigli the Huntsman agrees, but first, he will want a custom bowstring made.
* Go to the helmet store just north of the longhall. The shopkeeper Skulgrimen will give you one in exchange for the unusual fish that the Fisherman caught.
* On the easternmost dock to the north of Rellekka Market, you'll find the Fisherman. He will ask you to get a sea fishing map showing the best spots to catch edible fish.
* Find Swensen the Navigator. He is in a house south of the market, and east of Peer the Seer's house. He will make the map but he will want a weather forecast first.
* Peer the Seer, found in the south-west corner of marketplace, will give you a forecast if you can find him a bodyguard and make him sign a warriors' contract.
* Thorvald the Warrior can be found in the helmet store. He wants you to get him a seat in the long hall, which will require a champions token, in exchange for becoming the Seer's bodyguard.
* Manni the Reveller is in the long hall. He will gladly give up his seat if Thora the Barkeep will make him one of her legendary cocktails.
* Thora will only agree to make one if you can get a signed promissory note from Askeladden for him to stay out of the bar.
* Talk to Askeladden (who is outside the long hall) to get the promissory note for 5000 coins.

* Promissory note to Thora
* Legendary cocktail to Manni
* Champions token to Thorvald
* Warriors' contract to the Seer
* Weather forecast to Swensen
* Sea fishing map to the Fisherman
* Unusual fish to Skulgrimen
* Custom bowstring to Sigli
* Tracking map to Brundt
* Fiscal statement to Yrsa
* Sturdy boots to Olaf
* Fremennik ballad to the Sailor
* And finally, give the exotic flower to Sigmund

* 'S'outh portal
* 'W'est portal
* 'E'ast portal
* 'N'orth portal
* 'S'outh portal
* 'E'ast portal
* 'N'orth portal

* Down (staircase)
* 2 N (2 spaces north)
* 2 E (2 spaces east)
* 2 N (2 spaces north)
* 2 E (2 spaces east)
* 10 N (10 spaces north)
* 4 W (4 spaces west)
* Pipe 3

* A fire rune
* A water rune
* An earth rune
* An air rune
* A sword of your choosing (remember that you will not get this back)
* An arrow of your choosing (except ogre and training) (remember that you will not get this back)

* The drunken dwarf gives the first seed to set you off.
* Outside the Laughing Miner pub in the east side of Keldagrim and just by the mine carts, you should see a Rowdy dwarf. He asks you for a random item in exchange for his seed. If you talk to the Rowdy dwarf later, you can select the option that you don't know where to get the item and he'll ask you to get another item (this may or may not work).
* For the next seed, go to the west side of Keldagrim and talk to Gauss. He is in the King's Axe Inn, south of the bank in west Keldagrim. He will ask you to do a toast with him. Buy a beer and talk to him again to get the seed. If you buy a dwarven stout, you won't drink it during the animation and you can use the glass in the next step.
* To get the next seed, take the Catherby lodestone and run north to the cave entrance. You can also get there by either using the mine carts or taking the Taverley lodestone and running north to the cave entrance, by the farming patch at the foot of the mountain. At the pub inside the cave, talk to Khorvak, the dwarven engineer. Take a dwarven stout off the table and give it to Khorvak to get the seed – or just talk him out of it. You "borrow" the seed as you manage to convince him that you will "return it".

* Valve 1 - The first valve is west of the Clock Tower. Turn it right.
* Valve 2 - The second is directly behind the Carnillean Family's house. Turn it right.
* Valve 3 - The third valve is directly north of the cave. Turn it left. (This is the only one set to left for the flow to work.)
* Valve 4 - The fourth is south of the zoo's penguin cage. Turn it right.
* Valve 5 - Finally, the fifth valve can be found south-east of the fourth, near Brother Cedric and his broken cart. Turn it right.

* A bucket of sap can be obtained by using a bucket on an evergreen or acadia tree. The Embalmer suggests the acadia in Menaphos, but if you don't have access, take the magic carpet to Uzer - there are 2 acadia trees immediately to the north. If you do not have access to the Uzer magic carpet, exit Sophanem after speaking to the guard and demanding entry through the gate and run north north-west to the acadia tree north of Uzer.
* Talk to Raetul to buy a sheet of linen for . He is found wandering around a silk stall next to the Sphinx.
* To get salt, you can buy bag of salt or salt shaker (tool belt works) from Slayer Masters. Alternatively, you can go to the river bay north of Sophanem and use an empty bucket on the salty water by the shore to get a bucket of salty water. Then use the bucket on the centre piece of the suntrap located inside of Sophanem, just south-east of Klenter's Pyramid. The water will evaporate, leaving salt behind. Search the font and take the pile of salt.

* Add a mirror to the pillar radiating light, and reflect the light north.
* Go north to the next pillar, add a mirror, and reflect the light west.
* Go west to the next pillar, add a mirror, and reflect the light south.
* Go south to the next pillar, use the yellow crystal on it to tint the light yellow while it continues south.
* Go south to the next pillar, add a mirror, and reflect the light east.
* Go east and climb across the stone handholds. Note that the failure rate here is very high if your hands aren't empty. In case of failure, you takes 50 damage and falls into a hallway full of shadows on the ground floor. Run back up the stairs by the entrance and try again. This may take multiple attempts. Using Agility boosts will help.
* Pass through the blue door and open the chest to receive 2 more mirrors and a cyan crystal.

* Put a mirror in the pillar radiating light and reflect the light north.
* Go north to the next pillar, add a mirror, and reflect the light west.
* Go west to the next pillar and add the yellow crystal to tint the light yellow.
* Go west to the next pillar, add a mirror, and reflect the light north.
* Go north to the next pillar, add a mirror, and reflect the light east.
* Go east to the next pillar and add the cyan crystal to change the yellow light into green.
* Go east and pass through the magenta door. Open the chest to get 2 more mirrors.

* Put a mirror in the pillar radiating light and reflect the light north.
* Go north to the next pillar, add a mirror, and reflect the light downstairs. The wide part of the mirror should be on bottom during the rotation screen.
* Go downstairs to the bottom floor. There should be a little beam of light going into the pillar north of the stairs. Put a mirror in it and reflect the light west.
* Go west to the next pillar, add a mirror, and reflect the light north.
* Go around to the pillar just north, add a mirror, and reflect the light up. An upward beam of light will be visible.
* Go back upstairs to the middle floor and go north to the pillar with the beam of light going up. It is near the ladder to the next floor up. Put the yellow crystal in that pillar to make the light yellow. (Remember this location because it will need to be returned to later).
* Go up the ladder immediately north to the top floor. Add a mirror to the pillar and reflect the light west. The yellow light will go through a fixed magenta crystal, turning red.
* Go back down the ladder and go south. At the southern wall, go up the ladder. Go all the way to the northwestern corner. Be careful on the way to this pillar, as there are traps, potentially causing a small amount of damage. Put a mirror in this pillar and reflect the light south.
* Go to the southwestern corner, add a mirror, and reflect the light below. The wide part of the mirror should be on top during the rotation screen.
* Go down the ladder on the southern wall (by the handholds)
* Go to the chamber immediately north-west by climbing over the low wall, and use a rope on the rock. Climb down.
* Go south-west, passing through the open cyan door to and open the chest to get a blue crystal.

Do not reset the maze yet (by going to the crystal collector) as most of the mirror setup for the cyan door is needed for the next step of unlocking the yellow door.

* Go to the pillar with the yellow crystal from the last step (north side of the middle floor, immediately west of the magenta-coloured doors). Remove the yellow crystal, and replace it with the cyan crystal. A cyan light should now be going up. The mirror placed in the pillar above from the last step will reflect the light west, like before. However, this time, a cyan light will be going west, turning into a blue light. Head back south to the ladder.
* Return to the north-west corner of the top floor, following the same path as before.
* Rotate the mirror in this pillar to reflect the light down. The wide part of the mirror should be on right during the rotation screen.
* Go to the bottom floor (use the southern ladder down, and then the stairs near the crystal collector on the wall). In the north-west corner, pass through the yellow door then rotate the mirror south to the second yellow door. Follow the corridor south and then east, and open the chest to get 2 more mirrors and the first fractured crystal.

* Open the blue door again. Follow the above steps to open it using the yellow crystal. Cross the handholds and pass the blue door. Use the blue crystal (not cyan) on the pillar inside, then exit the blue door and return using the handholds.
* Retrieve the mirror from the pillar reflecting light towards the handholds, and then walk north to retrieve the yellow crystal. Do not collect by using the crystal collector to keep the blue crystal in place. The agility obstacle no longer needs to be crossed at this point, so weight is less of an issue, therefore using stronger but heavier equipment is feasible.
* Go north to the next pillar and rotate the mirror to reflect the light up instead of south. The wide part of the mirror should be on left during the rotation screen.
* Climb up the southern ladder to the top floor, and go north. Use the two staircases to move further north by shortly passing through the middle floor. Place a mirror in the pillar to the immediate north-east. The beam of light will not be visible until a mirror is placed inside the pillar.
* After adding the mirror, reflect the light south.
* Go to the next pillar which the light passes through by going back using the two staircases. This pillar is not the pillar located along the southernmost wall, but the second pillar north from the southern wall's ladder. Add the fractured crystal to split the beam into three.

* From the fractured crystal, go west to the next pillar. Add a mirror and reflect the light downstairs. The wide part of the mirror should be on right during the rotation screen. The pillar below has a fixed green crystal in it, turning the white light green.
* Go down to the bottom floor. Find the pillar with a little beam of green light coming out by heading south, and then west. Add a mirror and reflect the light south.
* Go south, add a mirror, and reflect the light east. This will unlock the magenta door. Behind it, however, is a yellow door preventing access to the chest.

* Go up the staircase near the entrance to get to the middle floor, then take the southern ladder to the top floor.
* Add a mirror to the pillar next to the ladder and reflect the light east.
* Go east to the south-east pillar. Add a mirror and reflect the light down. The wide part of the mirror should be on left during the rotation screen. 
* Go down the ladder to the middle floor, then take the stairs to the bottom floor.
* Head to the south-east corner. Pass through the magenta door, then add a mirror to the pillar inside. Reflect the light to the north and pass through the door.
* Open the chest to get 3 more mirrors and the second fractured crystal.
* Make sure to bring a death talisman, omni-talisman or wicked hood along to prevent needing to make another trip after this next part.

* Add a mirror to the pillar radiating light, and reflect the light north.
* Go north to the next pillar, add a mirror, and reflect the light down. The wide part of the mirror should be on bottom during the rotation screen.
* Go to the bottom floor. Go north and add a mirror to the pillar with light coming out. Reflect the light west.
* Go west to the next pillar and add the smaller fractured crystal (clear side facing east). If it doesn't work, take it out and use the other one.
* Go south to the next pillar and add the other fractured crystal (clear side facing north).

* From the second (southern) fractured crystal, walk west, add a mirror, and reflect the light up. The wide part of the mirror should be on the left during the rotation screen.
* Go up the stairs, then use the southern ladder to the top floor.
* Go north and then go west upon reaching the wall. Reaching the next pillar, add a mirror and direct the light to the west. Note that the beam may not be visible until the light is reflected in the right direction.

* From the second (southern) fractured crystal, walk east. Add a mirror to this pillar. The light will be reflected up towards the top floor (as there is no pillar on the middle floor there); this mirror cannot be rotated.
* Go to the top floor. Go to the pillar directly south of the black crystal and add a mirror. The light will be reflected west; this mirror cannot be rotated.
* Go west to the next pillar, add a mirror, and reflect the light north through a hole in the wall.
* Go north using the two staircases to and from the middle floor again. The next pillar is immediately north-east. Again, the light may not be visible until a mirror is added. Add a mirror, and reflect the light west.
* Go west to the next pillar and add the blue crystal to turn the beam blue.

* From the first (northern) fractured crystal, follow the beam of light north to the next pillar. Add a mirror and reflect the light up. Keep rotating until the beam goes up.
* Go to the middle floor using the stairs by the entrance and head north to find the pillar with the beam of light coming up. Add the yellow crystal to tint the light yellow.
* Climb up the ladder directly north of that pillar, to the top floor. Add a mirror to the pillar and reflect the light west. Again, the beam of light may not be visible until the mirror is added. The yellow beam passes through a magenta crystal, creating a red beam.
* Go back down the ladder to the middle floor. Go to the south ladder and climb up to the top floor.
* Go to the pillar at the north-west corner, add a mirror, and reflect the light south.
* Go directly south to the next pillar, add a mirror, and reflect the light east.

* Go down the stairs in the middle of the top floor, then go down the next set of stairs.
* Go through the cyan door. Rotate the mirror west towards the final pillar to merge it with the blue and green beams, creating a white beam pointed at the black door.
* Go through the black door to the death altar.

* Pull the south-east lever at the southern part of the room to rotate the crane. Position the crane and claw over the jig cart.
* Use the elemental bar on the jig cart underneath the purple claw to place the bar on jig cart.
* Pull the south-west lever twice, the one right in front of the purple claw to lower the purple claw and pick up the elemental bar.
* Pull the south-east lever to rotate the crane so that the purple claw and the elemental bar are over the molten lava.
* Pull the south-west lever to dip the elemental bar into the lava.
* Pull the south-west lever again to pull the elemental bar out of the lava.
* Pull the south-east lever to bring the purple claw and the golden, hot elemental bar back around & to being above the jig cart.
* Pull the south-west lever to drop the elemental bar back onto the jig cart.
* Pull the south-west lever again to raise the purple claw.

* Pull the jig cart operating lever (the only one labelled 'lever' instead of 'an old lever') which is just south of the spiral stairs. This sends the jig cart and the elemental bar to the next press station.
* Pull western old lever, that is next to the 3 pipes, to flatten the elemental bar.

* Pull the jig cart operating lever to move the cart again. The cart stops in front of a water tank.
* If there is any water in the chamber, turn the west valve to make sure the west valve is closed, then turn the east valve twice to open and close the east valve.
* Pull the old lever to open the door.
* Turn the corkscrew lever twice to pick up the flattened bar with the jig cart and move them into the water tank.
* Pull the old lever to close the door.
* Turn the valve to the west to flood the chamber. Then turn the valve again.
* Turn the valve to the east to drain the chamber. Then turn the valve again.
* Pull the old lever to open the door.
* Turn the corkscrew lever twice to move flattened bar with the jig cart back to the conveyor.
* Pull the old lever to close the door.
* Pull the jig cart operator lever.

* Pull the old lever on the east side. Proceed through the dialogue boxes "The fan starts to blow" and "The machine starts rumbling".
* Pull the old lever once more to turn off the fan.
* Pull the jig cart operating lever to bring the jig cart and the white bar back to the start.
* Take the finished primed bar from the jig cart.

* Reach Burgh de Rott - fastest ways of doing so are using Games necklace or Drakan's medallion
* Travel south-east to the pier and board a boat to Meiyerditch
* Jump out of a boat and proceed west/north-west through rocks
* Climb down the floor and then climb-over the wall rubble to the north
* Proceed north to the Old Man Ral

title: Monsters to kill
list:
* 17 Crawling Hands on the 
* 12 Banshees on the (requires protection from the banshees' screams)
* 9 Infernal Magi on the 
* 7 Bloodveld on the 
* 7 Aberrant spectres on the  (requires protection from the spectres' odour)
* 5 Gargoyles on the  (requires a Rock hammer)
* 6 Nechryaels on the 
* 6 Abyssal demons on the

* Enter the pass through the cave entrance in West Ardougne.
* Simply walk around the swamp and do not attempt to cross the bubbles in the cave.
* Talk to Koftik, and he will give you a damp cloth.
* Use it on an arrow to change it to a fire arrow.
* Light this arrow. It is possible to miss arrows in the next steps, so you may need to make more. Only make one at a time because you can not light these arrows if there is more than one in your inventory.
* Go to the north.
* Equip the bow and fire at the guide rope with the lit fire arrow, and you will automatically cross the bridge.
* Once you have crossed the bridge, you may be attacked by level 42 blessed spiders if you are under level Combat. Stay away from the small rooms to the north and south to avoid them.
* Now, go to the little chamber to the north and pick up a plank.
* Continue going south, then east.
* Use a rope on an old spike on the ground on your side next to the north gap. It is possible to fail this part and lose your rope, so bringing multiple ropes is a good precaution. If you do fall, you will have to navigate a rock maze to get out. You will end up at the beginning of the pass, and you'll have to start with firing at the guide rope again. The old spike is very small and slightly below ground level. It may be necessary to point your camera west and zoom very far in to see it.
* Continue following the path and climb over two rockslides.
* You will come to a grid of spike traps. For each person the path to cross these is different, so it is suggested that once you find your path, you write it down somewhere. You could already have figured out which path is safe for you while doing the quest Underground Pass. The area prevents you from using abilities like Surge.

* Once past the spike traps, pull the lever to the south and the portcullis will rise. Do not take the obstacle pipe because it's only one-way and you will have to redo guide rope obstacle.
* After passing the gate, you should be in a room full of zombies. Head west past the furnace.
* Continue going west, and as you run past the spear wall traps, you might take some damage. If you have a good Thieving level you can try to disable them by searching the odd markings on the wall. You may take multiple triple-digit damage per trap if you try to run past without disabling them. Area prevents you from using abilities like Surge so it is best to disarm the traps. Search on the odd markings on the wall, then run two tiles ahead of you. With run active, your character will run past the wall trap without activating it. You'll only take damage if you run across them all at once.
* Next, climb down the well.

* Head west towards the cages of slaves.
* Enter the south-east cage and dig up the mud. This will take you to the back of the cage.
* Follow the path and cross the ledge (if you fail, you will reach back to the cell area).
* In the next area you have a couple choices.
** If you have 50 Thieving, you may pick the locks on two cages by following the southward path. Once past the cage, make sure you don't step on the bubbles, or you'll have to start back at the beginning.
** Otherwise, head onto the wooden bridges, balancing over the narrow parts. Take the right path, left, then finally, the left again. The higher your Agility level, the less your chance of failing it.
* Whichever path you took, follow the path to the south and squeeze through the pipe.

* Go past the smashed cage and pass through the tunnel on the north side of the cave.
* Follow the passage until you pass the zombies and see paladins.
* Use the earlier found plank on either one of the flat rock traps to get past.
* Continue forward, open the door, and you will be standing in Iban's lair.

* After entering, head as far south (past the bridges and walkways) as you can. Along the back wall, you'll find stairs.
* Descend the cave stairs (this will take you to "Beneath Iban's Lair" as shown on the world map).
** If you need food, talk to Kamen the dwarf in the southwest corner of the cave. 
** Decline or accept Kamen's brew, but note that it will lower your Agility, potentially heightening your chances of falling into the abyss in the next step. 
** After declining or accepting, Kamen will offer to sell you food for 75 coins. 
* Proceed to the northwest corner until you find cave stairs that can be ascended.
* Ascend the stairs. 
** If at any point you fall during the next steps, these stairs are where you'll go to return to Iban's Lair and try again.
* Heading south, cross the third walkway.
* Jump over the bridge to the first platform.
* From the first platform, go southeast to a second platform.
* From the second platform, take the eastern path over a winding bridge to the third platform. There should be some red-cloaked Disciples of Iban on this platform.
* Proceed south for a bridge jump.
* Take the western path closest to the Temple of Iban stairs.
* Open the temple door.
** Doing so will unlock the Well of Voyage music track. 
** You can talk to Koftik here if you have completed the Underground Pass quest, who will give you some food if you were hurt by the traps.
* Climb-down the well.
* Head west past the glowing obelisks and exit the cave.

* Teleport to the entrance to Fremennik Slayer Dungeon, for example fairy ring, ring of slaying, Fremennik Province lodestone.
* Equip climbing boots to climb the rocks slightly north-east of the entrance (obtain the boots from Freda if the player does not have them).
* Enter the Troll Stronghold from Secret Entrance.
* Go to the upper level and exit the stronghold.
* Go to the north-east and follow the path. Be aware of the attacks from Thrower Trolls south of the boulder.
* Either lift the boulder (level 60 Strength) or squeeze past the boulder (level 60 Agility).
* Enter the hole near the knight.

* Teleport to Burthorpe lodestone.
* Equip climbing boots (obtain them from Freda if the player do not have them).
* Follow the route to get to the dungeon. This route may take damage from Thrower Trolls around Death Plateau.
* Either lift the boulder (level 60 Strength) or squeeze past the boulder (level 60 Agility).
* Enter the hole near the knight.

* Click the right side of the tar regulator twice.
* The player should see the "pressure" indicator on the left go up.
* When the indicator reaches the green region, click the right side of the pressure valve on the left once to let out pressure.
** If the player let it reach the orange region, they may have to click the valve to release pressure twice.
** This should keep the pressure dial in the green region.
* Now the player should start to add coal.
** If they have the correct setup, the tar regulator will be open and the pressure valve on. If the player turn off the tar regulator and keep the pressure in the green, they will not create the naphtha.
* Start by adding 3 pieces of coal.
** The heat cools over time, so add a piece of coal when the dial stops increasing, but do not add any when it is inside the green region – wait for it to cool below first.
** If it reaches the orange region, it will fail and the player will need more coal, but it is easy to avoid reaching that.
* When the bar along the bottom is full, and both dials reset, close the distillation window and the barrel will be filled with the naphtha.

* Crouch behind northern mine cart.
* Hide behind north-east wall.
* Mine rubium piece No. 3.
* Hide behind north-east wall.
* Place rubium on north-east vent, and quickly go hide behind north-east wall.
* Mine rubium piece No. 4.
* Crouch behind north mine cart.
* As soon as villagers turn around, place rubium on north-west vent then go Crouch behind the west cart.
* Mine rubium piece No. 6 then go Crouch behind west mine cart quickly.
* Hide behind south-west wall.
* Once southern villager is looking away, place rubium on south-west vent, and then go hide behind south-west wall again.
* Mine rubium No. 5.
* Crouch behind south mine cart.
* Place final piece of rubium on south-east vent. As soon as the final piece is put in place, the villagers will collapse, so don't worry about being caught.
* Proceed to the south-east door.

* Break the rocks in the centre of the room and immediately pass through to the east section.
* Wait until the north-east villager starts walking east, and the door guard is turned away. Run to the north-east pillar and mine four rubium from the wall, staying slightly behind the villager who walks around the pillar. After mining the fourth, make sure the door guard is turned away, and hide behind the wall where you originally broke the rocks.
* Hide behind the east mining cart.
* Use the north steam vent, and hide in the north niche.
* Use the west steam vent, and hide behind the west cart.
* Crouch behind the east cart.
* Run to the south-east corner of the west section, fully into the corner so that the villagers won't see you.
* Use the south steam vent, and again hide in the south-east corner.

* Run through the arched entrance at the south end of the fortress and climb up the stairs to the west.

* Enter the trapdoor in front of you to delve into the first level of the dungeon.

* Go into the eastern room and pick up the heat globe from the pedestal. Something nearby may freeze further.
* Return to the entrance room, and place the heat globe on the pedestal on the west side. This will melt an ice block, releasing a level 102 waterfiend.
* Pass through the gap where the ice was into the western room, ignoring the waterfiend. You must now telegrab the heat orb you just placed, from this room. Doing this will retrieve the globe, refreeze the ice, and may turn the waterfiend into an icefiend if it has not been defeated.
* Use the globe on the pedestal in this room to melt the ice to the trapdoor, and spawn another waterfiend. Go down the trapdoor, leaving the orb in place.

* Pick up the heat globe from the floor of the southern room.
** Two crates here can be looted; the southwestern crate contains a hammer, but the other one is currently blocked.
* Use the heat globe on the pedestal back in the north room, melting various ice deposits and spawning two waterfiends.
** The northeastern crate in the south room may now be looted for 40 law runes and 300 air runes.
* Go back north and then travel east until you find another pedestal ("Radiant pedestal"), and remove the imperfect heat orb from it.
* Exit the dungeon the way you entered, returning to the surface castle courtyard. You may have to remove and then replace the globe in the upper room to melt the path.

* Scale the damaged wall to the west, then head to the north-east corner to the destroyed pedestal. Use the imperfect heat orb on the "smashed globe-holder" on the ground, next to the "smashed pedestal".
* Once you have added the globe, select the "Push" right-click option. A small cut-scene will play, wherein you push the orb down the snowdrift and into the hole at the centre of the courtyard.
* Return to the lower level of the dungeon, re-entering the trapdoor and choosing the option "Yes, carry on from where I was."

* When you make it back down to the lower dungeon, head east back to the area where the imperfect heat globe was acquired.
* Go south, then west to find and pick up another heat globe.
* Head back east, to the point where the path turns north, and you will see a pipe in an alcove on the south wall. Use the globe to get it stuck in the mouth of the pipe.
* Use the hammer on the globe, or simply select the 'Whack-pipe' option. The globe will be expelled from the other end of the pipe and land on a pedestal in the other room. This will melt another ice block and spawn another waterfiend, but will allow you to pass through the passage. Continue to climb the ladder in this room.

* Look-at the thermometer. Note down the number it says. Check your current character's weight in your equipment interface. You must equalise both numbers. If you weigh more than the number: subtract the number from the thermometer from your character's weight to get the result number. For example: if the thermometer says 20 and you weigh 30, you would need 10. If you weigh less than the number: subtract your character's weight from the number from to get the result number.

* On the floor of this room is a Pile of weights. Take weights equalling the result number you got. * Repair the damaged deck of the ship.
* Go to Draynor Village. In the house north-east of the bank talk to Ned.

* After crashing on the island, follow the light grey path around and up to the top of the mountain. Climb down the hole.
* Move past the skeletons until you see Elvarg behind a short wall of spikes protruding from the ground on the east.
* Before you climb over to Elvarg its advisable to open the shortcut in the wall south of the short wall.
* Climb over it and kill Elvarg.

* Solve the hay bale puzzle:
** As you arrive, go north once and push the one hay bale there all the way to the western wall.
** Standing where you are, push a pair of hay bales at your immediate south twice.
** Go one square east and push another pair of hay bales to the south.
** Push the single hay bale directly west of you.

* Climb down the ladder.
* Talk to Zenevivia.

* Traverse through the dungeon, deactivating all the traps by walking on them and then return to the surface.

* Climb the staircase.

* Enter the dungeon. 
* Traverse through the dungeon, killing all the enemies (high-level players need not worry about using super antifire for the iron dragon as it is fairly weak and may be killed quickly).
* Enter the final door, talk to the Wise Old Man. 
* Climb the stairs.

* Talk to Zenevivia to start the battle. If you fail your first attempts, return to the Wise Old Man at the house in Rimmington. Right click on the house teleport tabs to modify them for another teleport to the fight.

** Zenevivia uses magic spells and flames on the floor that can quickly deal around 600 damage.
** She will sometimes use protection prayers so prepare to switch attack styles or just use Necromancy.

* After she is defeated, talk to her.

* You will return to Draynor Village.
* Talk to Zenevivia in the Wise Old Man's house. 
* Go upstairs and look through the telescope and watch the Wizards' Tower Robbery.
* Head downstairs, talk to Zenevivia again.

* Talk to Kennith along the east coast of Daemonheim near the Fremennik ship (Shadow reef). 
* Go west, and talk to him again.

* Enter the opening formed in the mountain nearby.

* Head east two rooms
* Kill the three enemies in this room
* Find the blue key on the floor 
* Return to the first room and unlock and enter the puzzle room door

* Choose a hero (preferably the one with the most health).
* One way to solve the puzzle is:
** Jump south across the first gap
** Jump west twice
** Jump south
** Jump north, back to the same spot
** Jump east three times
** Jump south twice and the puzzle is completed.
* Inspect the Seeker of Truth and return across the gap. (Quickest method is to get caught and teleported back).

* Talk with Bailey.

* Lure the fishing spot and go back to Kennith, the slug will follow you.

* Combine the ingredients to make the anti-mind control serum.
* Talk to Kennith, a little to the west. 
* Talk to the Slug thralls.

* Leave one character by the Witchaven villager just north of the entrance and move the other 2 to the metal gate to the north-east and kill the Risen knight.
* Use the character you left behind to knock out the Witchaven villager and proceed south with your player.
* Go into the room with the lever and pull it.
* The metal door to the north will now be open. Send a character through.
* Pull your player's lever again.
* Use the character you left near the entrance to knock out the other villager again, allowing your player to run north to the other characters you left by the gate.
* Bring the character you left at the entrance to join your player. Use the character in the room to pull the lever to let you all in. Pull the lever again and run south, east, and then north to the exit while killing any risen knights in your path.

* Send everyone to the north as far as they can go while avoiding the villager.
* Pull the lever and send Kennith and your player into the room to the east. Send Ezekial to the western room and leave Eva in the central chamber.
* Leave Kennith in the eastern room and send your player south to pull the lever.
* After the lever is pulled send Kennith into the easternmost room to pull the lever.
* Have your player pull the southern lever again.
* Send Ezekial west (if not already in the western room) then all the way south to pull the lever.
* Make Kennith pull the lever again and then send him into the southernmost room on his side to pull the lever.
* Send your player back to the central chamber with Eva.
* Make Ezekial pull his lever again and then send Kennith back to the central chamber.
* Make Ezekial pull the lever once more and send him back to the central chamber.
* Now that your party is regrouped, go to the next room.

* Kill all of the Risen Knights.
* Send a character to each of the rooms in the four corners.
* Pull all four levers in the following order: northeast, southeast, southwest, & then northwest. 
* Run to the newly opened gates and 'regroup' all of the characters. Proceed to the next room.

* Use your player to investigate the strange device. Put your arm in. 
* Kill the first wave of knights with Kennith, Ezekial, and Eva. Your player will then investigate the second hole.
* Kill the second wave of knights. Your player will investigate the third hole. 
* Kill the third wave of knights.
* Enter the tunnel to the north.

* Once the gate is open, knock down the wall in the west room with Ezekial and move Kennith north. Place him as close as possible to Mother Mallum while standing on the western ledge.
* Take control of Ezekial and knock down the wall to the east and proceed north.
* Kill or run past the knight and position Ezekial directly opposite Kennith.
* Take control of Kennith and attack Mother Mallum.
* You now have control of Eva. Talk to Mayor Hobbs and knock him out, then attack Mallum.
* Move Eva north of the statue and topple it.
* Talk to Lucy. 
* Leave the Citadel using the cave exit.

* Return and talk to Gudrun.

* Head to Ape Atoll and equip the monkey greegree and monkeyspeak amulet, then speak to three wise monkeys in the Temple of Marimbo (north-easternmost temple). 
* Fill your entire backpack with Green bananas by using take banana from the pile of bananas crate to the east and lay a trail to lure the guard to the crate (you can place bananas every few squares to ensure the guard does not give up. Key-binding the Green banana will make this step easier). You will have to go counter-clockwise around the building due to the large gorilla posted on the north side. See the full guide for advice on luring the guard efficiently.
* Return to the three wise monkeys and talk to them.

* Helpful things to keep in mind:
** Looking at the world map prevents the chimp ice from melting.
*** If you are out of run energy, rest and pull up the world map.
** Talking to NPC's prevents the chimp ice from melting.

* Take the chimp ice to King Awowogei without teleporting (this route requires completion of Eagles' Peak. For a full list of routes, see the in-depth quest guide):
** From Nardah, use the magic carpet to Uzer.
** Run north-west to the desert eagle lair located north of the Uzer Hunter area and north-east of the Dominion Tower. Enter the tunnel shown in the picture, and use the rope that spawns nearby on an eagle to be transported.
** Exit the cave via the north-west entrance and climb down the mountain.
** Run east into Tree Gnome Stronghold, up of the Grand Tree and find Daero to the east to travel to the Secret Hangar.
** Talk to Waydar to travel to Crash Island.
** Talk to Lumdo to travel to Ape Atoll. You get a checkpoint here where you can restart if the chimp ice melts.
** Run to King Awowogei. The chimp ice can't be frozen while transformed as a monkey, so choose your moments carefully. An easy method is to freeze it at the mahogany tree before the main gate, turn into a monkey, and enter the gate. Run east to the small obelisk across from the agility course and hide in the grass to freeze it again. Then turn back into a monkey, and run to King Awowogei.
* Go to the wise monkeys and add them to the barrel.

* Return to the three wise monkeys and hand the knives over.

* Take the letter on the floor.
* Search the coffin for a mysterious medallion (deals small amount of damage). 
* Climb the rope to leave the cave and return to Veliaf Hurtz.

* Once teleported, head to the northernmost room. The medallion can also teleport you to the Meiyerditch laboratory.
* Talk to Safalaan.

* Exit the base, go through the wall to the north and climb up the stairs.
* Jump the floorboards to the west and go down the ladder.
* Open the door, then go west a bit, then south to the building with the fireplace.
* Enter the building and climb up the ladder, where you will briefly be held up by two vyrewatch.
* Now jump over the wall to the building to the west and climb down the ladder.
* Open the door, exit and close the door.
* Now go north and west around the next building. Enter it and go east, where Vertida will be standing and talk to him.
* Climb the wall and speak to Mekritus A'hara.
* Stand on the lookout point for a cutscene.
* Drop-down the floorboards to the east.
* Talk to Nessie who is in the courtyard south of the building.

* Attack Vanescula Drakan - she will knock you back (if she does not knock you back, dismiss any active conjured spirits, unequip any armour, and climb up and back down the wall to the east, then try talking to her again).
* Talk to her and exhaust all options, eventually learning about the tree and receiving an envelope. 
* Teleport to Meiyerditch with the medallion and take the envelope to Safalaan.
* In the same room, talk to Vertida Sefalatis. 
* Head to the most south-western point within the Meiyerditch hideout. Search the crate for 30 smoke bombs.
* With your medallion, teleport to the Meiyerditch laboratory. 
* Go up the stairs, open the door, go through the slashed tapestry, and then out of the building.
* Run north and squeeze-through the grate on the north wall.
* Talk to Vanescula on the other side of the grate.  In Darkmeyer, the vyrewatch will attack you when you pass them as opposed to in Meiyerditch.
* Use the smoke bombs to avoid being caught by vampyre juvinates. Do not go near vyrewatch.
* Search chests inside buildings to find clothing (four pieces in total). You can use another smoke bomb before the previous one dissipates. Enter a building before your smoke shroud vanishes. Once in a building, immediately close the door.
* Fix all four pieces and wear them. You no longer need to hide in smoke.
* Return to Vanescula.

* Walk up the ramp to the north-east to enter the level of the city.
* Talk to Sanguinus Varnis at the top of the ramp, telling him your vampyre name. 
* Completing vampyric tasks below increases your rating. After completing enough tasks in the middle tier of the city, your rating bar will be half full, allowing progression into the next tier of the city.
* Talk to the Vyrewatch guard in the north-eastern jail.

* Complete any of the following tasks until you reach a half-full rating bar and access to the upper tier (proceed to next section).
** Terrorising Maria Gadderanks, , 
** Use the Angry or Laugh emotes several times next to Maria Gadderanks
** Talk to Maria while wielding the Gadderhammer
** Talk to Valentina Kaust , drink the vial of blood she gives you (if you are prepared to be damaged for half of your health) , and then use either chat option.
** Vandalise the four posters (after getting the task by speaking with Sanguinus Varnis), shown as purple squares on the image, and then report back to Sanguinus Varnis again. 
** Recapture six bloodveld younglings (after talking to Grigan Kaninus ). These vanish for long periods of time, so they can appear in places you've already checked. They are displayed as yellow dots on the minimap.
** Talking to Sentinel Draemus, Sentinel Gorthaur, or Sentinel Mortshade about citizens in Meiyerditch, the Myreque, and Burgh de Rott (three conversations).

* Killing Captured Meiyerditch citizens for the Vyrewatch guards is the fastest way to fill the reputation bar, as each kill gives 2 reputation but there is a limit to how many you can kill in a short period of time. There are about a dozen locked in the jail and they respawn fairly quick. Start the task by talking to a Vyrewatch guard in the south-western jail. 
* Entertaining Misdrievus Vakan then approach the nearby blood tither . Talk to Misdrievus Vakan again and then enter the building to the west for a cutscene.  
* Speaking to Vanescula Drakan to pledge allegiance to the Drakan family. 
* Talking to Sentinel Bloodmortis, Sentinel Noctantine, or Sentinel Plaguemanst about Vanstrom Klause  and Lord Drakan  (two conversations).

* After gaining enough status in the upper tier, talk to Vanescula about entering the Arboretum. 
* Enter the Arboretum (Ranis will stop you). 
** Arboretum is a big temple-like building to the east
* Proceed to enter the Arboretum.
* Solve the four puzzles:
** Check the health of the tree for the orb pattern.
** Pull the lever (along the eastern edge) to start the first puzzle.
** Rotating the orbs by clicking the left-bottom orb of a group of four orbs.
** Match the orbs to the puzzle solution.
** When the puzzle is complete, pull the lever.
* Check the health of the tree again. Repeat the process for all four puzzles.

* Chop the tree for three blisterwood logs and a cutscene will play.
* In the entrance room to the west, talk to Vanescula to be teleported to out of Darkmeyer.

* Use the medallion to go to Meiyerditch. 
* Talk to Vertida Sefalatis. 
* Talk to Vertida again for a bottle of holy water.
* Talk to Kael Forshaw for two silver sickles. 
* Use the medallion to teleport back to Darkmeyer. . This will complete the achievement On Wings Of Bling.
* Craft each of the logs into a staff, a polearm, and a set of stakes. Remember to set the quantity to 1 in the Build-X interface or you will lose the logs permanently. Fletching the blisterwood polearm leads to the achievement Raising The Stakes.
** If you forgot to cut three logs, you can enter Arboretum without any issues and cut some more.
* Bank at the Darkmeyer Treasury. The bottle of holy water is required for the fights with Vanstrom Klause and Harold.
* Enter the house with Harold in it (just north-east of the captured citizens) and kill him with any weapon. You must throw the bottle of holy water over him to be able to kill him.
* Go back to the bank and prepare for the final fight with Vanstrom Klause who is east of Harold.

* Only blisterwood weaponry can deal damage.
* If you're attacking at a distance use Deflect/Protect from Magic; otherwise, Deflect/Protect from Melee.
* If he shouts "Stare into the darkness!" run to the edge of the arena and rotate your camera away from him. Maximum 4000 damage.
* If he shouts "Let the blood consume you!" run away from the blood splodge on the floor. Maximum 6000 damage.
* If he shouts "Come, fiends, and aid your master!" kill the two easy minions that he spawns.
* If he throws blood bombs towards you, keep running around the room to avoid them. Maximum 4000 damage per bomb.
* Once he is very low health he turns into a cloud. Keep using holy water near him until he loses all health. Unequip your ring of life if you're wearing one.
** If you are saved by a ring of life after a group of bloodveld guardians spawn, heal up and return without a ring of life. You will be damaged, but in a safe way. You will not have to redo the fight.
* Use Deflect/Protect from Magic for this last part as Vanstom can do rapid magic damage to you whilst he is dying.

* Take control of Vanescula and kill the Bloodveld guardians. It is recommended to use the Shriek attack repeatedly as soon as it recharges.
* When you awaken, speak with Vertida, and watch a short cutscene.
* Teleport to Burgh de Rott with the medallion and talk to Veliaf Hurtz. 
* Quest complete!

* If you don't have desert clothes, buy them from Shantay.
* Begin the quest by talking to Irena (south of Shantay Pass). 
* Run south and slightly west to the gate of the Desert Mining Camp.
* Making sure not to attack him, talk to Mercenary Captain (the one with the all-grey shield). 
* Kill the Mercenary Captain to obtain a metal key.
** The metal key can be added to the steel key ring after One Small Favour.
* Unequip all armour (includes amulets, rings, etc.) and weapons, and keep them unequipped whenever inside the mining camp or mine.

* Open the gate to enter the camp.
* Go east to the mine door entrance and talk to the male slave on the east of the camp (it's the one who never mines). 
** If a guard catches you unlocking the slave's chains and you end up in the cell, bend the bars on the window and escape. Talk to the slave to try again.
* While wearing the slave outfit, open the mine door entrance. The outfit must be equipped any time you enter the mine.
* Upon entering, head north and follow the cave around until you come to a guarded cave entrance.
* Making sure not to attack him, talk to one of the guards. 
* Head back to the mine doors and exit.
* Unequip your slave clothing and leave the Desert Mining Camp through the gate.
* Run west to the Bedabin Camp.
* Talk to Al Shabim in the southernmost tent to receive the Bedabin key.

* Run east back to the Desert Mining Camp and climb up the ladder in the white building.
* On the western wall search the southernmost bookcase for a book on sailing.
* Talk to Captain Siad in the same room and ask him if you can chat with him, then mention the sailing book. 
* Open the chest beside the table to get the plans.
* Go back to the Bedabin Camp and show Al Shabim the plans. 
* Enter the tent to the north.
* Use the experimental anvil with a bronze bar in your inventory and answer the prompt to create a prototype dart tip.
* Use a feather on the dart tip to make a prototype dart.
* Take this back to Al Shabim. He will take the prototype dart, technical plans, and Bedabin key in exchange for a bronze dart and Tenti pineapple.

* Wear the slave outfit, head back down into the mine and give the pineapple to one of the guards.
* Walk through the mine cave and run east to the mine cart.
* Choose "Search" option on one of the empty barrels nearby and answer the prompt to take it.
* Choose "Search" option on the mine cart to ride it to the other side, answering the prompt to confirm. 
** Failing to enter the cart will cause minor damage. If you fail, attempt to enter the cart again.
* Go down the northwestern passageway containing a large number of slaves at the end and you will find Ana.
* Use the barrel in your inventory on Ana to squeeze her inside it, and head back to the mine cart.

* Use Ana on the mine cart first, then ride it yourself when it comes back. 
* Search the barrels around the cart and retrieve the one that has Ana in it.
* Use the winch bucket north-west of the cart to put the barrel on it.
* Accept the guard's offer for help and give him a compliment. 
* Head back to the surface and go to the winch bucket in the south-western corner of the camp.
** Do not remove your slave clothes at any point.
* Operate it and then search the barrel west of it.
* Use Ana on the wooden cart at the centre of the camp.
* Talk to the Mine cart driver. (Warning: If you use the wrong responses you'll have to rescue Ana again!)
** If you fail, you need to head back into the deepest part of the mine with a barrel and get Ana out again.
* Search the cart and answer the prompt to get on.
* Run northeast towards Shantay Pass and talk to Irena.
* Congratulations, quest complete!

* Go to your player-owned house portal, and attempt to enter your house.
* Attempt to enter again and choose the "A Clockwork Syringe" option from your portal. 
* Read the delivery note.(If Pete doesn't appear check your bank for the note) 
* Attempt to enter your house again and select the "A Clockwork Syringe" option once more. 
* Investigate the large crate. 
* Kill the level 98 Barrelchest Mk II.

* Talk to the estate agent.
* Interrogate the zombie head.
* Torture the head using all five options.
* Interrogate the head once more when it reaches maximum stress.

* With the zombie head, talk to Bill Teach on Mos Le'Harmless, either in the Other Inn or on The Adventurous ship. 
** Head to the docks of Port Phasmatys, cross the gangplank on the easternmost ship, right-click travel via Bill Teach to travel to Mos Le'Harmless.
** Alternatively, charter a ship directly to Mos Le'Harmless from Port Sarim.
** You can also use fairy ring if you have repaired the bridge there and partial completion of A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift.
* Walk north to Harpoon Joe's House of 'Rum'.
* Sit in the chair in the north-east corner and ask Joe for a "Long Drop". 
* Talk to Bill.
* Place-evidence on table nearby to set the zombie head on top.
* Talk to Bill again.
* Climb-up the ladder.

* Select-spell with the pirate spell sheet in your backpack to travel to Braindeath Island. 
**The spell can only be used on the of Mos Le'Harmless.
* Go directly west and talk to Captain Braindeath. 
** Optional: get a diving apparatus and a fishbowl helmet from him, if you don't already have them.
* Go to the Braindeath Island 'Rum'-geon entrance:
** Optional: If you have it, activate the Dungeoneering cape to travel directly there, skipping these steps. 
** Climb-down the wooden stair to the west.
** Head north past 50% Luke and open the gate.
** Head north across the two bridges to the mysterious entrance.
* Equip your diving apparatus and fishbowl helmet.
* Enter the mysterious entrance.
** Optional: kill a crab in order to complete the hard Daemonheim achievement Alcrabholic.
* Go down all three paths and search the dead brewers to discover their names.
* Return to Captain Braindeath and receive the Twiblick night special. 
* Teleport back to Mos Le'Harmless with the pirate spell sheet. 
* Return to the basement in Joe's pub. 
* Talk to Bill and receive the unlocked Twiblick night special.
* Open the box. 
* Talk to Bill again. 
** Select any of the remaining chat options to give the zombie head a makeover.
* Talk to Bill again.

* Return south to Bill's ship, cross the gangplank, talk to him, and use the "A Clockwork Syringe" option to begin your travel. 
* Talk to Bill. 
* Climb-down two ladders to the hold of the ship (lowest level).
** Open and search the gun locker.
** Open and search the repair locker.
** Take 3 gunpowder from the powder barrel.
** Take a barrel from the barrel stack.
** Use the gunpowder on the chain.
** Use the anvil to smith the heated chain and cannonball together.
** Use your cannonball and chain on the barrel to receive a cannonball barrel-boat.
* Go back up the ladder to the main deck. On the eastern cannon, choose 'Take-The-Ride' option to go to Bloodsplatter Isle.

* Investigate the Perch Rock. You must steer him around while dropping cannonballs on the Barrelchests.
* Leave the Isle by diving at the pier and swim.  
* Climb the ladder and talk to Bill on his ship, request to go to Bloodsplatter Isle. 
* Walk in to the middle of the factory building in order to get caught.
* Escape your cell and collect the following items directly north of the cell:
** Surgical mask.
** Roll of bandage.
** Barrelchest parts (abscond with shelf).
** Barrel from the stack.
* Return to Bill by using the signalling point at the end of the dock where you arrived. 
* Get the Barrelchest disguise from Bill.  
* Talk to Bill again and have him send you back to the island. 
* Enter the the factory and take 3 barrels from the stack and 3 gunpowder from the barrel - where you picked up the supplies for the Barrelchest disguise.

* Change into the Barrelchest disguise. Must be 3x3 clear around your character.
* Letter One: Go to the south-west room, sabotage the southern gas canister. 'Tell-joke' to each of the Dis-orderly and then brutalise each of them. Investigate the noticeboard.
*Letter Two: Kill each of Grimterns in the western-most room. Investigate the noticeboard after killing them.
*Letter Three: Talk to one of the drunk zombies lying on the beds in the north-west room, then investigate the noticeboard.
*Letter Four: Loosen each of the three undead arms in the north-east room, then inspect one of the arms, finally investigate the noticeboard.
*Letter Five: This step requires at least 300 life points. Use the three gunpowder on the barrels in your backpack. Then in the south-eastern room, finish-building on each of the three incomplete barrelchest stations, then detonate one of them to destroy all three. Finally, investigate the noticeboard.
* Change out of the barrelchest disguise from your backpack. Changing in the middle of the factory gets you caught.
* Return back to Bill by signalling him from the dock to the south.

* Talk to Bill onboard his ship and show him the evidence files.
* Return to Bloodsplatter Isle. 
** The barrelchest disguise is no longer required.
* Head back into the factory and enter the easternmost room.
* Pull the lever to activate the three conveyor belts. 
* Left-click the conveyor belts to load Bundle o' kegs onto them. 
** Continue loading the conveyor belts until each of the conveyor belts explode. 
** You can safely ignore the zombies that make it to you; killing them does nothing and they automatically die when all three belts explode.

* Jump over the destroyed wall between the conveyor lines, and head east through the door opening to the docks.
* Climb-down the ladder at the end of the dock.
* Board the unoccupied zomboat and sink all the boats.
** Fire cannonballs at the boats either by left-clicking on them, or using the minigame menu.
** Don't forget to repair your boat when it gets to about 25% health - it is not instant and you can only repair while your boat is at a stand still.
* After you sink all of the other boats, climb up the east ladder and talk to Bill on his ship.
* Head back to the basement in Joe's pub. 
* Talk to Bill to finish the quest.
* Quest complete!

title: Gathering supplies
list:
* Fish in the hole to the north east for a shark tooth and a squid. (Make sure to not stand directly on the fishing spot or you won't be allowed to fish, refer to the picture for where to stand.)
* Take the board from the wood scrap pile north of kitchen.
* Search the kitchen for olive oil, a popsicle tray and a hammer.
* Talk to Teddy to get a chequered piece of cloth.
* Search the shelves in the southwest washroom to get lye and a cork screw. It is also possible to obtain the hammer here instead of in the kitchen.

title: Assembling the set
list:
* Use the lye on the olive oil to make unmoulded soap
* Use the unmoulded soap on the popsicle tray.
* Use the squid on the popsicle tray to colour half of the pieces black.
* Use the hammer on the soap to carve it into game pieces.
* Use the ripped fabric on the board to make a game board.
* Take the game board back to Plaza. He will then give you the blueprints to the submarine. (If you leave the camp before turning in the board game you can retrieve the pieces that you have already made from Teddy)

* Be on the standard spellbook
* Be on standard prayers and have full prayer points
* Have 100% run energy
* Do not have a follower summoned
* Have an empty inventory
* Have all of the following equipped:
** A ring of visibility (unless the player has been granted the gift of looking into the Shadow Realm by Sliske), and
** A ghostspeak amulet or cramulet (unless the reward from the Morytania Hard Tasks has been claimed), and
** Six pieces of acceptable Saradomin equipment that the player owns, listed below. No items aligned with another god may be either equipped or in the player's inventory. The ring of visibility and ghostspeak amulet do not count as one of these items.

* Speak to Sir Tiffy Cashien in the Falador Park about the void knights. 
** Or, if Slug Menace isn't complete 
* Go to the Void Knights' Outpost.
** To get there, speak to the Squire on the pier at Port Sarim to travel to the island by ship free of charge. 
* Speak to Commodore Matthias in the north-east building.
* Talk to Captain Tyr just south of the building.
* Talk to the following people about escaping pests:
** Knight Ami 
** Knight Bernard 
** Knight Diana 
** Knight Mikhal 
** Jessika 
** Mariah 
** Mrs Gord 
** Squire Sam 
** Terry Gord

* Talk to Captain Tyr.
* Talk to Jessika about the crimes she has committed. 
* Talk to Captain Tyr.
* Talk to Commodore Matthias.
* Agree during the cutscene.

* Solve the 3x3 slider puzzle. The border helps you find their correct positions.
** The centre piece will appear when you have placed the border pieces. 
* Watch the cutscene and continue the dialogue with Commodore Mathias.

* Bank all your items, both equipped and in your inventory. Dismiss any pets or familiars.
* Return to Sir Tiffy and talk about Void Knights. 
** Or, if Slug Menace isn't complete

* Talk to Commander Korasi. 
* Talk to the toll booth to start the puzzle. 
* Complete the puzzle:
** Talk to Bernard and cross with him. 
** Talk to the toll booth to send yourself over. 
** Talk to Ami or Diana and have them cross together. 
** Talk to the toll booth to send Bernard over. 
** Talk to Bernard and cross with him.
* Right-click assign the people to the following:
* Completing the puzzle correctly triggers a cutscene.

* Kill the torcher.
* Go up the ladder.
* Kill the shifter and wait for another cutscene.
* Once teleported, talk to Sir Tiffy.
* Speak with Captain Tyr at the Void Knights' Outpost.
* Quest complete!

* Talk to Wizard Mizgog on the of the Wizards' Tower, just southeast of the beam. 
** Make a bowl of hot water if you haven't already, by filling a bowl at a water source, then using it on a Cooking range (all available in the Lumbridge Castle kitchen - If you have not done Cook's Assistant, you can use the range in the southeasternmost house in Lumbridge, south of Bob's Axes). You may also light a fire and use a bowl of water on it.
* Go to the Water ruins (west side of Lumbridge Swamp) and talk to the Phlegmatic imp. 
** Talk to the imp again, with a bowl of hot water in your inventory.
** Take the Phlegmatic bead it drops.
* Go to the Fire ruins (north of Al Kharid; outside Het's Oasis), talk to and fight the Choleric imp.
** Take the Choleric bead it drops.
* Go to the Earth ruins (north-east of Varrock; south of Fort Forinthry) and cheer up the Melancholic imp. 
** Take the Melancholic bead it drops.
* Go to the Air ruins (west of Varrock; southeast of Barbarian Village) and talk to the Sanguine imp.
** Race the imp around the altar 4 times by clicking and running inside the four different checkpoints when they appear.
** Take the Sanguine bead it drops.
* Return and talk to Wizard Mizgog. 
* Quest complete!
* Start the quest by talking to Xenia in the Lumbridge graveyard.

* Enter the catacombs.
* After a cutscene, proceed north. 
** Talk to Xenia if there is no dialogue.
* Defeat Kayle then talk to him. 
* Take his chargebow.
** (Optional) Equip it if you don't have any Magic, Ranged, or Necromancy weapon.
* Head west, open the tomb door, and then go through it.
* Defeat Caitlin.
* Go south and operate the winch.
* Talk to Caitlin. 
* Take her staff.
* Go down one of the stairs to the west. 
* Defeat Reese and talk to him. 
* Untie Ilona.

* A cutscene will occur. 
* Quest complete!

*Obtain the following items: a bucket of milk, a pot of flour, and an egg:
**Buy from the Grand Exchange for .
**Create them yourself:
***Bucket of milk: use a bucket on a dairy cow or prized dairy cow in the Lumbridge cow field.
***Egg: spawns at the chicken farm north-west of the cow field.
***Pot of flour: with an empty pot (found by the Cook in Lumbridge Castle), head to the Mill Lane Mill next to the cow pens and pick some grain from outside. Climb up to the top floor of the mill and use the grain with the hopper, then pull the lever. Climb down and take the flour from the flour bin with an empty pot.
*Talk to the Cook in Lumbridge Castle's kitchen with all the items in the backpack. 
*Congratulations, quest complete!

* Talk to Veronica located just inside the gate to Draynor Manor. 
* Enter the manor.

* On the, grab the fish food in the room south of the staircase.
* On the , take the poison from the room south of the kitchen, in the northwest of the manor.
* Use the poison on the fish food.
* Exit the manor through the eastern-most room (or teleport to the Draynor lodestone) and walk to the fountain in the southwest corner of the yard.
* Use the poisoned fish food on the fountain.
* Search the fountain for the pressure gauge.

* Walk along the west side of the manor until a compost heap is found.
* Search it for a grimy key.
* Go inside the manor and enter the small room behind the staircase.
* Take the rubber tube.

* Return to the entrance hall of the manor and go into the room to the west.
* Search the candle sconce on the western wall to open the wall.
* Climb down the trap door ladder to the north in the new room.
* There will be a puzzle with the solution as follows.

* Pull levers A, B up
* Enter Door 1
* Pull lever D up
* Enter Door 1
* Pull levers A, B down
* Enter Doors 3, 4 & 5
* Pull levers E, F up
* Enter Doors 6 & 7
* Pull lever C up
* Enter Doors 7 & 6
* Pull lever E down
* Enter Doors 6, 8 & 3
* Go through Door 9 and obtain the oil can.

* Leave the basement.
* Pull the lever on the eastern wall.
* Go up the stairs, then up the ladder, and talk to to Professor Oddenstein. 
* Talk to him again.
* Quest complete!

* Teleport to Falador and run north along the road to the Goblin Village.
* Talk to General Bentnoze or General Wartface, both of whom are located in the hut. 
* If you need goblin mail, you can grab three suits of goblin mail from the following crates:
** Behind the generals' hut.
** Behind the western hut.
** Up a ladder in the middle of the gate entrance of the camp.

* Dye one goblin mail blue and another orange.
* Use the orange goblin mail on one of the generals.
* After the cutscene, use the blue goblin mail on one of them.
* Use a normal goblin mail on one of them.
* Quest complete!

* Talk to Squire Asrol in the White Knights' Castle courtyard in Falador. 
* Talk to Reldo in Varrock Palace library about the Imcando dwarf tribe. 
**If The Giant Dwarf quest is complete, skip this step.
**If wielding ring of charos remove that, otherwise option does not appear.
* Talk to Thurgo south of Port Sarim (pictured right, north of fairy ring ) with a Redberry pie in the inventory. 
**If Smithing cape is obtained 
* Talk to him again. 
**If Smithing cape is obtained

* Talk to Squire Asrol. 
* Climb the ladder to the east, then the first staircase to the west.
* Enter Sir Vyvin's room directly south.
* Look for a cupboard and open it then search it.
** If Sir Vyvin keeps noticing, four methods can be used to distract him.
*** Have a friend talk to Sir Vyvin while you open and search the cupboard.
*** Open the door to his room and wait for him to walk out. However, this will take a very long time, so keep hopping worlds until you arrive at one where he's already outside, or alternatively just shut the door when he leaves and then search the cupboard.
*** Wait until he is behind the door, then quickly search the cupboard.
*** Wait until Sir Vyvin looks at a wall, then quickly search the cupboard.

* Give Thurgo the portrait. 
**If Skillcape in Smithing is obtained 
* Climb down the trapdoor on the hill east of Thurgo's house to enter the Asgarnian Ice Dungeon.
* Follow the dungeon until blurite rocks are seen (see the map).
* Mine a blurite ore.
** If you wish to complete Defender of Varrock later, mine an extra blurite ore.
** If you wish to complete the medium Falador achievements later, mine another one.

* Talk to Thurgo with the materials. 
**If Skillcape in Smithing is obtained 
** Bars can be withdrawn at the anvil in Thurgo's hut.
* Report back to the Squire Asrol. 
* Quest complete!

* Talk to Redbeard Frank just outside Port Sarim's pub. 
* Walk south along the docks, pay 30 coins to Captain Tobias to go to Karamja.

* Head inside the pub.
* Buy one Karamjan rum from Zembo.
* Do not leave the island yet or more rum will have to be obtained.
* Pick 10 bananas from the Banana Trees to the north-west.
* Go east to the house by the docks.
* Talk to Luthas about the officer., then talk to him a second time to ask for a job. 
* On the east side of Luthas' house will be a wooden crate.
* Use the Karamjan rum on the crate, then right-click Fill the crate.
* Talk to Luthas.

* Head to Wydin's Food Store in Port Sarim.
* Equip your white apron and attempt to open the door to the back room. 
** A free white apron can be obtained from the back wall in the fishing store.
* Search the crate with the banana on it.
* With the rum, return to Redbeard Frank for a chest key.

* Go upstairs in the Blue Moon Inn in south Varrock.
* Open the chest in the south-west room for a pirate message. Read it.
* Go to Falador Park and stand on the east end of the pond, directly west of the statue of Saradomin, indicated by X on the ground.
* Right-click Dig using the pirate message. Kill the gardener. Alternatively, leave the site for a while and the gardener will be gone.
* Right-click Dig using the message again.
* Quest complete!

* Talk to Father Aereck in Lumbridge Church. 
* Go through the graveyard's southern exit and follow the shore to a mining site. Head west to a hut in the swamp.

* Talk to Father Urhney inside the hut. 
* Go back to the graveyard and open a coffin located south of the catacombs.
* Equip the Ghostspeak amulet and talk to the ghost.

* Head back through the southern gate of the graveyard, keep walking until you reach the mining site once again.
* Look south-east of the mining site, there are some rocks. Search the rocks, you will receive a muddy skull.

* Several items will need to be placed around the ritual site:
** Northern Beacon: Run west from the ice entrance at the north of the plateau. Place the beacon on the closest tree.
** Southern Beacon: Run directly south, and place the second beacon in the tree south-south-west of the ritual stone. If this is done correctly, you should have a message saying the south beacon is opposite the northern beacon.
** Arrav's Heart: Place Arrav's heart in the rocks south of the ritual marker. The site is several paces south of the marker and just a pace or two east. If you cannot place the heart in a pile of rocks, you are at the wrong place.
** Western Beacon: Run up the west side of the plateau until you find a tree just north of a central line. Place the beacon here. Using the tree just south of the central line will not work.
** Eastern Beacon: Run straight east and place the beacon on the tree directly opposite the western tree. You should have a message saying the east beacon is directly opposite the west beacon.
** Go to the north-west corner of the plateau and look for an Overhanging Tree above the Cavern entrance. Use a rope on it to create a rope climb from the beach to the plateau, turning it into a Snow-covered Tree with an attached rope. This will be used for your allies to climb to the ritual. (From now on, you can also use the rope yourself to get between the canoe landing site and the plateau without having to go past the dragons around Ghorrock.)

* Read the code key and open the main entrance by obtaining the code from the key and strips. (In this example we take the code "EIHC", see the image on the right for the solution)
** Drag the red strip number 1 to the first letter of the code key (example: "E").
** A single number will be revealed by the code strip (example: "E" row). Enter that number in the code box using the controls.
** Drag the red strip number 2 to the second letter of the code key (example: "I").
** A single number will be revealed by the code strip (example: "I" row). Enter that number in the code box using the controls.
** Drag the red strip number 3 to the third letter of the code key (example: "H").
** A single number will be revealed by the code strip (example: "H" row). Enter that number in the code box using the controls.
** Drag the red strip number 4 to the fourth letter of the code key (example: "C").
** A single number will be revealed by the code strip (example: "C" row). Enter that number in the code box using the controls.
