* Right-click to use three glasses of beer on Jalal the Drunk. Finish the dialogue with each beer.
* Talk to a Menaphite Thug, who can be found inside the bar or outside the west side of the bar. Make sure to right-click to avoid attacking him.
* Talk to a brigand or bandit in the North Pollnivneach. Again, right-click to talk to him.

* Head to the kebab seller north-west of the well in the town centre. The map icon is [[File:Kebab seller map icon.png]].
* Talk to Isma'il the Kebab seller to buy red hot sauce from him. 
* In the house immediately to the south-west, talk to Sami the Camel Man to ask for two camels. Offer 500 coins. 
* Use the red hot sauce on a trough in the pen west of the camel shop.
* Pick up the dung with a bucket in the backpack if the dung is brown. If it is green, use more sauce on a trough until it is brown.
** 2 empty buckets can be found in the camel shop.
** Obtain more buckets of dung if you plan to complete Dealing with Scabaras (1 bucket, does not consume) and My Arm's Big Adventure (3 buckets).
* Talk to a Menaphite Thug to the south to give them one of the camel receipts.
* Talk to a brigand or bandit to the north to give them the other receipt.

* Go south-west of Pollnivneach to a big purple tent and talk to Rashid the Operator to join his gang. 
* Attempt to pickpocket a villager. You will fail and take 20 damage.
* Talk to Rashid the Operator for advice. 
* Talk to the street urchin near the well or the fountain. Pay him ten coins and then pickpocket the villager with an arrow over their head. You will fail again and take 20 damage.
* Talk to Rashid the Operator. 
* Wield the oak-blackjack.
* Lure a villager into a secluded area. Knock out the villager with the blackjack and pickpocket them.

* Talk to Rashid the Operator.
* Wear the desert disguise and gloves.
* Hide-behind the cactus near the mayor's house next to the fountain.
** The disguise and the gloves can be safely unequipped after this step.
* Use the keys on the door. If lost, talk to Rashid the Operator for another.
* Climb the staircase on the northern side.
* Search the landscape picture near the bed.
* Move the dial to 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8 in that order clockwise. Right-click the dials to help with the numbers. Click the centre square button will reset the mechanism.
** 1
** 1
** 2
** 3
** 5
** 8

* Talk to to Rashid the Operator to give the jewels.
* Talk to a Menaphite Thug.
* Talk to Rashid the Operator. 
* Talk to Faisal the Barman. 
* Right-click to talk to Badir the Snake Charmer sitting south of the bar. 
* Right-click to use the snake charm on a desert snake north of the Menaphite tent and wait until it goes into the snake basket to become a full snake basket.
** If Badir the Snake Charmer did not give you a snake basket, it may be in your bank or talk to him again. 
* Talk to Maysa the Hag, in the house north-west of the bar, on the hill.
* Talk to Maysa the Hag the second time to give her the full snake basket and ugthanki dung respectively.
* Use the Hag's poison on the table in the bar. It is the square one with a glass of beer on it, not the one with the empty beer glass.
* Talk to Rashid the Operator.

* Talk to the Menaphite Leader. Located outside the tent.
* Kill the Tough Guy.
* Talk to a villager. 
* Talk to the Bandit Leader east of the northern magic carpet station. The Bandit Leader will not appear if you did not talk to the villager in the previous step.
* Kill the Bandit champion.
* Talk to a villager.
* Talk to Hakeem the Mayor located next to the well in the middle of the town.
* Return to Ali Morrisane in Al Kharid.
* Quest complete!

* Talk to the Priest of Guthix just southwest of the Piscatoris Fishing Colony (slightly north west if using fairy ring ). 
* Enter the cave.
* Proceed through the caves whilst cutting twigs from the trees along the way (you should collect 5 total)

* In the final cave, fletch the twigs into ribbons.
* Craft the pyre then light it.
* Talk to the Phoenix.
* Exit the cave entrance.
* Talk to Brian Twitcher (Priest of Guthix).
* Quest complete!

* Outside the Carnillean Mansion south-west of East Ardougne, talk to Xenia. 
* Talk to Ceril Carnillean. 
* Search the bookcase in the room with Henryeta Carnillean for a book about the Carnillean family.
* Talk to Butler Crichton. 
* Head into the basement and enter the hole on the east wall (cutscene will begin), then head back to the house.

* Go to the and take the red and black dragon head from the wall (2 heads in total).
* Open and search the southern wardrobe for the armour and sword.
* Tear the net curtain from the north-east wall.
* Take the money pouch from the bed or Henryeta's necklace from the dresser.
* Search his painting set for red paint.

* Talk to Sarsaparilla., then talk again. 
* Open and search the wardrobe for her dress.

* Head to the cellar and talk to Claus the chef. 
* Search the cupboard, take everything (wooden boards, twine, shears, and Sir Ceril's wine).
* Search the barrel of junk to collect rusty spikes.
* Pick up the spider from the floor.
* (optional) Pick up 7 buckets of water from the floor.
** It is faster to skip this step and build a spike pit instead.

* Right-click build on the hole hotspot. (The cave going into the next area) 
* Enter the cave and talk to Sarsaparilla and Claus. 
* Continue through the cave and talk to the goblins. 
* Head to the south-easternmost part of the tunnels and enter the passage. 
* Search the spoils near the heap for bone scraps south-west of the room.
* Take the cave mouse to have the wolves follow you out.

* Head north to the centre bridge.
* "Build" the "jailer" hotspot by leading Claus to it.
** If the money pouch was taken, use it on Claus.
* Cross the bridge and build the dragon hotspots. The wolves will move into position.
* Use the dragon heads on the wolves.
* Build the Damsel hotspot.
** If the necklace was taken, use it on Sarsaparilla.
* Head back south across the bridge.
* Build hotspots in these locations as you backtrack up towards the cellar:
** Decoration - on the wall east of the fire 
** Traps - east and west of the fire 
** Decoration - west of the fire at the end of the hall 
** Decoration - on the north wall before turning around towards the cave entrance 
** Obstacle - on the floor in the southernmost corridor, heading towards the cave entrance

* Head back into the house and talk to Philipe. 
* Pickpocket him. Talk to him again. 
* Proceed through the cave while Philipe follows. 
* Watch the cutscene where Philipe attempts to pass the guards.
* Talk to Slimepits (one of the goblins) until a dialogue window with the Butler appears - do not continue dialogue until Philipe passes.
* Talk to Philipe again to have him follow.
* Continue towards Claus. 
* Talk to Philipe again to have him follow.
* Continue towards the dragons and talk to Philipe. 
* After the dragons are slain, a cave wolf matriarch will arrive. 
* Attempt to attack the matriarch to focus its attacks on you. Dodge or withstand the attacks until Philipe kills it. If you run in circles around the matriarch, most of her attacks will miss and you will take very little damage.
** Do not use Protect from Magic or the matriarch will revert her attention back to Philipe.

* Talk to Philipe for a cutscene. 
* Talk to Ceril.
* Talk to Xenia. 
* Talk to Ceril.
* Quest complete!
* Loot the chest near Ceril.

* Talk to Chuck the polar bear in Ardougne Zoo.
* Speak to him again. 
* Speak to him a final time to be teleported

* After being teleported by Chuck, head west to the seals.
* Wake up the seal that can be interacted with. 
* Perform the Dance or Jump For Joy emote.
* Talk to the seal. 
* Travel-Iceberg the smaller boat to the north-east. 
* Talk to Ping & Pong. You don't need to be in your tuxedo for this.
* After receiving the items from them, do one of the following:
** Option one
***Use a Clockmaker's bench 4 in a player-owned house to make their rock costume. 
***To return, use the Fremennik Province lodestone and head north to board the ship to iceberg.
** Option two
***Head to the north-east corner of the Iceberg and right-click Jim, a well disguised polar bear next to the stepping stones, and select 'tuxedo-time'. 
***Head to the north-west and investigate the avalanche of snow. Follow the main hall to the end and talk to the KGP agent in the booth. 
***After proceeding through the door, head east and then follow the western wall in the war-room to the western workbench. Craft Ping & Pong's costumes there.
***Head back outside. To get back in to the hallway, Push the big button west of the gate.
***Return to Jim, the polar bear, to get out of tuxedo.
* Give Ping & Pong their costumes.
* Board the nearby boat to return to the seals. 
* Wake up the seal, bank any items, including your clockwork suit, and head to the camp. There is a deposit box option when talking to the seal.

* Talk to Teddy, the polar bear in a clown costume, in the centre of the camp.
* Talk to Larry, north of Teddy
* Talk to Teddy again.
* Talk to Noodle outside the south-west building.
* Try to open the door to the southern building where the Walrus is in.
* Take bat-in-box the bat-in-box (slightly west of the door where the walrus is) from the front of the building.
* Encourage Teddy, Ping, Pong, and Bouncer to make noise by clicking on them repeatedly in turn. Click Ping, then Pong, then Bouncer, then Teddy until a cutscene starts. Their bars should all be blue, so it's a good idea to walk in circles.
* When the Walrus is outside, enter his building and steal from the table to receive an egg.
* Talk to Larry in the north with the egg.
* Talk to Teddy.
* Talk to all six of the unnamed penguins. (Four in the courtyard, one between the north and north-west buildings and one, hard to see depending on camera angle, on the fishing hole in the north-east corner).
* Talk to Teddy.
* Talk to Plaza outside the easternmost building.
* Collect the following items:
** Fish the fishing hole in the north-east until you receive a shark tooth and squid.
** Take a board from the wood scrap pile north of the easternmost building.
** Search the shelves in the easternmost building for olive oil, popsicle tray, and a rock carving hammer.
** Right click Teddy and Tear off fabric.
** Search the shelves in the south-west building for lye and a cork screw.

* Once all of the supplies are obtained:
** Use the lye on the olive oil.
** Use the unmoulded soap on the popsicle tray.
** Use the squid on the popsicle tray.
** Use the hammer on the soap.
** With a shark tooth in your backpack, use the ripped fabric on the board.
* Talk to Plaza.
* Talk to Teddy.
* Talk to Astoria outside the easternmost building. 
** If you are not prompted to start the game, talk to Teddy again.

* Defeat Astoria in a game of Battlefish. 
** Place your fish anywhere on the board.
** You can click on the "HIT" and "MISS" notifications to speed up this section considerably. But beware spam clicking may exit the game making you start over.
** Solution:

* In the small building just south-east, take from the circus prop crate on the northern wall.
* Talk to Teddy.
* To repair the engine:
** Use Bowling pin -> lever opening
** Use Hula hoop -> broken valve wheel
** Use Circus plate -> pressure gauge
** Use Foam finger -> pressure gauge
** Use Balloon -> metal wire
** Use Insulated wire -> wirebox
** Use Cloth -> cracked pipe

* Talk to Teddy. 
* Defeat the seals in Battlefish (if you accidentally exit, click on the periscope through the door to the left).
** Solution:

* Quest complete!

* Head through the Gnome Maze and squeeze through the loose railing.
* Talk to King Bolren.

* Talk to Commander Montai north of the maze. He is wearing red and will be wandering near the catapult to the east of where you are exited out of the maze. 
** Talk to him again to give him six logs.
* Talk to Commander Montai again. 
* Talk to the 3 tracker gnomes (map locations below).
* West of Commander Montai, fire the ballista and choose coordinate until successful.

* The building next to Tracker gnome 1, climb over the crumbled wall which is to the right of the locked door.
* Climb up the ladder and search the chest for an orb of protection.
* Climb back down the ladder and head out the door or climb back over the crumbled wall.
* Run back towards the north-west entrance of the maze, click Elkoy to Follow him.
* Talk to King Bolren. 
* Head north-west of the battlefield and follow the Ardougne wall all the way west.
* Kill the Khazard warlord.
* Return back to the maze and follow Elkoy.
* Talk to King Bolren.
* Quest complete!

* Head to Nardah (south of fairy ring ) and talk to Awusah the Mayor in the building east of the fountain. 
* Head to the house north-east of the fountain and talk to Ghaslor the Elder. You should receive a Ballad. 
* Head to the building that has a statuette plinth just west of Ghaslor's house and north of the fountain.
* Telegrab the ancestral key from the table.
** You may attach the ancestral key to your steel key ring if you've completed the One Small Favour quest
* Go to the other side of the building and open the northernmost cupboard and search it for the robe top and bottom.
* Fix the top and bottom robes.

* Head north, past the Dominion Tower until a waterfall is seen.
** You can teleport to there by using a traveller's necklace to south of the Uzer eagles' eyrie.
** There is a bronze arrow south-east of Dominion Tower and a shortbow north-east of it.
* Climb the waterfall.
* Equip the Robes of Elidinis and open the door.
** If the door will not open, make sure you repaired and are wearing both robe pieces, and make sure you have the Ancestral key you tele-grabbed earlier.
* Head east to the three doors.
* Try to open any door, kill the golem that spawns, then enter the room and clear the water channel for each room.
** If you click the door before the golem's death animation has finished, it will respawn and you will have to fight it again.

* Head through the door to the north and talk to one of the spirits in the large area. 
* Head back to Nardah. 
** It is possible to be bugged when exiting the cave. To get out of the bug, simply use a Home Teleport spell.
** Amulet of glory teleport to Al Kharid and then taking the magic carpet to Nardah is a quick option.

* Talk to Awusah the Mayor.
* Take shoes just south from the entrance door inside the Mayor's house.
* Go outside the house, then remove-sole from the shoes to obtain a sole.
** Ensure you have a light source or you will not be able to talk to the next NPC without being interrupted.
* Head west from the Nardah General Store, past a camp of trainee adventurers and climb-down the crevice.
* Talk to the Genie, then talk again.
** If your backpack was full, pick up the Statuette. - There will be room now as you gave the Genie a sole.
* Head back to Nardah and use the statuette on the plinth in the shrine room, north of the fountain.
** Optional: Pray at the statue for medium desert task achievement Heathen Idle.
* Quest complete!

* Travel to Mos Le'Harmless (fairy ring if you have repaired the bridge with 8 planks and 16 nails and partial completion of A Fairy Tale III).
* Talk to Bill Teach in The Other Inn. 
** If you have lost your Little Book o' Piracy, talk to him to get a new one.
* Buy three pieces of pirate clothing from Dodgy Mike's Second-hand Clothing.

* Go to house in south-east Rimmington with the Customs Sergeant while wearing three pieces of pirate clothing.
* Read the noticeboard next to the entrance door for information on the answers to the trick questions. The answers to the trick questions are different for everyone.
* Talk to the Customs Sergeant 
** Taking note of the ship name/s he references, select the answers that match the story on noticeboard.
* Deposit all your items in the Locker on the north side of the room. You need to store all the items you are wearing as well as dismiss any familiars.
* Talk to the Customs Sergeant again.

* Once in the prison, shout-through the barred window to your east.
* Pick up the tin cup in the cell and use it on the cell door 3 times until Heavy-Handed Harry throws stew on you, turning your prison uniform top into a fishy prison uniform top.
* Right-click tap the pipes on the eastern wall to receive a pipe.
* Shout-through your cell door until you receive a quill, paper, and ink bottle.
* Leave your cell through the hole to the north and search the rubble to receive an accordion (broken).
* Use the ink bottle on the paper to receive inky paper and ink bottle (empty).
* Use the ink bottle (empty) on the sharp rock outside on the east-most wall near the pier to get a smashed bottle.
* In order, use the smashed bottle, pipe, and inky paper on the accordion to get a vacuum pump.
* Use your fishy prison uniform top on the perch rock just east of the hole in the wall.
* Right-click use the vacuum pump on the perch rock once the seagull appears.
* Right-click use the vacuum pump and gull on the barred window.
* Dive off the pier on the east side of the island.

* Travel to Braindeath Island by speaking to Pirate Pete north of Port Phasmatys. 
* Go west and speak to Captain Braindeath. He will give you the fake beard, fake moustache and nose, fake monocle, moustache and nose, curly wig, and straight wig disguises. 
* Travel to the bar in north Port Sarim called The Rusty Anchor.
* Talk to the Bartender. 
* Talk to the Bartender again. 
** Repeat this about five times until he says he's tired.
* Go outside, put on a disguise, and then ask about the rum again. Repeat this step with each disguise. 
* Talk to the bartender again, this time with no disguise, and he will give you an order slip.

* Speak to Redbeard Frank outside of The Rusty Anchor in Port Sarim. 
* Travel to Mos Le'Harmless via the charter boat, fairy ring  if you have repaired the bridge, or Bill Teach, and talk to Brother Tranquillity to receive a letter. 
* Return to Redbeard Frank on the Port Sarim dock and deliver the letter. 
* Put on your pirate clothing and head back to Braindeath Island.
* Talk to Captain Braindeath for his mark. 
* Go down the southern stairs, and talk to Captain Donnie to get plans.
* Head north-west to 50% Luke by the bridge and use charcoal on him.
** There is charcoal in a crate on the other side of the gate near 50% Luke.
* Return to Redbeard Frank on the Port Sarim docks and exchange the Charcoal rubbing for Frank's mark. 
* Optional: Talk to the bartender and ask about 'rum' once more to complete the Rusty Reward achievement required for the master quest cape.

* Travel to Mos Le'Harmless.
* Talk to Bill Teach in The Other Inn to obtain an introduction letter. 
* Climb-up the bamboo ladder in Harpoon Joe's House of 'Rum' just north and speak with 50 Ships Mufassah. 
* Talk to Brass Hand Harry for 5 broken hands.
* Take-apart the five broken hands.
* With the two bronze wires in your inventory, use any piece of the hand on another to trigger a puzzle.
* Complete the puzzle to obtain a brass hand (the interface will close automatically when the puzzle has been completed).
** Try flipping the brace (bottom) piece if you're having trouble completing the puzzle.
** The location of the hand is as important as the components; make sure you're constructing the hand atop the silhouette.
* Talk to Brass Hand Harry (nearby) to receive an ink pad. Use the ink pad on the brass hand to get a inky hand. Then use the inky hand on the paper.
* Talk to Brass Hand Harry again to show him the completed Brass Hand Harry's mark.
** If you haven't done so yet, feel free to destroy the ink pad and hand.

* Equip your ghostspeak amulet, diving apparatus, and fishbowl helmet.
* Travel to Dragontooth Island by talking to the Ghost captain at the small boat in Port Phasmatys (he is at the south-eastern end of the docks). 
* Travel to the north-east part of Dragontooth Island and dive via the chain.
** You will need both hands free to dive.
* Swim around until you find a Karamthulhu and catch it. (It is the only fish that appears on the mini map.)
* Head over to the ship and climb-up the stairs.
* Open and search the chest to get a crowbar.
** An aggressive giant lobster may attack you. You can open and search the chest while being attacked.
* Return down the stairs and climb down the ladder.
* Go west on the bottom floor of the ship and dig the mess a several times to uncover the idol of many heads buried in the pile of planks and sand. Pick it up.
** You can wield weapons while down there digging, so you can kill any aggressive giant crabs or lobsters that may be hindering you from digging successfully.
* Bring the idol back to Bill Teach to receive Bill Teach's mark.

* Travel to Brimhaven and go to the Brimhaven Agility Arena entrance, located south-east of the docks.
* Speak to Cap'n Izzy No-Beard. 
* Return to the Rimmington Customs Office. Deposit all of your items in the locker and get arrested by talking to the Customs Sergeant.
* Search the bed for a crude lockpick and use it on your cell door.
* Kill one of the customs officers, loot the uniform and equip it to disguise yourself.
** You can withdraw your pickaxe from your tool belt to use as a weapon.
** Make sure you do not have lootshare enabled, as this can prevent the uniform from being dropped. If you do not get the loot, try relogging.
* Climb the stairs twice to the top floor.
* Open the door to the room with the cabinets.
* Search the northern-most cabinet on the second column from the west for "Wanda the Fish". 
* Talk to the Locker Officer and receive the brooch. 
* Return to Cap'n Izzy No-Beard in Brimhaven to receive Izzy's mark.

* Talk to the Customs Sergeant in Rimmington with the five marks. He will give you a file.
* Use one of the marks on the file.
* Talk to the Customs Sergeant to give him the filled file.
* Talk to him again to get sent back to prison.
* Search the bed for the crude lockpick and break out of your cell. Kill the Customs Officer(s) for another uniform, equip it, then head to the top floor.
** You may get a message saying that the lock is rusty, and the lockpick does not work. Continue trying until it works.
* Go to the top floor and talk to the Locker Officer to get back the filled file.
* Return to your cell and right-click open the door.
** If you do not have the option to open the cell door, hop to a different world.
* Shout-through the barred window to Young Ralph. A cutscene will follow.
* Quest complete!

* Talk to Ali the Wise in Nardah (north-most building). 
** To get there: teleport to fairy ring and run south.
** Or teleport to Al Kharid and go south to Shantay Pass, then take a magic carpet to Nardah.
* Head to the snowy area northwest of Trollheim, enter the troll tunnels and head north to go through the tunnels, and then head to the east to Ritual plateau tunnels.
** Follow the directions on the map below to get to the Ritual plateau tunnels, or use Trollheim Teleport if you have it. If you travel through Death Plateau or Troll Stronghold, you must bring the climbing boots. 
** Prepare for combat before going through Trollheim as you don't have any access to bank in there.

* Navigate through the caves by mining the rubble; some rubble must be mined from multiple sides to clear it.
** Optional: pick up the stone, granite, slate, and shale tablets.
** Optional: Search the small bookcase for notes (a-j) if you want to give all information to Ali the Wise after the quest is completed. There is no reward for doing so.
* Enter the room east of the caves.
* Climb the stairs.
* Talk to Arrav, who will attack you immediately. 
** After he starts attacking you, if you do not auto-retaliate, right-click and attack him.
* Fight until he teleports away. The fight will pause multiple times for dialogue.
* Enter the room to the south and search the tapestry on the west wall for base key and base plans.
* Travel back to Nardah and speak to Ali the Wise.
* After the cutscene, speak with Ali the Wise again.

* Enter the nearby Uzer Mastaba pyramid.
** To get there, either run north-east of Ali the Wise, use the nearby magic carpet network to get to Uzer and run south, or teleport to fairy ring and run east.
* Enter the pyramid, head north-west through the imposing doors, then south, down the stairs and talk to Senliten for oil in a canopic jar. 
** Players who have completed certain quests can also choose to head directly to the Pharaoh Queen from the pyramid doors.
* Use (do not eat) your dwellberries and ring of life on the oil in a canopic jar to obtain a full canopic jar.
* Return to Ali the Wise and speak to him.
** If Leela is in the mummy's tomb, she can return you outside the Uzer Mastaba.

* Go to the Varrock Palace and speak to Hartwin (northwest tower, ) to travel to Chaos Temple Dungeon. 
* Climb down the trapdoor.
* Follow the path, opening three doors along the way.
* Head east to the room with the range.
* Equip your insulated boots then enter the pipe on the south wall of the room.
* Run through the sewers and attempt to enter the next pipe.
* Summon your familiar, interact with it and choose the remote view option.
* Run to the room south of you, search all the tables for decoder strips and notes (k-z).
* Right-click pick-lock on the chest to obtain the code key.
* Go north to the room east of the pipe and operate the keypad and solve the keypad puzzle:
** First read the code key and memorise or write down the letters.
** Drag-and-drop strip #1 over the line indicated by the first letter of the code key (A, B, C...).
** The strip has a hole that reveals a specific number, this is the first digit of the passcode.
** Use the up and down arrows to enter that number, and press the right arrow to move to the next digit.
** Repeat this for the other three strips.
* Enter the room, equip your crossbow and mithril grapple, then grapple the pipe above you.
* Take from the pedestal for a heart in a canopic jar, then teleport out.
* Return to Ali the Wise and speak to him.
* Quest complete!
* Talk to Sylas south of Taverley (north of the Witch's house).

* Head up the east side of White Wolf Mountain near the Burthorpe mine entrance and talk to Grimgnash. 
* Once he is sleeping, take a Feather from next to the nest.
* Go back to Sylas and talk to him.

* Head to the tower directly south-east of Goblin Village.
* Go around the south-east side, climb over the crumbling wall, and talk into the drainpipe.
* Talk into the drainpipe again. 
* Climb up Rupert's beard.
* Talk to Rupert.
* Right-click climb down Rupert.
* Talk to Miazrqa, located over the crumbling wall and to the north of the tower.

* Head to the Witch's house south of Taverley, the building next to Sylas.
* Open the main door.
** Look under the Potted plant to the left of the main door of the witch's house to obtain a key if not given by the princess.
* Climb down stairs (cellar bulkhead) and search the crate near the piano for leather gloves. You may need to search multiple times.
* Whilst wearing the leather gloves, open the gate and search the Music stand.
* Play the piano in the first room (refer to the music sheet pictured right).
** The notes "EFEDC" are played on the right hand (upper) side and the notes "AEGA" are played on the left hand (lower) side.
* Right-click Search the now-opened piano.
* Make two shrink-me-quick potions.
** Combine vial of water and clean tarromin.
** Add shrunk ogleroot.
** Repeat.
* Go upstairs and head into the small room leading to the garden.
* Drink one of the potions next to the mouse hole and glyph.
* While in the mouse hole, follow these directions:
** Run north past the first mouse, find the set of the nails on the eastern wall and climb up them.
** Go south-west, and climb up the nails on the northern wall.
** Climb up the nails on the south wall in the room.
** Run to the north-east corner, and climb down the nails on the eastern wall.
** Run north, and climb up the nails on the eastern wall. 
** Pickup the pendant at the end of the next hallway.
* After taking Miazrqa's pendant, leave the mouse hole either by teleporting to Taverley, or Home teleport to Falador, or going back through the entrance.
* Talk to Miazrqa.
* Talk to Rupert to get Rupert's helmet.
* If you need another shrunken ogleroot, you can kill an Experiment No. 2 down the manhole near the entrance to the witch's house, or pick one up from the pile in the room with the experiments.

* Talk to Sylas.
* Plant the magic beans in the Farming patch next to Sylas and water it using a watering can.
* Climb the beanstalk and kill Glod.
* Take the golden goblin, climb down the stalk on southern sides and give it to Sylas.
* Right-click Use the other shrinking potion on the beanstalk.
** Careful not to drink it!
* Chop the beanstalk.
* Talk to Sylas.
* Quest complete!

* Head to Oo'glog and talk to Chief Tess. 
* Talk to Balnea in the Oo'glog bank.

* Talk to Chargurr north of the bank. 
* Talk to Chargurr with 8 achey tree logs and 10 eucalyptus logs in the backpack to add them to the fire pit.
* Talk to Chargurr. 
* Give her four spears. 
* Talk to Chargurr. 
* Use two raw chompies on Chargurr.
* Talk to Chargurr.
* Light the fire pit.
* Talk to Chargurr.

* Talk to Balnea located in the bank.

* You have exactly two weighings to determine which is the heaviest weight.
** The heaviest weight will always be random.
** Drag two sets of three weights onto both sides of the scale and click the central green gem to weigh.
** If one of the sides is heavier, you know the heaviest weight is part of the 3 weights that went down. Put one of those weights on the left side and one weight on the right side of the scale, the last one in the bottom row and click the green gem again. If either side went down you know the heaviest weight. If they are equal you know it's the one you put back in the bottom row. 
** If both sides were of equal weight, you know the remaining 3 weights in the bottom row are the heaviest. Put one of those weights on the left side and one weight on the right side of the scale, the last one in the bottom row and click the green gem again. If either side went down you know the heaviest weight. If they are equal you know it's the one you put back in the bottom row.

** A slower method is walking west from the Karamja lodestone, entering the dungeon, and walking to the iron and steel dragons
**If you don't get the question about 'One of a Kind' go back to the entrance of the room and walk slowly into the room again.
* Kill 3 iron dragons. 
* Head to the west wall by the mysterious entrance to study the dragonkin writing.

* Travel to the Grotworm Lair north-west of Port Sarim lodestone.
** Remora's necklace will take you directly outside of the portal.
* Enter the bottom level of the Grotworm Lair. You can use the shortcut to the south-east of the first floor to get there quickly. 
*Investigate the summoning portal. The portal is right next to the shortcut, a square hole in the wall gleaming green. 
* Talk with Hannibus.

* Travel to Dragontooth Island by talking to the ghost captain east of Port Phasmatys (south of those ships, in the small boat). 
** The fastest method is teleporting to Dragontooth Island directly, using the Dungeoneering cape teleport, or using the elder divination outfit to teleport to the "Radiant Wisp Colony".
** A quick method to Port Phasmatys is heading to Port Sarim and taking a charter ship to Port Phasmatys (talk to Trader Stan south-east of the lodestone).
** There are two ghost captains, you need to talk to the southern one who is standing next to a rowboat, not a ship.
* Enter the mysterious entrance to the south.
* Fight or tank a celestial dragon until Hannibus's bond reaches 100% (approximately 2 minutes).
** Attack multiple to reach 100% faster.
* Talk to Hannibus again.

* Activate the Artefact north of Edgeville Monastery to meet with Hannibus in the King Black Dragon Lair. 
**You will not enter a player-versus-player enabled area despite the warning.
* Talk with the King Black Dragon. 
* Enter mysterious entrance.
* Talk with Therragorn. 
* Kill the 3 dragon-hunters.
* Talk to Hannibus for a cutscene.

* Kerapac will talk to you. 
* Head into the far northern room. Kerapac will talk to you. 
* Harvest 25 dragonkin memories from the protoplasmic wisps and channel them into the cage.
* Talk with Kerapac to fight Echo of Jas. 
* Kill the Echo of Jas and then talk to it after you defeat it.

* Kerapac will talk to you. 
* Quest complete!

* Speak to Kharshai, located under the helmet shop in Rellekka. Agree to help him. 
* With the engrammeter, head to any divination colony of vibrant wisps or higher. Fill it with 500 divine memories.
** You may utilise World 79 (Community Divination World) for more frequent enriched springs.
* Visit the locations below, use the charged engrameter to collect the memory.
* Return to Kharshai. Talk to him to give him the memory. 
* Recharge the engrammeter with another 500 divine memories, and repeat for the remaining 14 memories.
* Take the final memory to Kharshai, receive your reward.

* Optional: Equip a ring of visibility to skip some dialogue.
* Find the World Gate, south of the Eagles' Peak lodestone.
* Talk to Azzanadra.

* Rotate the right controls near the gate until you reach World gate icon M.png.
* Rotate left until you reach World gate icon A.png.
* Rotate right until you reach World gate icon H.png.
* Step away from the controls, and speak to Sliske.

* Put on a face mask or equivalent protection to avoid taking 50 damage every 15 seconds while in Freneskae.
* Enter the World Gate to enter Freneskae.

* Run through Freneskae using the map below to reach the Sanctum. Move fast and avoid the hazards. There are healing points along the way if needed.
* Optional: collect the memoriam crystals along the way. They are numbered on the map below; for efficiency, start with collecting number 9, then 2, 1, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8.

* Optional: Deposit collected Memoriam crystals in the middle to see memories.
* Go to the north side of the room to the door puzzle.
* Match the symbols up together to light up the lines in between them three times to open the door, then enter.
* Kill the four nihils then enter the next area to the north. All nihils use a special attack after hissing. Each nihil always runs in the same direction. Therefore, a pair of nihil (ice and shadow or smoke and blood) can be killed first, leaving areas between the tracks unused and safe. Don't stand in the middle, as you might be dashed by multiple nihils at once.
** Killing the nihils while all 4 are attacking you will unlock the title and the achievement Annihilator. 
** The smoke nihil attacks with Magic. Its special attack will decrease Attack, Strength, Magic, Ranged, and Defence by 15. Its charge will decrease these stats by 5.
** The shadow nihil attacks with Ranged, and its special attack creates Nex-like shadow bomb at the position of player that deals rapid damage. Players should move away as soon as the floor below them is darkened by a circular spot. Shadow nihil darkens the whole screen whenever it approaches the player, both when charging or fighting the player, but this causes no gameplay difference.
** The blood nihil attacks with melee. Its special attack causes all incoming damage to heal it, indicated when the creature lowers its head and begin to glow. It also will passively heal other nihil if it is damaged. Its charge inflicts a bleed similar to Slaughter that begins at 100 damage.
** The ice nihil attacks with Magic, and its special attack applies a six second stun and drains player's Prayer points by 50% of its maximum. Its charge drains the player's Prayer points by 25% of its maximum.

* Attempt to descend the ledge to the north then speak to Zaros. 
** If you accept Zaros' help against Mah, he will provide you with full prayer for use with Ancient Curses along the fight and less damage from Mah.
* Defend against monsters while Mah has her nightmare (progress displayed at the top of the screen).
** Use Freedom or Anticipate after Mah clenches her hands to avoid being stunned when she screams in agony (though you will still take damage).
* When the progress is 0%, climb down the ledge next to Mah's hand.
* Collect The Measure and place it on the ground near faint wisps to activate them for harvesting (wisps can be found on the centre and edges of the cave. After revealing one, it will be a yellow dot on minimap).
* Convert Mah memories into Mah Energy using the Energy rift. When you gather 250 energy, weave it into a simulacrum (dark to help Zaros, light to hinder Zaros). Hop worlds if you are having trouble finding wisps. You will be outside of the World Gate, enter again using the checkpoint option.
* Return and speak to Zaros by exiting the rock face on the wall between two hallways (west of the energy rift). Speak to Zaros again after the cutscene. 
* Talk to Azzanadra through the world gate. 
* Quest complete!

* Speak to Brother Samwell (west of Paterdomus and east of Varrock). 
* Search for the following clues. 
** Investigate northernmost slaughtered monk. 
** Investigate nearby plant (east of the chest).
** Investigate the tree with the arrow stuck in it (south of him).
* Talk to Brother Samwell.

* Up the limestone quarry, speak to Odd Old Man. 
* Talk to Brother Samwell. 
* Search for additional clues by following the crystals to the east.
** Investigate the killed elf ranger (southeast of the Temple). 
** Investigate the plant west of her, near the middle pile of crystals next to the stairs.
** Investigate the clothing on the fence, to the south of the tree.
* Talk to Blaze Sharpeye by the beacon. 
* Return to Brother Samwell.
* Go to the Wizards' Tower and speak to Wizard Valina inside the entry way on the lectern.

* Return to Brother Samwell. 
* Learn from Icthlarin about Death's disappearance. 
* Defeat attacking wights.
* Finish the conversation with Icthlarin. 
* While standing next to Icthlarin, open the invitation box.

* Once in the citadel, talk to Icthlarin. A cutscene will play. 
* Enter the door to the west then north to the window to watch another cutscene.
* Walk out the south window; jump the gap; run across the planks; drop down the rocks; climb up the rock face; walk in the western window.
* Climb through the obstacle to the north.
* Open the north door, then continue north into the next room.
* Pull all three levers in the room (on the west, south, and east walls) to create light.
* Lead all the wights that spawn (a group of 3, then 4) into the light to be able to damage them.
* View the east window for another cutscene.
* Open the door to the north, then continue east into the next room.
* Use the viewing panel., then rotate the bottom-left machine once, the top-left one twice, the top-right three times and the bottom-right machine once.
* View the south window for another cutscene.
* Open the door to the east, then continue south into the next room.
* Talk to the statue of Death. 
* Open the chest and take the correct item, then place on the answer plinth pedestal.
** First chest (east) , place on answer plinth. 
** Second chest (middle) , place on answer plinth. 
** Second chest, again , place on answer plinth. 
* View the west window for another cutscene.
* Open the south door, then jump off the drop.
* Speak to one of the Barrows brothers to enter the main room. 
* After a cutscene, walk forward to continue talking with the Gods. 
* Run around rear of other gods and stamp out the smaller flames on the ground to reach Death's cage while avoiding the fireballs from Strisath. Free him from his cage.
** The flames might be difficult to see with low graphics settings, especially with shadows turned off.
* Run back behind Icthlarin.
** Getting hit by the fireballs will reset your progress.
* Speak to Icthlarin.
* Speak with Brother Samwell.
* Quest complete!

* Speak to Eli in Falador Farm north of Port Sarim. 
* Eat the piece of bacon he gives you.  
* Make sure you have at least 3 (better 6) free inventory spaces or Eli won't be able to give you planks
* Speak to Eli again.
*During the cutscene, avoid clicking too fast through the dialogue or you will have to restart the cutscene.
* Build the hotspots and keep adding bacon until Eli has escorted the pigs away (focus on the middle one and they will all swarm to it). 
* Talk to Eli. Choose any 1 of the 3 show pig suggestions.   or   or

* If necessary, gather 5 wheat from the field south-east of the Draynor lodestone.
* Talk to Martin the Master Gardener in Draynor Village. ( if Vampyre Slayer is completed)
* Go north-west of Martin and talk to each character (accuse each to quickly find the suspect).  
** Continue until you have found the suspect (usually Pickpocket Dan)
* View cutscene after accusing.

* Go back to Eli in the storm cellar and talk to him for construction materials. 
* Build the pig machine in the north of the cellar.
** Click a second time on the pig machine again to improve it.
* Speak to Eli. 
* Speak to Eli again to give him the 5 wheat you gathered. 
* Go outside and put bacon on the decoys then poison them with the sleeping potion.

* Talk to Eli.
* Pick 5 onions just south of Draynor bank. These must be picked after having talked to him; you cannot use onions you already have, even if you picked them yourself.
* Deliver the 5 onions to Eli. 
* Interact with pig machine.
* Watch the cutscene about the pig.
* Talk to Eli to receive a pig. 
* Take the pig to each location (a cutscene will play once you reach the correct area).
** Lumbridge Castle courtyard.
** Varrock Marketplace (in the centre of the fountain).
** Ardougne Marketplace.
** Falador centre (just south of the north gate).
* Return to Eli.
* Quest complete!

* Talk to Gideon Bede inside the church in north-east Varrock. 
* Climb down the trapdoor in the room.
* Walk north and speak to any of the spirits.
* Speak to the Spirit of the Mind inside the eastern room.

* Speak to the Spirit of Faith in the northern room, who'll guide you to the other side. 
* The correct pathway is:
** 3 north
** 2 east
** 3 north
** 2 west
** 1 south
** 2 west
** 4 north

* Speak to the Spirit of the Body in the western room. 
* Defeat all 10 skeletons.

* Talk to the spirits in the central room.
* Take Silverlight from the altar. Make sure you actually take the Silverlight in the rock in the centre of the room or you will not be able to do the next steps.
* Go back up the ladder.
* Read the scroll to the north of the trapdoor.
* Head south to Aubury's Rune Shop. South of the shop is a trapdoor just outside the Zamorak temple. Climb down the trapdoor.
* Make your way west to the large room, killing all the cultists along the way.
* Fight Delrith. Run into Gideon's dome shield to negate most of the damage. Only Silverlight or Darklight will work.
* Speak to Gideon again.
* Quest complete!

* Go to the middle level of the Troll Stronghold.
** Enter the cave entrance from Trollheim and go down one level.
** Otherwise, enter the secret entrance from the entrance to Fremennik Slayer Dungeon (fairy ring code ) or Death Plateau and go up one level.
* Talk to Ug on the middle level of the Troll Stronghold. Offer him your help. 
* Talk to Aga in the room to the north. 
* Talk to Arrg in the same room. 
* Talk to Ug again.

* Teleport to Burthorpe and talk to Freda in the plateaus west of Burthorpe. 
* Talk to Dunstan east of the Burthorpe lodestone about a sled. 
* Talk to him again to give him a rope, maple or yew logs, and an iron bar.
* Use swamp tar on a wax bucket (with a cake tin in your inventory).
* Use your wax on the sled.

* Enter the cave entrance opposite the ice gate, which located north-west of the main entrance to Troll Stronghold.
** Preferably use Trollheim Teleport here if you have it.
** Otherwise, you need to go through the Troll Stronghold and past Trollheim.
* Head north-west and exit the cave through the crevasse.
* Head south, equip your sled and slide through the slope.
* After the end of the first part of the ride, pick the Trollweiss flowers west of your location. Do not sled any further south at this point or you will have to climb the mountain again.
* Go back and talk to Ug.

* Talk to Arrg and tell him you're here to kill him. The fight will start immediately after that. Arrg also attacks immediately after the teleport, so be prepared. 
* Kill Arrg.
* Return to Ug and talk to him.
* Quest complete!

* Enter the south-western ruined house in Mort'ton.
** Teleport to Canifis and run south-west to the gate of the swamp (must have Nature Spirit quest started), and then head to Mort'ton.
** Teleport to fairy ring and then run south by south-east to where the map says the Hollows, to find a rowboat that takes you there.
** Alternatively use Drakan's medallion to teleport to the Barrows and run west.
* Search the shelf on the wall and read the diary. 
** If you do not find it, it's probably already in your bank.
* (Optional) Chop three swamp trees nearby and burn two logs to get the ashes.
** If you have an Underworld Grimoire equipped make sure to disable the auto-storage function, otherwise your ashes will be sent to the bank.
* (Optional) Pick up the vials (on the ground near the shelf) and search the smashed table for extra tarromin and one grimy rogue's purse.

* Make vials of water by using the empty vials on the sink nearby.
* Make Serum 207 by adding clean tarromin and ashes to a vial of water.
* Use it on Razmire (afflicted) in the general store.  
* Kill five Loar Shades and pick up their remains. Be sure to talk to Razmire first. They can be safespotted using the rocks south west of the waypost in the middle of town.
* Give him the remains. He may require more Serum 207.
* Use the serum on Ulsquire Shauncy, located in the house east of the general store.
* Wait a minute and ask him about the remains and the temple.
* Talk to Razmire. 
* Buy at least one olive oil from his general store and optionally a Flamtaer hammer.
* Open his builders' store.
* Buy 5 timber beams, 5 limestone bricks, 25 swamp paste.

* Hop to World 88 which is the official world for this minigame.
* Head north-east and kill shades or repair the temple to increase your sanctity.
* Repair the temple until you reach 100% and at least 20 sanctity.
* Light the sacred altar in the centre of the temple.
* For solo questers: Shade luring dummies can be used to distract the Loar Shades when repairing the temple. Using the Flamtaer bracelet, the solo player can instantly create the temple walls section by section, until at 100%.
* Use your olive oil on the flame to make sacred oil.
* (Optional) Use Serum 207 on the flame to make Serum 208, which permanently cures NPCs.
* (Optional) Use the Serum 208 on Razmire and Ulsquire in the houses nearby to permanently cure them.

* Use the sacred oil on a log to create a pyre log.
* Head to south-western Mort'ton to the Funeral Fires (do not cross the river to the west). The Funeral Fires appear as black crosshairs on the minimap on the western part of the Mort'ton.
* Use the Pyre Log to light the fire, then use the Loar Remains to sacrifice them on the funeral pyre.
* Talk to Ulsquire.
* Quest complete!

* Talk to Ali the Wise in the northernmost building in Nardah. 
* Go to the Exam Centre.
** If you asked Ali for help getting there, he gave you a Dig Site pendant (or Ali's pendant if you have not unlocked the ability to create Dig Site pendants) to teleport directly there.
** Alternatively, teleporting to Varrock Dig Site with either pendant for the first time will grant you the Return to Senntisten achievement.
* Talk to Dr. Nabanik outside of the Exam Centre south of the Digsite. 
* Talk to Terry Balando inside the exam centre for a restoration certificate. 
* Talk to Dr. Nabanik. He will give you a rope.
* Use the rope on the winch in the north-east dig site, north of The Stormbreaker ship.
* Operate the winch to enter the Digsite dungeon.
* Talk to Azzanadra in the southern part of the dungeon. 
* Open the ruined backpack for a battered letter and heat globe.
* Read the letter and then talk to Azzanadra.

* Travel to the Barrows.
* Kill the six Barrows Brothers found in their tombs below the ground.
** Barrows amulets can be used to skip killing up to three brothers.
** Amulets can only be used on the tombs before the brother is summoned.
** The final brother must be killed without using an amulet.
* Once all six brothers are dead, search the chest at the centre of the tunnels beneath the crypts to get the Barrows icon.

* Go to the Ghorrock fortress:
** First use the canoe near Erjolf from Tale of the Muspah for a quick access. It is located on the west coast of the Rellekka Hunter area, north of fairy ring code .
** Go east and place the heat globe on the pedestal near the ice block entrance.
** Squeeze past the ice block.
* Enter the fortress through the south entrance and climb-up the stairs to the west.
* Run to the south-east corner of the castle and climb-down the stairs east.
* Scale up the damaged wall north of the door.
* Climb down the smashed rampart in the north-west corner.
* Enter the trapdoor in front of you.

* Run east and take the heat globe.
* Return to the entrance room of the basement, and place the heat globe on the pedestal on the west side.
** A waterfiend will be released. It is immune to fire damage, but does not need to be killed.
* Go inside the west room, then right-click the radiant pedestal to cast Telekinetic Grab on it.
* Use the globe on this room's pedestal. Go down the trapdoor.
** A waterfiend will be released. It is immune to fire damage, but does not need to be killed.

* Pick up the globe in the southern room.
* Use it on the pedestal back in the northern room with the ladder. 2 waterfiends will spawn.
* Loot the crates in the south room for 40 law runes and 300 air runes.
* Go to the east room and take the globe from the pedestal for an imperfect heat globe.
* Exit the dungeon the way you entered.

* Scale the damaged wall to the west, then head to the north-east corner to the destroyed pedestal.
* Insert-globe in the smashed globe-holder on the ground.
* Choose the push option on the smashed globe-holder on the ground.
* After a cutscene, climb down the smashed rampart in the north-west corner.
* Return to the dungeon by re-entering the trapdoor.

* Go down the trapdoor in the western room.
* Run through the dungeon and take the heat globe from the pedestal in the southwestern corner.
* Head back east through the hallway you ran through until you reach the southeast corner, where the path turns north.
* At that corner, look for a pipe on the south wall.
* Choose the "Place-globe" option on the pipe.
* Choose the "Whack" option on the pipe.
* Continue into the southeastern room and climb the ladder to go up.

* Head west and kill the ice demon (it cannot be damaged by water spells).
* Take the Frostenhorn that it drops.

* Return to Azzanadra with the items back at the Senntisten Temple underneath the Dig Site. 
** The Dig Site pendant can be used to teleport outside the temple (option 2).
* Back outside near the winch, talk to the Assassin for a relic. 
* Return to Azzanadra. 
* After the cutscene, speak to Azzanadra again. 
* Quest complete!

* Talk to the Mercenary Adventurer at the Temple Trekking ending point (west of Canifis). or the Canifis lodestone are good options to reach the area quickly. 
* Enter the Mausoleum west of the Adventurer.
* Talk to Drezel. 
* Go through the gate west of Drezel and climb down the stairs north of the well.
* Search the sparkling wall storage unit a few steps east of the stairs, then go back up the stairs.
* Exit the Mausoleum via the west entrance ladder, enter the Paterdomus temple and head to the top floor.
* After the cutscene, kill Fistandantilus and Zaromark Sliver (or wait until they time out and teleport away).
** Both enemies have 2,750 life points, a combat level of 77, and a max hit of 220 in magic and ranged. These enemies will use prayer to become immune to your combat style, but do not protect against necromancy. Necromancy or multiple combat styles are recommended for this fight.
* Search the crude table in the north-west corner of the room.
* Return to Drezel. 
* Talk to the Mercenary Adventurer and escort him the same way as any Burgh de Rott Ramble.  
** Easy path recommended for least time and effort. Be sure to remove any melee-reducing equipment like ranged and magic armour. If you encounter juvinates, you will require your Rod of Ivandis or another silver weapon.
* Once in Burgh de Rott, if the dialogue does not automatically start, talk to the Mercenary Adventurer.
** If no one with that name is present in Burgh de Rott, skip to the next step.

* Climb over the wall inside the Pub and then climb down the trapdoor to the cellar.
* Talk to Veliaf Hurtz until he gives you a crate. 
* Climb up the ladder.
* Go south of Burgh de Rott and take the boat to Meiyerditch.
* Go to the Meiyerditch Myreque base. Refer to the Meiyerditch shortcut guide for help. Being caught by the vyrewatch and sent to mines provides a fast and reliable route.
* Talk to Flaygian Screwte, in the north room, and offer him your help.

* Ask Andiess Juip or Kael Forshaw in the same room about weapons. 
* Go to the next room south (near Mekritus A'hara) and search the middle bunk bed on the eastern half of the north wall for a book.
* Read it and remember which page mentioned flails.
* Give the book to Flaygian, giving him the proper page number. He will give you 10 nails and a hammer. (You can drop the hammer)
* Head to the northernmost part of Meiyerditch and enter the house south of the house with the furnace ("mass of debris").
* Use the Make-ladder option on the centre post.
* Climb up the post.
* Jump across the floorboards to the east, then to the north.
* Jump west through the damaged wall.
* Climb up the ladder and search the trough.
* Take a piece of coal from the coal barrel.
* Go to the bottom floor and select "dig" on the mass of debris (right click).
** If the "dig" option doesn't appear, you must go back to the top floor and search the trough
* Use the coal on the furnace, then light the furnace.
* Return and talk to Flaygian, then in the same room;
** Take 2 silver and 2 mithril bars from the barrel on the northern wall.
** Take a blessed sickle from the shelf on the south-western wall.
* Go to the room to the east of the entrance ladder.
* Search the crate for a chain link mould and add it to your tool belt.
* Return to the furnace and make the Silvthril chain. It can be found by clicking on the silver bar in the smithing interface (scroll with down arrow next to "Casting Metals & Glass").
** You do not need to make 2, you will have 1 bar of each type left. These are not used at any point in the quest so you can safely deposit them into your metal bank.
* Talk to Flaygian, then use the blessed sickle on him. 
* Talk to Safalaan.

* Proceed to the laboratory; the building south-east of the furnace, third from the top on the east wall and through the slashed tapestry.
* Dismiss any followers and climb down the stairs.
* After the cutscene, Look at one of the bodies in the north-west corner. 
* Search the door to the south and use the saw in your tool belt.
* Climb-through the door, then after the cutscene continue down the long and winding tunnel.
* Continue north on the path to the large chamber where the strange stones are.

* If you need runes for the Lvl-2 Enchant spell, search the corpse next to the rocks before continuing.
** Searching the corpse will complete the Bloodstained Treasure achievement, if not already completed.
* Search the strange stones in the northern part of the cavern.
* Talk to Safalaan. There will be a cutscene and a fight against vyrewatches in which you cannot deal any damage, but the fight will end in another cutscene with Safalaan being attacked.
* Make sure you have 4 free backpack spaces, then talk to Safalaan.
* Use the emerald on the sickle (right click, don't accidentally make bolt tips).
* Use the Lvl-2 Enchant spell on it.
* Use the chain on it.
* Talk to Safalaan.
* Go to the surface, equip the Ivandis flail, kill a vyrewatch, and pick up its corpse.
* Return to Safalaan.

* Return to the basement of the pub in Burgh de Rott and talk to Veliaf. Ask him what to do. 
* Return to and talk to Drezel at the Mausoleum. 
* Go through the west gate, then down the stairs north of the well.
* Use the pyre logs on a funeral pyre, then the vyre corpse. Light it.
* Take the ornate tomb key from the pedestal.
* Use it on the wall storage unit from the beginning of the quest on the north-eastern side of the room (the same one that is still sparkling) to acquire a blood talisman.
* After the cutscene, go upstairs and ask Drezel what to do. If you still have the library key: . Otherwise, to bypass getting a new key. 
* Report to Veliaf in the Burgh de Rott pub basement.
* Quest complete!

* Talk to Dondakan the Dwarf about cannonballs in the Keldagrim south-west mine. 
* In the western half of the Keldagrim Palace (the big building in the centre of Keldagrim), talk to the Dwarven Engineer.

* Teleport to the Falador lodestone and run north-east to the Dwarven mines (stay outside)
** Teleport using the skull sceptre and run west.
** Or teleport to the Invention Guild and run directly east.
* Talk to Rolad, who is located in the most north-eastern building near the ladder to the mines. There is a pause in the dialogue; be sure to finish the whole conversation.
* Go down the ladder to enter the Dwarven mines.
* Kill scorpions in the southeast to get the first page. It will appear in your backpack.
* Search the mine carts just to the north for the second page. They may also be in the mine carts just south of the ladder you entered the dungeon from.
* Mine any ore rocks in the mine to find the last page (the rocks in the resource dungeon connected to the mine do not work).
* Return to Rolad and read the book. Don't destroy the book yet.
** If you don't have an ammo mould for the next step, it can be bought from Nulodion for 5 coins. The ammo mould can be stored on your tool belt.

* Return to Dondakan in the Keldagrim south-west mine. Talk to him, and then use a gold bar on him.
* Head to any furnace with an ammo mould and make a golden cannonball.
** There is a furnace in the west side of the Keldagrim Palace. 
* Return to Dondakan and use the golden cannonball on him.

* Read the dwarven lore book to find a piece of base schematics. 
** If you lost the book, you may speak to Rolad.
* Teleport to the Taverley lodestone, run north and enter the cave by the tree patch.
* Go to the bar inside the Dwarven Tunnel and talk to Khorvak, a dwarven engineer. 
* Talk to the Dwarven Engineer on the west side of the of the Keldagrim Palace (the same one you went to earlier) for another part of the schematics.
* Assemble on any of the schematics.
* Move around (and rotate if needed) the pieces, referring to finished schematics pictured right.
* Smith a gold helmet on the anvil in the same room which requires three gold bars by using a gold bar on the anvil. 
** If you are proceeding or completed Legends' Quest.

* Prepare to fight a level 50-56 enemy, along with your gold helmet.
* Return to Dondakan, equip your gold helmet and ask him to shoot you into the rock. 
** During the cutscene, click directly on the text "Click to continue", clicking anywhere else will exit and restart the cutscene.
* Once inside the cave, do not remove the gold helmet or you will have to restart.
* Mine at least 6 gold ores, which is required to damage the enemy, and keep them in the backpack. The more ores mined (up to a maximum of 15), the lower its combat level.
* Jump-through the first wall of flames and right-click talk on the next ring of fire.
* Kill the Arzinian Avatar.
* Speak to Dondakan.
* Quest complete!

* Talk to Commander Veldaban west of the Keldagrim bank. 
** If you did not bring beer, go to the bar south of the bank prior to speaking to Commander Veldaban. Purchase 3 beer by speaking to the Barman (one to empty out).

*: You are not allowed to use weapons or armour or beasts of burden. This also means no runes, staves, etc (you can use food, prayer, rings of recoil, already summoned familiars, a pickaxe or hatchet removed from your tool belt, or even a dismantled godsword).
* Climb down the ladder and wait for him to appear to begin the fight.
* Defeat him three times and either kill him the fourth time or let yourself be defeated. (You will not die).
* Talk to Thorvald to receive his vote.

* Speak to Peer the Seer, who can be found south-west of the market in Rellekka.  or  if you've completed the easy Fremennik achievements
* To enter his house, you must solve a simple riddle. Possible answers include: "tree", "time", "life", "mage", "fire", "wind", "mind" and "disk".
* Enter the building and climb the ladder.
** Study the unicorn's head for an old red disk.
** Study the bull's head for a wooden disk.
** Search the bookcase for a red herring.
** Open then search the eastern chest for an empty jug.
** Open then search the south-west cupboard for an empty bucket.
* Use the red herring on the cooking range to get sticky red goop.
* Use the goop on the wooden disk to get a second red disk. 
* Go down the eastern trapdoor and use the two disks on the abstract mural for a vase lid.
* Climb the ladder.
** Use the empty jug on the tap, then the full jug on the empty bucket.
** Use the empty jug on the tap again and fill the bucket. You'll have a full bucket and a 1/3rds full jug.
** Use the full bucket on the drain to get an empty bucket. Or search the cupboard again.
** Use the 1/3rds full jug on the empty bucket.
** Use the empty jug on the tap, then use the full jug on the 1/5ths full bucket to get a 4/5ths full bucket.
** Use the 4/5ths full bucket on the northwestern chest to receive a vase.
** Use the vase on the tap.
** Use the vase lid on the vase of water to get a sealed vase.
* Use the sealed vase on the frozen table to receive a frozen key.
* Use the frozen key on the range, then go down the eastern trapdoor again and out the exit. You will receive Peer the Seer's vote.

* Talk to Brundt the Chieftain in the longhall in Rellekka.
* Congratulations, quest complete!

* Talk to Eluned in Isafdar and agree to get teleported. 
* Talk to Arianwyn in Lletya. If you leave the town, the fastest way back is to use the crystal teleport seed you were given.

* Make your way to Arandar. Some ways of getting there are;
** Teleporting to the World Gate using the Sixth-Age circuit or teleporting to rune dragons with five metallic dragon trinkets.
** Heading to the entrance on the Kandarin side.
** Exiting Lletya and heading north on the Tirannwn side.
** Using a Traveller's necklace to the Outpost and running west.
** Using Home Teleport to Eagles' Peak lodestone and running south.
* Kill a mourner. Pick up all pieces of the mourner outfit including the gas mask and mourner letter.
**You may now want to unequip and bank any combat equipment as you will not need it to progress the quest any longer.
* Read the letter.
* Go to Taverley and talk to Tegid at the southern lake, south of Jatix.
* Search the laundry basket near him to steal the soap. 
* Use it on the bloody mourner top with a bucket of water in your backpack.
* Return to Lletya with your crystal teleport seed.
* Talk to Oronwen in the clothing shop, talk again. 
** Be sure to bring your bear fur and silk. Kill a grizzly bear just west of Lletya if you need bear fur.
** This is an opportune time to trade with her and buy dyes while she is fixing the trousers. It is highly recommended you purchase at least 3 of each.
* After one minute has elapsed, talk to her again for the trousers. 
** If your backpack is full, they will be dropped on the floor.

* Unequip everything except the mourner suit and gas mask, head to the the Mourners' headquarters (north-east corner inside of West Ardougne).
** If you cannot enter the headquarters, re-equip your mourner suit.
* Descend the trapdoor and talk to the Head Mourner in the south-east room of the basement. 
* Talk to the gnome on a rack in the west room. 
* Use a feather on him twice with the toad crunchies in your backpack.
* Talk to the gnome again with a mahogany log and leather in your backpack.
* Release him.
* After one minute has elapsed, talk to the gnome again for a fixed device. If he disappeared, simply lobby.

* Travel to the Feldip Hills (fairy ring ).
** Fetch an ogre bellows from Rantz's cave if you need one. If you already have one, you won’t be able to obtain another from the chest.
* Go to the small swamp slightly south-west of Rantz and make the coloured toads.
** Do not fill up your ogre bellows, make sure it is empty. If you need to empty it, bloat toads until it is empty before following the next steps.
** Use the bottle of dye on your ogre bellows.
** Use your ogre bellows on a swamp toad.
** Repeat the process for each bottle of dye.
** (it is highly recommended that you make multiple of each toad).
* Teleport to the Ardougne lodestone, and head to where Brumty's sheep roam to the west.
* Use a toad matching the colour of the nearby sheep on the fixed device in your backpack, equip it.
** If you are unsure of the colour of the sheep, you can examine it for a description of the colour (red tinge, green tinge, blue tinge, yellow tinge).
* Open the equipment tab and fire the fixed device. (Get out of firing mode to see which direction your character is looking at. This way you can avoid having to struggle with finding the sheep with the arrows.)
* Use the arrows to aim at a sheep and then press the middle "FIRE!" button once it is in the middle of the screen.
* Do that for the three other sets of sheep, making sure to match the colour of the toad to the colour of the sheep.
** If done correctly, you will no longer be able to prod the sheep.
* Go back to West Ardougne and take a rotten apple from the ground west of the headquarters, if you don't have one.
* Return to the Head Mourner and talk to him.

* Talk to Elena, who lives slightly north-east of Ardougne Castle.
* With a rotten apple in your inventory, talk to her again.
* Wait one minute or world-hop, then talk to her again.

* Go to the fenced-in apple orchard Northwest of Ardougne, west of the combat training camp.
* Take an empty barrel, use it on the Rotten Apple Pile.
* Then use the Apple Barrel located in the middle of the orchard to make apple barrel.
** If you don't already have a barrel of naphtha, take one more empty barrel.

* Skip this section if you have an extra barrel of naphtha from Regicide.''
** Return to Isafdar, head to the Poison Waste a few steps south of the Tirannwn lodestone.
** Fill your barrel with coal-tar.
** Go to the fractionation still in Rimmington outside of the chemist's house.
** Use the barrel of coal-tar on the still.
** Rotate the tar regulator clockwise twice (don't do a complete rotation), to make the tar flow at maximum. The 'pressure' indicator on the left should go up.
** When the pressure enters the green region, rotate the pressure valve clockwise once to let out some pressure. This should stall the pressure indicator.
** Start adding coal. This raises the 'heat' indicator on the right. If it's below the green region, add more coal. If it's above, don't add coal until it gets lower.
*** If the heat reading reaches the dark orange portion, you've spoiled your compound and must start again.
*** If you run out of coal, your progress will be saved, but you will have to re-set the pressure to add more coal to it.
** Exit the interface once the green bar is full.

* Use the apple mix on your sieve. This was given to you by Elena when she identified the toxin.
* Use the toxic naphtha on a cooking range to get 2 toxic powder. A range can be found in the Mourner Headquarters.

* Proceed to Thorgel in the temple. Do not teleport out of the room to the death altar until rotating the red beam back the way it started, or else the light door will be locked on return.

* Investigate the energised pillar (east multi-coloured 4-beam pillar).
* Talk to Arianwyn.
* (Epilepsy warning about 2s duration) Use the crystal trinket on the energised pillar.
* Talk to Arianwyn. 
** Speak to Arianwyn again if you need a death talisman.
* Enter the death ruins.
* Remember the following steps and do them quickly, or you'll have to try again:
** Talk to Thorgel to become energised. 
*** He is south of the altar, and does not appear as a yellow dot on the minimap.
** Exit the altar.
** Pass the door of light.
** Rotate the first pillar of light mirror by the stairs.
** Go up the first stairs and immediately take the stairs to your left (north).
** Run all the way east then south to the large crystal and investigate it. (If it speaks, you were not fast enough and have to go back to Thorgel.)
** Run back down the stairs and touch the energised pillar. (If you don't get transported, you were not fast enough.)

* Once inside, search the dead slave on the ground.
* Chop, then fix the eastern crystal tree with the blue light beam.
* Solve the puzzles by reflecting the light beams to the opposite coloured receivers. You only have one receiver available at a time.
*: For example: if the receiver in the end is yellow and since the opposite of yellow is blue (refer to the colour wheel), you need to direct the blue light beam to the yellow receiver. Due to how mirrors reflect, you often have to reroute, just keep trying different paths for the quickest solution.
*: Refer to the in-depth guide if you cannot figure it out.
** Redirect the blue light to the yellow receiver. This enables the red light.
** Redirect a combination of red and blue light to the green receiver. This enables the green light.
** Redirect a combination of blue and green light to the red receiver.
** Redirect all three colours to the colourless receiver. When done all receivers on the western wall will be white. See below for example solutions.

* Now is your last chance to inquire about saving the Gnome, if you intend to (it's completely optional).
* Return to Arianwyn in Lletya and give him the report.
* Quest complete!
