* If you needed to leave to obtain items, teleport to Al Kharid, go north, talk to Captain Dalbur to glide to the Tree Gnome Stronghold, then talk to Daero at Blurberry's Bar to return to the hangar, Waydar to return to Crash Island , and then Lumdo to return to Ape Atoll . 
* If you didn't need to leave to obtain items, go to the area where you first landed on Ape Atoll. There is a one-way shortcut south of Garkor.
* Travel west until you see a dungeon on your mini-map. Climb down.

* Run through the long dungeon. 
** Protect from Melee is highly recommended here, as are antipoison and energy potions. Make sure to have several pieces of food (and/or Enhanced Excalibur) for healing from the traps and mobs.
* At the end of the dungeon (the most north-eastern part), speak to Zooknock first.
* Use the gold bar on Zooknock.
* Use the monkey dentures on Zooknock.
* Use the monkeyspeak amulet mould on Zooknock. He will give you an enchanted bar and your mould back.
** If you use the monkey bones on him here you don't need to get new ones when turning in the talisman. Monkey bones from the monkey zombies in the cave do not work. Keep your monkeyspeak amulet mould as it used in Do No Evil.
** Make sure you finish the dialogue after giving him the three items and the bones; otherwise, you will not receive the enchanted bar and your mould back. If you leave the area, you will have to run all the way back through this cave to finish the dialogue to get the enchanted gold bar.

* Return to Marim (Ape Atoll) (protect from missiles and surge to gate).
* Escape prison and run east into the temple.
* Take the southern ladder up, the eastern ladder down, and then the trapdoor down into the dungeon.
** Alternatively, you can kill one of the two gorilla guards blocking the trapdoor and climb down that way.
* Use the enchanted bar on a pillar of fire and use the amulet on a ball of wool to create an monkeyspeak amulet.
* Go to the banana garden west of the prison.
* Wait for the monkey's aunt to leave and quickly go into the garden through the corridor at its north-east corner.
* When she returns, run back into the corridor.
** You can stay in the area with red monkey knife fighters if the guards are called and climb the ladder to the south up and back down again.
* Equip the monkeyspeak amulet, talk to the monkey child, and talk to him again .
* Talk to Monkey child again. 
* You will have to wait for The Monkey's Aunt to pass by the child once again before the child gives you the Monkey talisman.
** If you're obtaining multiple for Recipe for Disaster: Freeing King Awowogei, Do No Evil or Monkey butler then repeat the same step as before then speak to the Monkey child again. 
* Take your monkey bones and Monkey talisman and use it on Zooknock at the end of the dungeon under Ape Atoll. 
** Make sure to make the standard Monkey greegree for the next steps as other forms will not work.
*** Bring other monkey bones and multiple talismans if you want to make more greegrees and  then use your Monkey talisman and different types of monkey bones on Zooknock. 
**** You can use multiple greegrees on each other to save bank space.
* Watch the cutscene. Talk to Zooknock to receive your greegree.

* During this section, do not teleport while you're carrying the monkey or you will have to re-obtain the monkey. This includes spirit tree teleportation.
* Enter Ardougne Zoo and equip your greegree near the monkey zone. Speak to the monkey minder.
** If you have other monkeys types on your monkey greegree, make sure to swap it to the Karamjan monkey (brown with red cap). Otherwise the monkey minder will say to you that you aren't getting anywhere near his monkeys.
* Talk to an unattackable monkey. Unequip the greegree and talk to the monkey minder again.
* Run to the Grand Tree and talk to Daero, then Waydar,  and finally Lumdo.
* Equip the greegree, pass through the gates.
* Return to Garkor by the kings palace (as a monkey) and speak to him.
* Talk to the elder guard west of Garkor, they will say you need permission from Kruk.
* Head west from the main gate, walk round and up the hill and then cross the bridge to end up on the other side of the hill.
* Talk to Kruk, who will grant you an audience with Awowogei.
** You may need to talk to Garkor, then with the Elder Guard outside of the throne room first.
* Inside the throne room, talk to Awowogei.
* Talk to him again to give him the rescued monkey.
* Talk to the southern Elder Guard to exit the throne room.
* Talk to Garkor, this will start a cutscene.
* Talk to Garkor again after the cutscene for the 10th squad sigil.

* Right-click 10th squad sigil teleport when you are ready to kill Jungle Demon.
** If you rub the sigil with your greegree equipped and with a full inventory, your greegree will drop on the ground.
* Kill the Jungle demon.
** Prayer flicking between Protect from Melee and Magic (or Deflect Melee and Magic) can prevent most damage. Begin on Protect From Melee, and as the demon begins the animation for the magic attack swap to Protect from Magic, then wait for the hit and switch back to Protect from Melee. Otherwise, remain on Protect from or Deflect Magic.
* Speak to King Narnode in the Grand Tree. 
* Quest complete!

* Teleport to Karamja (shortest teleport is ) and run far south/southeast to the southeast corner of Shilo Village. 
* Speak to Mosol Rei near the Broken cart. He will give you a wampum belt.
* Teleport to the Karamja lodestone and run southeast to Trufitus, northeast of Tai Bwo Wannai Village, west of the hardwood grove.
* Use the belt on Trufitus. Tell him you're going to search for "Ah Za Rhoon". 
** If you don't yet have a chisel, a rope and torch, you should get those now from Jiminua's Jungle Store. You may also craft bronze wire at the nearby anvil.

* Travel east of Trufitus' hut, cross a wooden log and then head south to the mound of earth surrounded by three dead trees, Ah Za Rhoon.
* Search the mound of earth and select excavate. 
* Use a lit torch on the fissure.
** To obtain a lit torch, light the torch in the backpack.
* Use a rope on the fissure.
* Search the fissure, climb down.

* Search the cave in (see map) and wiggle through the rocks to proceed to the second area. 
* After wiggling through, follow along the west side of the wall and search the loose rocks against the northwestern wall for a tattered scroll. 
** You might fail and take damage, retry until you succeed.
* Search the old sacks in the far southeast corner for a crumpled scroll.
* Search the ancient gallows to the north for the Zadimus corpse. 
* Read both scrolls.

* Use the Karamja lodestone/Tai Bwo Wannai teleport to get back to Trufitus.
* Use the two scrolls and the corpse on Trufitus and ask about the sacred ground. 
* Walk west to the nearby Tribal Statue. Bury the corpse then talk to the Spirit of Zadimus for the bone shard.
* Use the bone shard on Trufitus. 
* Talk to Trufitus. Ensure Trufitus mentions the need to find the Tomb of Bervirius.

* Head southwest to Cairn Isle by climbing the rocks and going across the bridge. Be careful, you can sometimes fall - use the Surge ability to bypass this.
* Search the well stacked rocks to the north to enter the Tomb of Bervirius. If you fail search again until you are able to enter. 
* Inside, run south and search the tomb dolmen to receive three items: sword pommel, locating crystal, and Bervirius notes. 
** If you do not have enough space the notes will drop on the ground.
* Read all 3 options on the Bervirius notes.
* Use the chisel on the sword pommel to create bone beads (the chisel on the tool belt will not work).
* Use the bone beads on the bronze wire to create beads of the dead.
** You can make the bronze wire from a bronze bar at an anvil near Trufitus.

* Travel east of Trufitus' hut, over the agility log and run north, to the general area of The Shaikahan.
* Search the foliage, then attempt to open the Ancient Door. (See the map for the location.)
* Use a chisel on the bone shard.
* Equip the beads of the dead.
* Use the bone key on the door to open it.
* Open the ancient metal gate. 
* Climb down the rock.
* Run to the south west corner and use 3 bones on the tomb doors. Be careful not to bury them instead.
* Open the doors and search the tomb dolmen.
* Kill all 3 forms of Nazastarool. The stalagmites to the east of the tomb dolmen can be used as a safe spot.
* Search the tomb dolmen again for a Rashiliyia corpse.

* Travel back to the Tomb of Bervirius on Cairn Isle.
* Use the Rashiliyia corpse on the tomb dolmen.
* Quest complete!

* Speak to an examiner in the Exam Centre. 
** Teleport to the Archaeology Campus by using the archaeology journal and run south-east.
* Talk to Seth Minas (site manager) in Archaeology Guild. Make sure you have the unstamped letter otherwise the dialogue with Seth does not progress.
* Grab a cup of tea from the desk in the south side of the building. It is behind Acting Guildmaster Reiniger or Drew (depends on your progress). Not required if you have one.
* Talk to an examiner in the Exam Centre; you will fail the exam.

* Search the green bushes to the west of the Monolith in the middle of the Archaeology Campus (not the ones to the south, near the fences) until you find a teddy bear.
* Take the panning tray from the small building south of the screening station.
* Pan the water to the east of where you found the panning tray. Someone will try to stop you. Give him the cup of tea to pan the water. 
** Pan until you find a special cup. 
** Pan until you find an uncut opal if you have not already.
* Pickpocket the Dig Site workman in the north-east corner of the dig site until you get an animal skull.
* Talk to Katarina (student) in the central area of the dig site.
* Talk to her again.
* Run south-east, talk to Dorian (student).
* Talk to him again.
* Run west, talk to Eduardo (student) who can be found in the dig spot closest to the well.
* Talk to him again.

:If the answer choices for the below options are not listed, you need to give the students their respective digsite finds, the cup, animal skull, and teddy bear before proceeding.
* Return to an examiner. 
* Talk to all 3 students again.
* Return to an examiner. 
* Talk to all 3 students again.
**Katarina will demand an opal (talk to her again). You can obtain this by panning.
* Return to an examiner. 
* Optional: Give Seth Minas (site manager) the level 1, 2 and 3 certificates to receive a Fruit Blast or a chocolate cake. The Fruit Blast can be saved for the quest Recipe for Disaster: Another Cook's Quest.

* Excavate the area on the ground named level 3 grid (near Dorian at the east digsite, see image) until you find an ancient talisman. It may take over 40 attempts to get it.
* Talk to Terry Balando back at the Exam Centre.
* Go to the north-eastern winch (a square hole in the ground with a rope going down it), at a dig site north from Dorian. You will also find Elissa wandering nearby and a training grid near the winch.
* Operate the winch three times to hand in your invitation, attach a rope, and climb down.
* Pick up an arcenia root. One is directly to the east of the rope and another is west of the rope, under a torch on the wall. You may use Area Loot to pick them up.
* Search the bricks south-east of the rope. 
* Climb back up, then climb down the winch near Katarina to the southwest.
* Talk to Doug Deeping to receive a chest key.

* Optional: Search the sack for an extra charcoal. Do not grind it. You will need it for Desert Treasure, but cannot get it from here after completing the quest.
* Go back to the northeastern winch and climb down, use the key to unlock the chest in the north east room and search it for ammonium nitrate.
* Use the trowel on the closed barrel directly east of the chest.
* Use a vial on the barrel.
* Grind the charcoal.
** If you didn't bring charcoal, search the sack of charcoal a few steps north.
* Mix the nitroglycerine and ammonium nitrate together, add ground charcoal, then finally add the arcenia root.
* Search the bricks to the south and select the compound on the brick.
* Search the brick again, select your tinderbox.
* Enter the large chamber, take the stone tablet.

* Use the tablet on Terry Balando in the Exam Centre.
* Quest complete!

* Speak to Golrie in the Gnome Village Dungeon. (Note: If you run into a bug where you can't click the X to close the letter without it moving your character, right-click on the X and click "Close" or press "Esc" on your keyboard to close the note.)
* After asking what is next, you will be transported to the surface for a conversation with Golrana.
* Talk with Golrana inside the Gnome Village.
* Teleport to Castle Wars (or follow Elkoy out of the maze) and head to the highlighted area north of the Observatory and south of the Ourania altar (just north-east of the crystal tree). Make sure to pass the Observatory on its eastern side, alternatively use a 'Chipped' Watchtower teleport to teleport directly there.
* Make sure to dismiss your pet/follower. Talk to Golrana.  
* Walk up the path north-west until you reach a large dead tree. Search it, then climb-through it.
* Investigate the ledge on the south end of the chasm (the wall near the rocks at the south of the room), continue the conversation with Golrana, she then will cross the chasm and throw a rope for you to cross.
**If you encounter a bug in which Golrana disappears, simply re-log and continue from two steps prior.
* Move south and continue through the cave by jumping across gaps.
* Travel north-west until reaching a water stream with stepping stones, but do not cross yet.
* Before crossing the set of stepping stones, investigate the small crevice in the south wall to your immediate east.
* Golrana will enter the crevice and emerge on the other side, she then will move a stone for you to complete the jumping part.
* Cross the stepping stones, head southwest until you reach a crevice, then climb-through and out of the cave.
* Go west to the ledge overlooking Lletya and investigate the sturdy tree, then climb-down it.

* After a cutscene, take the handwritten book on the crate next to you and read it.
* Search all crates, lamps, shelves and the picture in the room. You will be notified when you have gathered everything in the room.
* Build the crate at the desk north of the ladder, then calibrate it.
* Note down the number and colour value for all three.
* Use the calculator below to get a working pair of shapes for each of the three value pairs. Note down the pair of shapes for each.

* Once you sing all 6 desired shapes, calibrate the device then insert the correct shapes into their corresponding slots.
* Click the green tick mark at the bottom to complete the puzzle.

* Climb up the ladder and talk to Golrana underneath the steps just to the east of Lletya centre. (If you teleport to Lletya instead of leaving via the ladder, she will not appear. You can return to the lab from a trapdoor in the sheep pen in the northwest Lletya.)
* Once back up on the ledge, walk past the large boulder to the east, and Golrana should spot an air vent.
* Open the air vent on the rock wall just south of the boulder, then climb-down it.
* After the cutscene Climb-up the stairs just next to you.
* Head east to the prison and rotate the watcher once.
* Enter the prison through the metal doors. Talk to the guard. 
* Pick-lock on the northwest cell door. Talk to Bolrie. 
* Lead Bolrie out of the jail and west to the corridor behind the stairs you just came up.
* Continue through the door in the end and watch the cutscene.
* After the cutscene, stand north of the big boulder and push it southward to block the air vent.
* Talk to the gnomes for a cutscene.
* Talk to them again to watch a second cutscene.
* Quest complete!

* Speak to Sir Owen in the garden north of the Edgeville Monastery. 
* Talk to Saradomin after the cutscene. 
*Alternatively if aligned with another god. 
* Pick up the suit of armour just south-west of you and equip it.
* Talk to Saradomin.

There are multiple possibilities, choice-wise, to get through this. The list below is just a recommended choice order.
* Open the Portcullis.
* Fortress guard: (guaranteed suspicion on first chat option)
** It is required to dismiss pets and familiars before proceeding. 
* Head north, to Lieutenant York: 
* Head north-west, and climb up staircase. The fortress guard will stop you. 
* Head to the to the south, talk to Hierophant Marius. 
* Head south-east of the room, and climb up staircase. The fortress guard will stop you. 
* Go upstairs, head north to Lieutenant Graves. 
* Search the Lieutenant's body, and choose whether you want to kill him or not. It doesn't matter.

* Head up the stairs in the north-east to the ritual chamber. 
* Search the wardrobe for a Letter from Lord Daquarius.
* Search the box of candles for three red candles.
* Search the shelf for chalk.
* Pick up the Grimoire and read it. 
* Use a candle on each stand, and fix the symbol on the floor. 
* Light the candles.
* Use chalk on Ritual circle.

Note: The below incantations must be said in the order as they are written.
* Chant over the north-west candle. 
* Chant over the north-east candle. 
* Chant over the south-east candle. 
* Enter the portal. 
** You must remove the suit of armour that was equipped at the beginning of the quest.

* Head south, to the Wand of Resurrection.
* Solve the puzzle by matching the tiles to lower the barrier.
** The image of the completed puzzle is taken with the compass facing south.
* Try to take the wand. A chat option appears. Select offer to risk your life.

* Head north. Talk to Dawn. 
* Defeat the Black Knights and Sir Owen.
* Go north and open the portcullis.
* Kill Dawn. Refer to the full guide if you're having trouble.

* Search Dawn's body.
* Head south, enter the Portcullis and speak with Saradomin. 
* When Saradomin asks if the player wants to be teleported back to Edgeville, it is recommended to stay in the tombs, to claim the extra post-quest rewards which require level 40 Strength and two other coffins requiring level 60 and 80 Strength.
* Quest complete!

* Recharge your prayer if you have fewer than 470 points.
* Talk to Pirate Pete, north of Port Phasmatys. 
** If you have the ectophial it will place you close to Pirate Pete.

* Note: If at any point you leave the area you can return via Pirate Pete. 
* Complete the dialogue with Captain Braindeath. He gives you a blindweed seed.
* Run south and Climb-down a Wooden Stair.
* Run south to the farming patches.
* Rake the south-easternmost Blindweed Patch (the only one which isn't labelled as 'trashed').
* Use the seed on the patch.
* Pick the blindweed once grown (can take up to 5 minutes).
* Return to and Talk to Captain Braindeath.
* In the south-east corner of the building, Climb-up the Ladder.
* In the north-west corner, Deposit at the Hopper (1 tile east of the Pressure Barrel).

* Talk to Captain Braindeath, he'll give you an empty bucket if you don't already have one.
* Go to the bridges to the west and Open the Gate.
** Optional: Wear your ring of charos to distract 50% Luke.
** If no ring just click Open and your character will distract him.
* Continue north and up the mountain to the Stagnant Lake.
* Fill at the Stagnant Lake.
* Deposit at the Hopper from earlier (keep the empty bucket for later).

* Return to Captain Braindeath. He will give you a Fishbowl and net
** If you accidentally Untangle the fishbowl, just Use the bowl on the net to re-tangle them.
* Fish a total of 5 sluglings and/or karamthulhu near the farming patches (a mix of 5 will work).
* Use all 5 on the Pressure Barrel next to the Hopper.
* Pull the lever.

* Return to Captain Braindeath. He will give you a wrench.
* Enter the western room and Talk to Davey to get the holy wrench.
* Right-click Use the wrench on the brewing control to the east (the object shaking crazily).
* Kill the evil spirit.
* Return to Captain Braindeath.
* Climb-down the nearby ladder to the south-west.
* With slayer gloves equipped, kill a fever spider and take its body. 
** Slayer gloves are not required with high life points or when safespotting the spider behind a crate (with Magic/Ranged/Necromancy)
* Deposit at the hopper.
* Return to Captain Braindeath.
* With an empty bucket, turn the Output Tap (south of the machinery) to receive unsanitary swill.

* Talk to Captain Donnie near the farming patches.
* Return to Captain Braindeath.
* Quest complete!

* Travel to Port Phasmatys.
* Talk to Bill Teach in the inn. 
* Run to the dock and cross the gangplank to board the eastern-most ship.
* Talk to Bill Teach.

* Search the repair locker, take 4 ropes.
* Search the Gun Locker, take 1 fuse.
* Climb-up the ship's ladder.
* Climb the climbing net next to the central mast.
* Use rope from the backpack on the hoisted sail on the ship you are on.
** The same actions of climbing and using the rope are used to change ships every time.
* Add fuse on the powder barrel on the eastern ship.
* Light the fuse (you may fail and have to retry).
* Climb the climbing net and use the rope on the hoisted sail as before.
* Talk to Bill.

* Climb-down the ship's ladder.
* Search the repair locker and take:
** 30 tacks
** 6 planks
** 3 swamp paste
* For each of the three leaks in the hull:
** Fill the ship hull.
** Waterproof the ship hull.
* Climb-up the ship's ladder and talk to Bill.
** Be sure to finish all the dialogue, or else you won't be able to proceed.

* Board the other ship (climb and use rope as before).
* Climb-down their Ship's ladder.
* Plunder the closed chest for 5 plunder.
* Return to your ship (climb and use rope as before).
* Climb-down your ship's ladder.
* Store-plunder on the plunder storage.
* Return to and talk to Bill.

* Climb-down the ship's ladder.
* Search the gun locker for a cannon barrel.
* Repair the broken cannon on the top deck.
* Talk to Bill.
* Search the gun locker and take:
** Ramrod.
** Some fuses (take 3 in case of failure).
** Some cannon canisters (take 3 in case of failure).
* Climb-up the ship's ladder.
* Prepare and fire the cannon. If you miss you will need to repeat these steps.
** If you make a mistake, you can empty-out the cannon. You will still need to clean it with the ramrod (final instruction).
** Take-powder from the powder barrel next to the cannon on the deck.
** Use gunpowder on the cannon.
** Then the ramrod.
** Then a canister.
** Then a fuse.
** Fire! the cannon. Check your chat log to see if you hit or not.
** Use the ramrod on the cannon again to clean it.
* Talk to Bill.
* Return to the gun locker and take:
** At least 5 cannon balls.
** At least 5 fuses.
** 2 cannon barrel (the cannon may blow up).
* Fire the cannon as before, substituting the canister for a cannon ball, until you put three holes in the enemy's ship. 
* Quest complete!
* Talk to Bill to claim another reward.

* Speak to the Zealot, north of the mine west of Burgh de Rott. 
* Pickpocket Zealot to get Zealot's key.
* Climb over the cart to the south and crawl-down the cart tunnel.

* Run directly west through the cave and crawl-through the cart tunnel.
* Re-enter the cave via the southern entrance.
* Descend the nearby ladder to the east.
* Go down the ladder directly east.
* Go down the south ladder (beware of the moving cart — follow it as it moves south and step off the track when you can).

* Pick a glowing fungus (J).
* Use the glowing fungus on the mine cart (K).
* Check points settings (L).
* Compare your tracks to the correct version (pictured in bright red). Remember the letters where the track needs to be changed. Pull the levers at (M) and (N) so that the bright red arrows match. (You can also examine the levers to find the corresponding letter).

* Return to (L) and check points settings. Click start.
* If you fail and manage to put the mine cart in water, you will need to pick another glowing fungus to put into the mine cart.
* Your character will say "I wonder if that cart is anywhere useful now?" when the puzzle is complete.
* Make your way back to the very first cave room, by backtracking or teleporting out and coming back.
** You can use the Drakan's medallion or games necklace for quicker access if you have it, to teleport to Burgh de Rott. Otherwise continue with the instructions in this section.
** Go up the ladder by the glowing fungus spawn.
** Go north past the haunted cart, then the first wing east, climb up the ladder.
** Go west, climb up the ladder.
** Go west and exit the cave.
** Enter the northern cave.

* Go down the nearby ladder, just to the east.
* Go north-east and down the ladder by the doors.
* Go west and down the ladder in the north-west corner.
* Search the cart just south to get the fungus.

* With the fungus, go back up the ladder.
* Run east, go past the ladder going up, and go down the ladder (beware of the moving cart).
* Run south (on the east path when it splits) and use Zealot's Key on water valve (P).
* Go down the lift directly south of the water valve.
* You should fall into a chamber full of water. From the flooded chamber, walk south onto the track and follow it to the east. Walk down the stairs.
* Go directly west and through the door.
* Try to pick up the innocent looking key to the west, sitting on the crate just north of the crane.
* Kill Treus Dayth.
* Pick up the key.
** Optional: Add it to the steel key ring if you have it.

* Walk up the stairs you came from (in the east room).
* Walk down the stairs to the far west.
* Open the large door.
* Cut a piece of crystal outcrop.
* Quest complete!
** [Optional] If you want extra salve amulets you can mine multiple crystals.
** [Optional] First mine a mithril ore vein to the near the large doors on cave level 2 for an achievement.
*** You can get there by backtracking. Up the lift, then up the ladder to the north, then up the ladder to the north again. Through both large doors to the West and the vein is immediately north.

* Choose the 'talk to' option on Lokar Searunner on Rellekka's westernmost dock. 
* Speak to Brundt the Chieftain in the Longhall for a seal of passage. 
** You will need to keep the seal on you while on the island. Talking to anyone without it will teleport you back to Rellekka.
* Return and talk to Lokar. 
* Climb the ladder and board the pirate ship. Talk to Captain Bentley about sailing to Lunar Isle. 
* Climb down the central ladder.
* Below deck, talk to 'Bird's-Eye' Jack to the south-west.
* Talk to Captain Bentley again. 
* Return to 'Birds-Eye' Jack again.

* Must talk to them in this order.
** Talk to 'Eagle-eye' Shultz at the very front of the ship (back upstairs).
** Talk to 'Beefy' Burns on the lowest level of the ship.
** Talk to 'Lecherous' Lee on the very top level, at the south end of the ship.
** Talk to First mate 'Davey-boy' on the southern end of the deck near the stairs. 
** Climb up to the top level at the south end of the ship and talk to the cabin boy (2 inventory spaces required). He is next to Lecherous Lee.

* Use the lens on the lantern. Light it.
* Use the lantern on the following objects and rub away the symbols:
** Cannon: Climb the ladder in the middle. The cannon is on the middle level at the south end of the ship. 
** Wallchart: Climb back up and enter the southernmost room. The wallchart is on the northwestern wall.  
** Chest: Climb down to the lowest level of the ship. The chest is on the ground at the northern end of the ship, just as you come down.  
** Barrel: On the same level, the most southern stack of three barrels.  
** Support: Same level big support column in the middle of the ship.  
* Talk to Captain Bentley.

* Climb down the ladders and walk into the city (there will be a small cutscene).
* Go north-east outside the city and kill suqah until these items are obtained:
** One suqah tooth.
** 4 suqah hides.
** If not already in the backpack, one grimy guam and one grimy marrentill. Clean the herbs.
* Mine a lunar ore at the mine north-east of the city. Climb down the ladder and mine a stalagmite to the West of the rune essence rock. It looks like a rock jutting out of the ground.
**Optional: Mine Rune Essence to complete Runes on the Moon, which is a Hard Fremennik achievement.
* Run to the south-east part of the island. Talk to the Oneiromancer near the astral altar.
* Return to the city and enter the walking house in the northern section. Talk to Baba Yaga (1 inventory space required). 
* Use the vial on the sink.
** Add a guam and a marrentill to the vial of water.
** Grind the suqah tooth and use it on the vial to complete the potion.
* Return to the Oneiromancer with the potion.

* Use your dramen staff/staves on the following altars in the listed order (you may need talismans to access if you do not have alternate teleports):
** Air (west of Varrock)
** Fire (north of Al Kharid)
** Water (Lumbridge Swamp)
** Earth (south of Fort Forinthry)
* Before returning to the isle, smelt the lunar ore at any regular furnace and make a lunar helmet at a regular anvil.
* Travel back to Lunar Isle by selecting "travel" from Lokar Searunner in Rellekka at the westernmost dock.
* Travel with Captain Bentley to Lunar Isle.
* Give a lunar staff to the Oneiromancer.

* If you have already made the lunar helm, you can skip the next 4 steps.
** Climb down ladder north-eastern part of the isle.
** Mine a stalagmite for a lunar ore.
** You have to use a furnace to smith the ore (the forge in the southern building will not work).
** Use an anvil to make the helm, such as the one in the southern building.

* Talk to Pauline Polaris in the north-western-most building in the city. Choose the correct answer "Jane Blud-Hagic-Maid". The answers are randomly ordered.
* Talk to Meteora south in the city.
* Kill Suqahs until one drops a special tiara. If you haven't already, pick up their hide as well as you'll need four hides later on.
* Give Meteora the tiara.
* Talk to Rimae Sirsalis in the clothing store south of the bank about ceremonial clothes. 
* Talk to Rimae Sirsalis again, she will tan your hides. 
** If you didn't bring thread, Rimae's shop sells some.
* Craft a lunar torso, trousers, gloves, and boots from your hides.

* Go to the biggest building in the city (west of the lodestone) and talk to Selene (she might be outside). 
* Exit the city and run south. Dig up near blue flowers with a spade (tool belt doesn't work), they are the flowers to the furthest south west across the bridge.

* Give the Oneiromancer all your lunar gear.
* Talk to the Oneiromancer again with 11 free inventory slots.

* Use the vial on the kindling Oneiromancer just gave you to create soaked kindling.
* Get your combat runes and supplies, dismiss your follower, and wear all your lunar items. Four backpack spaces are required.
* Do not carry an augmented crystal hatchet in the backpack to avoid a bug later in the quest.
* Run to the biggest building in the city (west of the lodestone).
* Make sure you're wearing all 8 pieces of Lunar equipment; if you exit to lobby or logout, or are not wearing them all when you add the soaked kindling, you'll have to return to the Oneiromancer to get a new kindling.
* Light the ceremonial brazier then use the Soaked kindling on it to enter Dreamland.

* Talk to Ethereal Man or Ethereal Lady.
* Step on the yellow/green platform south-west of the island.
* Talk to Ethereal Fluke.
* He will call out a number. You need to make the dice add up to the number he called. When you "roll" one of the dice, it will turn the die upside down, so each die only has two possible numbers (1 and 6, 2 and 5, 3 and 4).

* He eventually teleports you back to the middle.
* Talk to the Ethereal Man/Lady.

* Head south-east and step on the pink/purple platform.
* Talk to Ethereal Numerator.
* Click on the numbers to complete the patterns for four times.

* He eventually teleports you back to the middle.
* Talk to the Ethereal Man/Lady.

* Head north-east and step on the blue platform.
* Talk to Ethereal Perceptive. He might give you a hatchet. (Do not carry an augmented crystal hatchet in the backpack or you will be given the following message: "You do not have a hatchet which you have the Woodcutting level to use" even if you have another hatchet in the backpack or a hatchet on your toolbelt)
* Run west and chop 20 dream logs, depositing them on your log pile.
* He will teleport you once you've won the competition.
* Talk to the Ethereal Man/Lady.

* Head north-west and step on the grey platform.
* Talk to Ethereal Guide.
* Cross the chasm by jumping on the correct combination of Dream Puffs. Keep a note of the correct steps! You can use the table below to track your path: click cell to highlight it. Click again to cancel a highlight.
* Once complete, talk to the Ethereal Man/Lady.

* Head east and step on the yellow platform.
* Talk to Ethereal Expert and start the race. 
* Jump over the hurdles. If you fail three times, you will lose the race. Run and stop before each hurdle, before clicking the orb to jump over.
* After you have won talk to the Ethereal Man/Lady.

* Head south-east and step on the green platform.
* Talk to Ethereal Mimic. 
* Click on them and then copy the emote that they perform. They teleport after each correct emote.
* After five correct emotes, they'll teleport you back.

* Talk to the Ethereal Man/Lady to begin the final fight. 
* Kill Me (6,000 life points, weakness to fire spells). You can safe-spot them behind the dream tree.
** Should you forget your runes after entering the fight, you will not be able to leave the fight in any way unless you log out and back in. This will take you back to Lunar Isle where you can bank to get the runes. 
** Be sure to equip your Seal of passage before speaking to a banker. 
** Go back to the Oneiromancer again to get the kindling and potion to return back to the dream.
** Re-equip your Lunar amulet before attempting to enter the dream.

* Read the lectern to return to Lunar Isle. 
* Talk to the Oneiromancer.
* Quest complete!
* Talk to Dimintheis in the house next to the Fancy Clothes Store in south-eastern Varrock.

* Go to Gertrude's house west of Varrock and talk to Caleb, who is inside the house (although he can sometimes wander outside). 
* Talk to him again with swordfish, bass, tuna, salmon, and shrimp in the backpack to get a crest part. 
* Then ask Caleb where the rest of the crest is..

* Talk to Avan just south of the Al Kharid mine. 
* Travel to the Dwarven mines north-east of Falador. 
* Head south-west of the general store and talk to Boot.

* Travel to Witchaven, south-east of the Ardougne lodestone. Climb down the ruins just to the west of the town. Run past the hobgoblins towards the elongated room with the Ogres.
* Solve the puzzle:
** Logging out will reset this puzzle.
** Head to the northern lever located outside the room and pull it up.
** Head to the southern lever, located inside the room, and pull it up.
** Return to the northern room and pull the lever outside the room down.
** Enter the northern room and push the lever in there up.
** Leave the room and pull the one outside the northern room up.
** Go back to the southern room and pull the inside lever down.
** Now enter the room with the hellhounds.
* Mine two 'Perfect' gold ore in the hellhound room. You will continue to mine gold while being attacked by hellhounds if you turn auto-retaliate off.
* Smelt the ores into bars and then craft a 'Perfect' ring and a 'Perfect' necklace with two rubies at any furnace. There is a furnace just northwest of the Al Kharid lodestone. 
* Go back to south of the Al Kharid mine and give them to Avan.

* Talk to Johnathon on the of the Jolly Boar Inn south-west of the Fort Forinthry lodestone.
* Use an antipoison on him.

* Teleport to Edgeville and prepare for the final fight which will use multiple casts of the four blast spells. The other elemental spells do not work.
* Enter Edgeville Dungeon and run north and then west.
* Kill Chronozon when it appears.
** Chronozon must be hit with all four elemental blast spells or deathtouched dart in order to be killed, or otherwise it will return to full health when it is nearly dead. Once it has been hit with all four elemental blast spells, other types of damage can be used to kill it.
** Only the following elemental spells will work: Air Blast, Water Blast, Earth Blast, Fire Blast.
** If you use a high tier magic weapon (tier 70+), it will be very hard as you will kill him before being able to deal all 4 types of damage, therefore use a low-tier weapon (tier 30 or 40).
* Kill him and take the crest piece.

* Talk to Dimintheis.
* Quest complete!
* Talk to Dimintheis again for cooking and smelting gauntlets.

* Talk to Martin the Master Gardener in Draynor Village. 
* Talk to 5 different gardeners near farming patches around RuneScape. Easy options include:
**Frizzy, on the other side of the wall, just west of Martin. 
** Elstan, to the north of Frizzy. 
** Alain, north of Taverley lodestone. 
** Dantaera, north-west of Catherby lodestone. 
*** If you do not have secateurs yet, buy them from Vanessa's Farming Shop just to the south.
** Ellena, east of the Catherby lodestone, beside the fruit tree patch on the beach. 
* Note that:
** Spirit Tree Patch gardeners all count as the same gardener.
** The gardeners in Prifddinas won't work.
** The zombie farmer does not work.
** Head Farmer Jones in Taverley won't work.
**Wyson the gardener in Falador won't work.
**Demetrius in Wendlewick won't work.
* The fifth gardener you talk to will mention fairies.
* Talk to Martin again.

* Equip your dramen staff or lunar staff and head to the Lumbridge Swamp to enter the Lost City shed.
* Run south and talk to the Fairy Godfather (near Chaeldar, the Slayer master) about the Queen. Make sure to finish the whole dialogue.
* Run west to the bank, then go north a few steps and talk to Fairy Nuff.
* Travel to the Dark Wizards' Tower, west of Falador (use the skills necklace teleport to Crafting Guild or teleport to Port Sarim lodestone, and then run north-west).
* Climb to the top, talk to Zandar Horfyre.
** Player with low combat level should be aware of the aggressive dark wizards inside the tower.
* Teleport to Port Sarim and talk to Malignius Mortifer (just north-west of Port Sarim, pictured right) about a Tanglefoot.  or  if Swan Song has been completed.
** Talking to Malignius at the Um ritual site will not work.
* Head back to Draynor Village and enter the gates of Draynor Manor.
* Dig the gravestone directly inside the north fence of the manor, west of the gallows. It resembles a celtic cross.
* Return to Malignius.  or  if Swan Song has been started.
* Fetch the items that Malignius requested (they will be listed in your quest journal), then make your way to the Nature Spirit. Bring multiple of any edible item, or bring a filled druid pouch to ward off ghasts.
** Make sure to clean any requested herbs.
** Make sure to bring extra of any requested food items.
* Talk to the Nature Spirit in Mort Myre Swamp to receive magic secateurs.

* Return to Zanaris, then enter the shady grove (dungeon icon) west of the cosmic altar.
** You can use a cosmic altar teleport to teleport to the cosmic altar.
* Run south around the bend then north to the opening with the Tanglefoot.
* Equip your magic secateurs and kill Tanglefoot. Off-hand weaponry will work here, but will only deal as much as the secateurs would.
* Take the Queen's secateurs (area loot will not work).
* Talk to the Fairy Godfather, Next to the Slayer Master icon.
* Quest complete!

* Use any fairy ring to travel to Zanaris. If you can start the quest, you will be redirected to the Sparse Plane.
** If you cannot start the quest, enter and leave Zanaris via fairy rings repeatedly until Fairy Very Wise appears and talks to you. It may require up to 30 minutes after completing A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen. If you've declined her before, you have to travel by fairy ring to reach her.
* Talk to Fairy Very Wise and accept her offer  . After accepting her offer, Nuff's certificate is no longer needed to reach the Fairy Resistance headquarters.
* Accept the teleport from her, or use the fairy ring to get to the Fairy Resistance headquarters .
* Talk to the Fairy Queen south-east in the headquarters and then finish talking to the Tooth Fairy (she automatically speaks to you after you speak with the queen). 
* Be wary of cutscenes that may trigger epilepsy. Talk to the Tooth Fairy, then turn on the projector to watch the first briefing. 
* Talk to the Tooth Fairy again after the briefing. 
* Turn on the projector to watch the second briefing.
* End of cutscenes.
* After both briefings, agree to collect her wand. 
* Run north-west and take a hammer and secateurs from on top of the crates. You may use area loot. Use them on each other to create a tooth extractor.
* Leave through the fairy ring.

* Go to the house north-west of Zanaris bank. Use your tooth extractor on the door to pick the lock on it.
* Talk to Gnarly. 
* In no particular order, compliment him with the following responses (Only 3 compliments may be needed to continue to the next part):
** "Your enamel shimmers like a river of silver in the moonlight."
** "I've never seen such amazing, inspired and dream-like toothiness."
** "I can see your bicuspid ancestry is an example to all molar-kind."
** "You're a wonderful guard tooth with lovely cusps."
* Use the bucket of milk on him . Gnarly should jump into your inventory.
* Use the fairy rings to go back to the Fairy Resistance HQ.
* Talk to the Tooth Fairy in the south-east room, then turn on the projector.
* After the briefing, agree to the tooth extraction. 
* Step onto the yellow flowers and use the wave emote. There will be a cutscene.
* Leave through the fairy ring.

* Talk to General Bre'egth outside of the Zanaris mill, northwest of the fairy ring. 
* Talk to any other Ork about K'Chunk. 
* Run to the fairy ring, talk to Fairy Fixit about K'Chunk. 
* Teleport to and talk to K'Chunk. 
** Recommended: Bring 4 regular planks and 8 nails of any kind to fix the bridge by using a plank on the broken bridge.
** Recommended: Bring 8 willow logs if you have level 85 Firemaking, light the bonfire for K'Chunk and receive 10,000 Firemaking experience.
* Pickpocket him for the tooth.

* Teleport to .
* Head down the waterfall to talk to the Wood Dryad to the west. 
* Talk to General Gromblod.
* Talk to the Wood Dryad again.
* Teleport to .
* Pick a mango from the mango tree.
** Optional: unblock this end of the hollow log if you haven't yet.
* Return to .
* Talk to Gromblod, giving him the mango, he will spit it out about 15 tiles south of where he is standing. It does not appear as a red dot on the minimap.
* Pick up the mango with tooth and use the tooth extractor on it.

* Teleport to and talk to General Shredflesh. 
* In no particular order, calm him with the following responses:
** "What's a bit of pain for a huge ork hero like you?"
** "If the tooth isn't pulled out, all your teeth will hurt much worse!"
** "Let me pull it out! What are you, an ork or a goblin?"
** "I'll make sure it doesn't hurt a bit; I'm a professional."
* Use the extractor on him.
* Clear the pile of rock behind him if you haven't yet already.
* Go back and talk to the Tooth Fairy in the hideout.
* Turn-on the projector to watch another briefing. 
* She gives you the fairy wand.

* Prepare for the final battle, with the above listed items.
* Teleport to, , , . (If the fairy ring at does not appear, lobby and start over.)
* Look-through the fairy tree where you'll encounter a cutscene.
* After the cutscene talk to the Tooth Fairy.
* How to kill the Fairy Godfather:
** Use all 3 teeth on the farming patches.
** Stand by the patches and kill the generals and ork warriors; Prioritise any general using the drum near the rift, to stop new orks from spawning.
** Once the teeth have grown, instruct them to fight.
** Focus on ork warriors while the teeth focus on killing the generals.
** After you and the teeth kill the generals, kill the godfather.
** You must let the teeth attack the godfather to reduce the shields. Ensure all 3 teeth are attacking the godfather at once, as each one removes a layer of his 3-layer shield.
** If all 3 teeth are not attacking the godfather, you will not land hits as his shield will still be active. The melee tooth will not path around the player if you are in the way.
* Talk to the Fairy Godfather for a cutscene.
* Continue dialogue with the Fairy Queen and accept her teleport. 
* Talk to Martin the Master Gardener. 
* Quest complete!

* Talk to Commander Denulth in Burthorpe, east of the castle. 
** If Denulth tells you that the ambush is still being planned, try asking him about the White Knights first. 
* If you don't own climbing boots, buy them from Freda 
* Enter Sabbot's cave from Death Plateau and cross all the obstacles to reach the exit of the tunnel (recommended for low Defence and Constitution levels).
** Alternatively, take the shortcut by running through the Death Plateau on the surface, clockwise around it, and climbing the rocks to the northwest, then climb the cliffside while wearing climbing boots. Beware of level 67 thrower trolls - Protect from Ranged, Dive, and Fremennik round shield are advised when taking this route.
* Exit the cavern, climb the rocks to the immediate west of the exit and follow the path east over the rocks until you reach the arena entrance.

* Open the arena entrance and attempt to leave through the northern entrance.
* Defeat Dad after he attempts to attack you. You may choose to kill him or spare him after defeating him. 
** An easy way to kill Dad safely is to bring him over to the northern entrance or down by the southern rocks and safespot him.
** Very low level players may need food.

* Exit through the north arena entrance.
* Follow the path north-west, go through the cave to the north and go outside.
* Once outside, continue the path to the stronghold to the north and west; thrower trolls can be dealt with by:
** Taking agility shortcuts around them with level 47 Agility. The cliffside shortcut may be used to avoid the thrower trolls completely.
** Running counter-clockwise around the mountain, past the thrower trolls (not behind them: they are supposed to throw rocks at you automatically) to the west.
*** Protect from Ranged against them.
*** Use Dive to quickly run past them.
*** Equip Fremennik round shield to reduce their damage greatly.
* Look for a dungeon on your minimap northeast of the Troll Stronghold, and enter the cave entrance.

* Run south, go through the open wooden door, then continue north.
* Kill a troll general and take the prison key. You can safespot with magic, ranged, or necromancy behind the counter.
* Head back towards the entrance, past the door and go down the stone staircase to the north.
* Unlock the Prison Door to the immediate east and head down the stone staircase.
* Open the exit to the south and enter the secret entrance.
* Pickpocket (or kill) Twig and Berry. Safespot them inside one of the open cells if needed.
* Take the cell keys and unlock the two jail cells to free the prisoners.
* Talk to Dunstan, the blacksmith in north-eastern Burthorpe.
* Quest complete!

* To enter Port Phasmatys, either pay two ecto-tokens as an entrance fee to pass the energy barrier or charter a ship to reach the town. Each entry through the barrier, until the end of the quest, will cost two ecto-tokens.
* Equip the ghostspeak amulet. You need to equip the amulet when you talk to the ghost residents in the town.
* Talk to Velorina at Port Phasmatys, in the northernmost building just east of the entrance. 
* Talk to Necrovarus at the Ectofuntus just outside the town, to the north.
* If you do not already have a bucket of slime, obtain it now for later use in the quest.
** Open and climb down the trapdoor on the west side of the Ectofuntus to enter the basement. You do not need a bucket to obtain one.
** If you intend to proceed with the quest Vessel of the Harbinger after this quest, obtain the second one.
* Talk to Velorina.

* Teleport to Canifis lodestone. 
* If you haven't already made nettle tea, pick some nettles just east. Use the nettles on the bowl of water to get nettle-water.
* Head north-west to Netty's house which is on the east side of the Slayer Tower, talk to Netty in her house. 
* If you haven't already made nettle tea, run south of Netty's house and cut down a swamp tree for logs. Light a fire and use the nettle-water on it to get nettle tea. It is possible to accidentally boil your tea over.
* Talk to Netty to get her porcelain cup. 
* Use your nettle tea on her cup, and use your bucket of milk on it.
* Talk to Netty again. 
* Repair the model ship with the silk. Bring thread just in case.

* Go inside the shipwreck just north of Alice's farm, east of the Canifis lodestone.
* Climb the ladders to reach the top deck (there is a ladder on the outer cabin wall).

* Wait for the "wind speed" to become "low", which is shown on the top of the screen. Search the mast to determine the colours and their positions. You need to search for 3 different results, take note if needed.
* Dye the model ship with the same colours and position as the mast. Orange dye is made from red and yellow; green dye is made from blue and yellow; purple dye is made from red and blue dye. If you make a mistake when painting, simply paint over the piece again.

* Climb down a ladder and enter the captain's cabin. 
* Talk to the old man. 
* Use the key on the chest by the Captain and open it for a map scrap.
* On the of the ship, open and search all unlocked chest in the eastern end of the ship until a giant lobster spawns.
* Kill the giant lobster.
* Search the chest again for a map scrap.
* On the  of the ship, go to the northwest part of the ship's deck.
* Cross the gangplank to the rocks.
* Jump to the rocks on your side until you find a chest. Open it for another map scrap.
* Put the pieces together to get the map.

* Go back to Port Phasmatys.
* Right-click and choose "Travel (Dragontooth Island)" on the ghost captain on the south-east docks (the one with the smaller boat, not the one directly east of Velorina) to get a ride to Dragontooth Island.
* Dig with a spade at the location shown to the right to obtain the book of haricanto.
* Right-click and choose "Travel" on the ghost captain to go back Port Phasmatys.

* Talk to Ak-Haranu (who is not a ghost) around the docks. 
* Go to the inn and talk to Robin. 
* Win 4 games of Rune-Draw against him to get a signed oak longbow. The easiest method is to choose "draw" until one player loses by drawing a death rune and repeating this until you have four wins total.
** Talk to Robin every time you finish a game. 
* Talk to Ak-Haranu to get the translation manual.

* Ask the ghost innkeeper, who is located in the pub, for a job to get a bedsheet. 
** Don't give it to Robin like he asks.
* Use your bucket of slime on the bedsheet or dip it into the Pool of Slime. You cannot re-enter Port Phasmatys via charter ship if you have dipped bedsheet in the backpack.
* Talk to Gravingas west of the inn to get a petition form. 
* Wear your bedsheet.
* Ask the ghost villager for signatures until you have 10.
** You can get multiple signatures from the same ghost if you ask another ghost first.
** Some will resist. Just ask others.
** If a ghost ask for ecto-tokens, simply leave the conversation and ask the same ghost again.
* After you collected 10 signatures, remove your bedsheet. 
* Talk to Necrovarus at the Ectofuntus. Take the bone key he drops on the floor.
* Head upstairs, and use the key on the door on the south-west side. Then open the door.
* Open and search the coffin for Necrovarus' mystical robes.

* Head north-west of the Canifis lodestone and talk to Netty in her shack (east of the Slayer Tower).
* Equip the enchanted ghostspeak amulet.
* Talk to Necrovarus near the Ectofuntus. Once you have talked to Necrovarus, you will be able to enter Port Phasmatys freely. You can pass the energy barrier without needing to pay ecto-tokens.
* Talk to Velorina in northern Port Phasmatys.
* Quest complete!

* Talk to Queen Ellamaria in the garden of Varrock Palace. 
* Talk to her again to receive a trolley that is needed later. 
* Equip the ring of charos and talk to the Wise Old Man in Draynor Village. 
** Show them a range of colours so that they can come to a compromise.
** Take his generous gift even though you have no need for it.
** It's absolutely, unquestionably the most interesting thing I've ever done!
** Put on the silly helmet and jump into the cannon.
** You of course Pkmaster0036, no one could ever challenge your greatness!
** Ask me nicely and I might consider it.
** No, especially not that wise old man, who doesn't look at all suspicious.
* Thanks for your help, Wise Old Man. 
* If you don't have onion seeds, cabbage seeds or marigold seed, purchase them from Draynor Seed Market.

* Charm Lyra at the allotments near Port Phasmatys (east of the Canifis lodestone). She is located where the four watering pot icons ([[File:Farming patch map icon.png]]) are on the minimap. Accept to grow the patch of onions. 
* Plant onion seeds in allotment patch. Planting in one patch is enough, planting two increases the success rate of healthy growth. This will take about 40 minutes, so continue the quest and come back later.
** Apply compost or supercompost to allotment patch to protect the crops.

* Charm Kragen at the allotments at Manor Farm, northeast of the Ardougne lodestone. Accept to grow the cabbages. 
* Plant cabbage seeds in allotment patch. Planting in one patch is enough, planting two increases the success rate of healthy growth. This too will take about 40 minutes, so continue the quest and come back later. Rosemary must be fully grown to protect cabbage. 
** Apply compost or supercompost to allotment patch to protect the crops.

* Use cabbage-port on your explorer's ring 3 or teleport to Draynor Village lodestone and run north-west past the wall to the farming patch in Falador farm.
* Charm Elstan at the allotments north of Port Sarim and agree to grow some marigolds. 
* Plant a marigold seed in the flower patch. This will take about 20 minutes.
* Apply compost or supercompost to flower patch.
* Add water till fully grown this will take 10 to 20 minutes.
* Pick up the grown marigold. 
* Talk with Elstan and finish the dialogue. Aborting the dialogue between handing him the unnoted marigolds and receiving the seeds, you will have to grow the marigolds again.

* Go to the Edgeville Monastery. Try to take a seed from one of Brother Althric's rose bushes.
* Charm Brother Althric near the monastery rose bushes. 
* Unequip the ring of charos and use it on Edgeville's well east of the lodestone. 
* Try to take a seed from one of Brother Althric's rose bushes again.
* Talk to Brother Althric.
* Pick 4 pink, 4 white, and 4 red rose seeds (just click each type of bush once; you will pick 4 of them automatically).
* Use your fishing rod on the well and equip the ring of charos.

* Talk to Dantaera at the Catherby allotment farming patch with the ring equipped. Select all the options beginning with [Charm]. 
* Interact with the white tree on Ice Mountain west of Edgeville, select secateurs.
* Use the white tree shoot on a plant pot and water it.
* It will take 3 minutes for the shoot to turn into a White tree sapling. It is recommended to plant the tree in the Queen's Garden as soon as possible, as this will take about 6 minutes longer to grow than the other plants.

* Charm Bernald who is south of the Taverley pub. 
* Use a plant cure on his grapevines.
* Talk to Bernald again.
* Run north and talk to Alain at the tree patch. Do not charm him. 
* Use an essence on any anvil (you will find anvils walking north), grind the shards, use the rune dust on a plant cure.
* Return to Bernald.
* Use the new plant cure on his grapevines.
* Talk to Bernald.

* If you have no trolley, talk to Ellamaria in the Varrock Palace garden to receive one.
* Teleport to Lumbridge, and at the entrance of the Lumbridge Castle courtyard, use the trolley on the southern statue.
* Push the trolley east across the nearby bridge. 
** You may select the "Big-push" option to move the statue more quickly.
* Push it into the Queen's garden and use the "place" option when statue is close to the plinth, the one against the east wall. If you are not fast enough to push it and place it, it will disappear and respawn in Lumbridge.
* Teleport to Falador, and use the trolley on the statue of Saradomin south of the Falador lodestone.
* After the cutscene, push it north out the gates and onto the garden plinth using the place option again.
* If you take too long to move the statues to the plinth, they will vanish and return back to their original position.

* You can now return to the patches and collect your seeds from the farmers (if you haven't done it already)
** Orchid seed (pink) and orchid seed (yellow) from Lyra east of Canifis.
** Snowdrop seeds from Kragen north-east of Ardougne.
** Delphinium seeds from Elstan north-east of Port Sarim.
* Plant the seeds back at the garden.
** Use your buckets of compost on the nearby plantpots. If having issues with "this patch needs weeding first", use regular compost, not supercompost.
** Plant the rose seed, flower seeds, and white tree sapling in their spots.
** Plant the vine seeds in the vine patch.
** Plant the orchids in the plant pots. You may use Inspect option on a plant pot to find out what goes there.
* Wait for everything to grow which takes around 15 minutes; 20 for the White Tree if you haven't planted it yet.
* Talk to the Queen.
* Charm King Roald while equipped with the ring of charos (a). 
* Quest complete!

* Travel to Mos Le'Harmless (fairy ring if you have repaired the bridge), walk a bit north off the dock and talk to Brother Tranquillity (if you arrived via the fairy ring, run into town and he is north of the docks). 
* Bank/dismiss any pets or familiars.
* Upon arrival on Harmony Island, go through the dialogue, or Brother Tranquillity will teleport you back to Mos Le'Harmless.
* Run outside and head slightly north to the statue. Pull the statue, then climb-down statue.
* Equip your diving gear and descend the stairs.
* Run past the zombie pirates.
* Repair the stairs at the end of the tunnel, then climb them.
** If you happened to bring your planks in a plank box, be sure to remove them so you can repair the stairs.
* Climb the ladder.
* Peer-through the peephole on the wall.
* Make your way back to Brother Tranquillity on Harmony Island and speak with him.
* Travel to the Edgeville Monastery.
* Search the southern bookcase on the  of the western wing to find a prayer book.
* Read the book.
* Head back to Brother Tranquillity who teleports you to Harmony Island.

* Talk to Father Badden at Uzer, east of Shantay Pass. (Optional: take the magic carpet to Uzer)

* Go down the stairs.
** If you do not have the strange implement from The Golem quest, you can pick it up from the ground in the northwest room.
*Talk to Evil Dave wearing your three black items and your dyed Silverlight. He is standing at the entrance to Agrith Naar's demonic temple in the underground Uzer ruins.

* Talk to Denath. 
* Talk to Jennifer to get a demonic sigil mould. 
* Talk to Matthew. 
* Go to any furnace and smelt a demonic sigil.

* Talk to the clay golem outside the ruins about last night. 
* Look in the nearby Broken kilns for a book until you have found the Demonic tome (there's a broken kiln north of the Rug Merchant and one behind the walls east of the staircase that are easy to miss).
* Talk to Matthew back in the lair.
* Go north to talk to Denath and write down the incantation he tells you. 
* Complete the circle and click the sigil to chant the incantation. Be sure to remember it, as you’ll need it again later in the quest. 
* Be sure to take the sigil from the floor, or you will have to make a new one at a furnace.
* Enter the portal and take Tanya's sigil.
* Tell Evil Dave to return to the lair - you should have 4 sigils now.

* Go up the stairs, talk to Father Badden and Father Reen. 
* Talk to the golem.

* Talk to Matthew to start the incantation. 
* Chant demonic sigil and say the incantation normally. (If you have forgotten the incantation, it can be found on page 6 of the demonic tome.)
* Kill the demon with the Silverlight (dyed). After defeating it, you will have the Darklight equipped.
** You can damage the demon with any combat style, but you must equip the Silverlight (dyed) as it dies.

* Equip your catspeak amulet, have your pet cat with you, and talk to Unferth. His house is in eastern Burthorpe, south of Dunstan and east of Tam McGrubor.

* Locate Bob the Cat using the catspeak amulet.

** Click on the whiskers until the arrow and the eyes glow white.
** Run in the direction of the arrow, occasionally re-checking the amulet, until you find Bob.

* Talk to Bob.

* Ask Gertrude about Bob's parents in her house west of Varrock. 
** If Rat Catchers hasn't been started. 
* Speak to Reldo in the Varrock library. 
* Go back and talk to Bob the cat again, in the same spot you found him.

* Go to Sophanem and talk to the Sphinx. 
** Talk to Raetul and buy a full desert robe set, if you don't have them already.
* Return to Unferth's house in Burthorpe and do the following:
** Rake the patch behind his house and plant potato seeds in it. Your cat will notify you when they are done (typically 25–35 minutes to grow). A supreme growth potion from player-owned farm cannot be used to accelerate growth. It will not get disease, and it does not need composting or watering.

** Use the logs on fireplace, then light the fireplace.
** Use the chocolate cake and bucket of milk on the table.
** Make his bed upstairs.
** Give Unferth a haircut.

* Talk to the Apothecary in south-west Varrock. 
* Unequip your weapons and equip the doctors hat/nurse hat and your white robes.
* Return to Unferth with a vial of water.
* Talk to Bob the cat. If he's not at his previous location, locate him again using the catspeak amulet (e).
* After the cutscene, talk to Unferth again.

* Inspect the bed and window.

** Sister Elena, north of the cabbages, in the kitchen (3 clues). 
** Sister Cecilia, in the east-central room, the chapel (3 clues). 
** Sister Catherina, in the chapel (2 clues).

* Climb down the stairs to the cellar in the room northeast of the chapel.
* Investigate the bloodstains (1 clue) and body (5 clues).
* Search the robe cabinet south of Sister Elena's body. (1 clue)
* Return to Abbess Benita for a cell key. 
* Search the sack (singular, not the sacks) in the kitchen adjacent, east of Abbess Benita.
* In the southeast corner of the building, enter the second cell from the east (Elena's cell) and inspect the bed.
* Read the letters, talk to Valerio the musician about Sister Elena's death (1 clue). 
* Talk to Sister Cecilia in the chapel for a clue. 
* Return to Abbess Benita and blame anyone/nobody. 
* Talk to Sister Catherina, who is now dancing outside near Valerio.

* Talk to Valerio near the dead body. 
* Talk to Abbess Benita.

* Pick a cabbage and climb down the stairs to the cellar in the room northeast of the chapel.
* Click move on the candelabrum near the eastern wall in the centre of the room north of the Reliquary, then use a cabbage on it (but don't eat it).

* Hide-in the cabinet . You may skip the cutscene.
* Knock out the killer, then chase after them around the abbey.
* Talk to the killer at the top of the tower. 
* Climb down the stairs. You will get sent all the way down.
* Climb up the stairs twice and operate the clock mechanism so that the minute hand points to 12.
* Climb up the stairs and talk to the killer about the bell.

* Talk to Sister Anna (the killer) . You may skip the cutscene.
* Talk to Abbess Benita.

* Enter the flat-topped pyramid Uzer Mastaba from the west side, south of Uzer.
** Teleport to the fairy ring and then run east.
** Teleport to Al Kharid and go south to Shantay's Pass (Or use amulet of glory's teleport to Al Kharid).
** Use the magic carpet network to get to Uzer.
** Teleport with the traveller's necklace to desert eagles' eyrie.
* In the initial east chamber, rummage and kill the skeleton for a canopic jar.

* Kill the four skeletons in the room for a mummy hand and the scroll of the dead. The mummy hand and scroll of the dead don't appear in area loot, you need to right click to take them.

* Place jar on the shelves 4 times.
* Fill the empty sarcophagus.
* Pray at the 5 broken statues.
** This requires 150 prayer points.
* Repair the chair and table.
* Use spice on your jug of wine.
* Use wheat on your empty pot.
* Replace the pot and jug.
* Run east and kill the shadow. Then light the enchanted sconces in the following order: south, north, west, east. Shadows will spawn and must be killed between each sconce lighting.

* Talk to the Pharaoh Queen who has appeared in front of the table to give her the 2 papyri and the Scroll of Praise. (Not required for quest completion, only for 100% rebuild)
* Right-click check-progress on your scroll of the dead or pyramid journal to verify you've rebuilt the mummy 75%. Otherwise, check any parts missed. (Or 100% if you want to finish the mummy)

* Go down the ladder.

** Inside the temple, run west and down the stairs.
** Cut through the web in the north-east corner and take the boots of lightness.
** Go back upstairs
* Equip the boots and the pendant of Lucien. Check that your weight is now 0 or less.
* Enter the north gate.
* Take the bridge across the lava and pick up the lever located in the southern part of the room, in front of the crates.
* Near where you first entered the dungeon, use the lever on the lever bracket, which is mounted on the wall just west of the ladder returning to the surface. You must complete the dialogue, or the lever will not be placed.
* Pull the lever.

* Go through the south gate, and loot the chests in the tunnel for ice arrows. After looting the arrows from a chest, the next set of arrows will spawn in another random chest and it is possible they will spawn in the same chest that you just searched. You will only need a couple of arrows. You can just go back and search the chests again, as the respawn/refresh rate is quite quick (no need to hop worlds).
* With 20 limpwurt roots and your bow, return to the main chamber with the bridge. Continue north past the trapdoor to the lever on the wall.
* Right-click the lever and select Search for traps, then pull it.
* Run west and open the wooden door
* Open the next door and kill the fire warrior that appears with ice arrows.
* Talk to Winelda, and ask to be teleported across the lava. She will ask for 20 limpwurt roots.

*Heading north, push through the wall to enter the room full of Armadyl guardians.
* Remove your pendant and talk to a guardian. 
* West of the Grand Exchange, go inside a small building. (A few tiles south of fairy ring )
* Equip the Armadyl pendant and kill Lucien.

* Enter the large room to the north through the wall.
* Go to the small sub-room in the corner.
* Try to take the staff from table, kill any guardians if they stop you until the staff is acquired.
* Go inside the shed building west of the Grand Exchange. (A few tiles south of fairy ring )
* Hand the staff to Lucien.

* Talk to Asgarnia again and offer to help him.

* Talk to the bartender at the pub for a Bandit's brew.

* Talk to Eblis, by or in the eastern-most building of the Bandit Camp. (if the first chat option is not 'Ask about Archaeology' )
** He will not speak to you if you're wearing any Zamorak or Saradomin equipment.
* Use all the items on Eblis, then talk to him again.

* Retrieving the four diamonds can be done in any order.
*:Jump to §Blood diamond
*:Jump to §Ice diamond
*:Jump to §Smoke diamond
*:Jump to §Shadow diamond

* Enter the pub in Canifis. After a short cutscene, talk to Malak. 
* Take a silver bar and talk to Ruantun in the Draynor Sewers for a Silver pot.
* Take the pot to the High Priest on Entrana for a Blessed pot.
* Talk to Malak in Canifis for a blood-filled Blessed pot (this deals 50 damage).
* Crush the garlic, use the garlic powder on the blessed pot, then add spice to get a completed Blessed pot.
* Prepare for a level 84 boss fight. If you die, you will have to re-do the previous step.

* Run south-east to the Graveyard (map pictured right).
* Use the pot on the tomb, then kill Dessous. Alternating between praying Protect from Melee and Protect from Magic every tick makes Dessous unable to attack.

* Prepare for combat by getting plenty of food, a few super restore and super energy potions (even at max combat). Also grab a cake or a chocolate bar if not already in your inventory.
** Get runes and a magic weapon for fire spells if using Magic. Only fire spells will work if using Magic on Kamil.
* If you don't have spiked boots, get them first from Dunstan in Burthorpe (requires an iron bar).
* If you used your climbing boots to get the spiked boots, then get a new pair of climbing boots from Freda.
* Consider using the Endurance relic power in place of energy potions to keep your run energy up.
* Travel to Trollheim using Trollheim Teleport.

* Take the path that leads to the snow area north-west of Troll Stronghold.
* Talk to the troll child a few squares west of the ice gate.
* Use a cake or a chocolate bar on him. Talk again to help him.

* Kill 5 trolls, then travel through the cave entrance to your east and keep running.
* Kill Kamil when he appears.

* Equip your spiked boots and climb the path to the top.

* Break the two ice blocks at the top (by casting a fire spell or choosing the "smash-ice" option).

* Consider using the Endurance relic power in place of energy potions to keep your run energy up.
* Open the burnt chest in the middle of the dungeon to receive a Warm key.

* Bank the smoke diamond immediately. While holding the smoke diamond, a stranger capable of dealing over 5,000 damage per attack can spawn at any time.
* Travel to Rasolo (north-west from Ardougne lodestone; see the map to the right).

* Return to the desert Bandit Camp.
* Unlock the secure chest in the southern-most tent. You might consume between 10 to 100 lockpicks.

**You can steal from the level 54 Bandits around the camp to get lock picks and antipoison.
**Master thief's lockpick also works and will never break.
** Five finger discount upgrades help.

* Talk to Azzanadra.

* Talk to the High Priest in Sophanem. 
* Climb the ladder behind the altar.
* After the cutscene, talk to Maisa. 
* Talk to the High Priest.

* Use the oxidized bronze items on the crate.

* Use the oxidized bronze items on the crate.

** Mummies to the west.
** Locust lancers, rangers, scabaras lancers, and rangers in the swamp to the south-east.
* Copy the notes to the scabaras research.

* This section is a race against time. Read it fully before continuing. You need to pass all challenges successfully in one go, otherwise you need to tell the clay golem to reset the levers so you can try again.
* It is possible to empty the storage box of logs so you might need to bring your own in case you fail at first attempt. If you have a lower Firemaking level, you might not be able to stoke the furnace. For example, the storage box may give you magic logs, but if your Firemaking level is below 95, you won't be able to continue, unless you bring your own logs.

* Use the logs on the furnace to stoke the furnace.
* Talk to the golem. 
* Relight the furnace.

** Cross the pipe and pull the lever.
* Enter the empty room.
** Pull the lever.
* Enter the scarab room.
** Kill the level 92 giant scarab.
** Pull the lever.

** Flip the rune in the upper left corner. Use your notes to identify the locations of other matching runes and flip them over (You are matching groups of 3 runes). Continue until all runes have been flipped.

* Run to the High Priest of Scabaras in the north-west room in the dungeon. Disarm the traps along the way.
* Talk to the High Priest. 
* Defeat him.
* Talk to him again. 
* Defeat him.
* Talk to him once more. 
* Defeat him.
* Talk to him once more. 
* Return to the High Priest in Sophanem.

* Talk to King Lathas.

* Pull the lever to the south at the end to continue.

* Take the middle west path, traversing the flat rocks as before using the plank. Take the orb.
* Take the final path and do not pick up the orb right away. Search the flat rock underneath the orb to disarm the trap first and then take the orb. If successful your character will automatically pick up the orb. If not, continue trying to search the rock.

* Use the 4 orbs on the furnace.
* Return to the altar (again, don't forget about the traps).
* Climb down the well. You can search the two stacked crates for 2 salmon and 2 meat pies.

* Pick the lock and dig the mud in the south-easternmost cell.
* Walk west and cross the ledge.

* Pass through the tunnel north of the cage, until you reach 3 paladins.

* Use the badges and unicorn horn on the well.
* Open the door.

* Talk to Niloof the dwarf.

* Open and search the chest north of the middle demon.

* Take the bucket in the large house. Use it on the barrel in the smaller house to receive a dwarf brew.

* Use the dwarf brew on the tomb.

* Walk south to the third walkway and cross the bridge.
