* Talk to the Gardener Ghost on the in the northern side. 
* Lead him south-east into the Haunted Woods. (Don't worry about him getting stuck he will teleport back to you)
* Periodically talk to him for directions and dig at graves by choosing the "Dig" option until the decapitated head is found.
** The grave is about 10 squares east and 5 squares south of the fairy ring. Choose the "Dig" option on the nearby grave.

* Go to the tavern in Canifis.
* Take a pickled brain off the table for 50 coins or by using Telekinetic Grab on it.
** Telekinetic grabbing the brain completes a medium Morytania achievement, Brain Bending.
* Use the decapitated head on the pickled brain.

* Head east of Fenkenstrain's Castle to the tombstones just west of the Musician.
* Use the star amulet on the easternmost memorial.
* Push the memorial to enter Fenkenstrain's Dungeon.
* Kill an experiment creature with a wolf's body and woman's head and pick up the cavern key.
* Continue north-west and open the entrance.
* Go up the ladder.
* Go north and right-click dig on all 3 of the graves to obtain torso, arms and legs

* Teleport back to Canifis and talk to Dr Fenkenstrain in his castle. 
* Talk to Dr Fenkenstrain again to turn in needle and thread.
* Talk to the Gardener Ghost to receive the shed key. 
* Enter the shed next to Gardener Ghost, and search the cupboard for a garden brush.
* Take 3 garden canes from the pile just outside.
* Use the 3 garden canes on the brush for an extended brush, consuming 3 spools of bronze wire. 
* Go up the west stairs, and use the extended brush on the fireplace in the nearby room for a conductor mould.
* At any furnace, make the conductor with a silver bar. In the smelting interface, look under the 'casting metals & glass' section. Under the 'silver casting' subsection of that section, there will be an option to make a conductor.
**Be sure to make only one, as the furnace will try to use multiple bars.
* Go back to the castle and go up either staircase.
* Go up the ladder in the southern room.
* Repair the lightning conductor.

* Talk to Dr Fenkenstrain.
* Go upstairs and use the ladder in the central northern room.
* Talk to Fenkenstrain's Monster.
* Pickpocket Dr Fenkenstrain.
* Quest complete!

*Go to Burgh de Rott, then enter in the inn where you will climb over the broken down wall and climb down trapdoor in the northwest of inn.
* Talk to Veliaf Hurtz in the Burgh de Rott pub basement. 
** Search the chest to the north for garlic if you do not have one.
* Run south-east of the pub until you find a boathouse.
* Search the boat, then use a plank on it to fix it.
* South of the boat, use plank on the boat chute to fix it.
* Push the boat down the chute, then go down to the docks and board the boat. If a Vyrewatch stops you at any point, just activate Freedom and walk away. 
** Keybind may not work, recommended to click the ability on your action bar or in the Defence abilities tab.
* Exit the boat by jumping onto the nearby rock, and continue north-west a short distance.
* Just before the shore, kick down the floor, and climb down it as shown on the image on the right.
* Climb the wall rubble to the north and talk to a Meiyerditch citizen. 
* North of the wall rubble, talk to Old Man Ral ([[File:Task map icon.png]] Taskmaster icon on the map). 
** (Optional) If you want to reduce detection chance by the Vyrewatch, you can buy a set of Vyrewatch clothing from Trader Sven just south of Old Man Ral before continuing.

* Go to the house south-west of Old Man Ral with the door facing north (the western of the two houses with northern doors – it has a sickle next to it on the outside wall). Open the door and enter it.
* Climb up the ladder there.
* Jump to the floorboards in the south.
* Jump to the floorboards in the east.
* Go to the north-east corner of the room, push the wall and walk across the floor.
* Crawl under the wall to the north.
* Go north to the second room, look on the west side, push the wall and walk across the floor.
* Climb down the ladder.
* Search the table next to the wall, open the trapdoor table, and go through the trapdoor tunnel.
* Climb up the shelf next to the sickle logo in the north-west corner of the room. 
* Crawl under the wall to the east side.
* Jump to the floorboards in the east.
* Climb down the ladder.
* Search the pots near the eastern door to get a key and use it to open the door.

* Climb up the ladder in the room to the east, by the sickle.
* Jump to the floorboards in the south.
* Go east, south, west then climb up the shelf to the south.
* Climb up the ladder in the west.
* Jump to the floorboards in the south.
* Walk a little to the south-west and climb down the ladder once.
* Go east through the rooms and walk across the washing line.
* Climb down the ladder.
* Push the wall to the north and walk across the floor.
* Climb up the shelf to the north.
* Climb down the shelf in the north-eastern corner. 
* Jump to the floorboards in the north.
* Jump to the floorboards in the north again.
* Go to the north end of the house and jump to the floorboards in the east.
* Climb up the ladder to the east.
* Search the wall to the west to get the ladder top.
* Climb down the same ladder, repair the broken ladder going down by using the ladder top from inventory to broken ladder and climb down the ladder.

* Open the door to the east and go northwest outside. Go past the house immediately north of the house you just left and into the house with a door on its east side. You should be in a room that has an unlit fireplace, a portrait, and some sort of wall east of it joined to a room that is a perfect diamond.
* Go west through the door into the next room, then north out of the house until you see barricades.
* Head east at the sickle logo, past the north side of the house with two buckets. Enter the first door to your south; you should be east of the room with two buckets and north of the diamond room from earlier.
* Climb up the ladder.
* Jump to the floorboards in the east.
* Climb down the stairs.
* Go south along the eastern side of the stairs. Attempt to push the wall and choose a knife or a sickle to unlock the latch (tool belt knife works), allowing you to push it open.
* Push the decorated wall from the southern side.
* Open the lumpy rug on the southeast square in the 4-square pattern of the rug. If you take too long, you will have to push the wall again as the mechanism will quickly reset.
* Climb down trapdoor to enter the hideout.

* Run far north and talk to Vertida. 
* Take the message back to Veliaf Hurtz who is in the basement of the pub in Burgh de Rott.

* Talk to Drezel in the Mausoleum under the Paterdomus temple west of Canifis. Use or the invitation box to teleport nearby. 
** If you have destroyed your Temple library key 
* Take the west exit, past the monuments.
* Search the small bush slightly south-west of the western church steps.
* Return and talk to Drezel in the Mausoleum. He will give you runes to teleport to Varrock.
** Depending on other running quests, you might need to talk to him. 
* Talk to King Roald in the Varrock Palace. 
** You will be teleported back to the Paterdomus.

* Talk to Drezel about what to do next. 
* Talk to Veliaf Hurtz back in the basement of the pub in Burgh de Rott. 
* Return to Meiyerditch using the boat in the boathouse south-east and try to get caught by a Vyrewatch. 
* Mine 15 ore from the walls. (Only requires 1 backpack space as the ores stack)
* Use them on a minecart, then talk to a guard.
* Run south-east to the house marked on the map (right).
* Go south through 3 doors and up the ladder.
* Jump the floorboards to the east, descend the stairs and enter the hideout.
* Talk to Vertida 
** You will be teleported back to sector 1.
* Climb down the ladder, open the door, run south and climb over the wall rubble near the shore.
* Run south and climb the fallen floorboards back towards the boat and onto the top of the wall.
* Run north along the top of the wall and climb down the ladder.
* Choose the "search" option on the rocky surface.
* Open the barricade to the north; then go north, and climb up the ladder.
* Keep running north along the wall, over more ladders. Talk to Safalaan at the very end to receive papyrus and charcoal. 
* Run clockwise around the wall until you reach the north wall and see a sickle drawn on the ground. 
** If playing on high graphics settings, the sickle will be hard to see due to the shadows on the ground. The sickle is located just past where the shadows first appear on the north wall.
* Use the papyrus on the charcoal and watch the cutscene.
* Go anticlockwise around the wall to a sickle on the west wall, and then one on south wall. Use papyrus on charcoal at each of the symbols.
** Western wall
** Southern wall
* Watch cutscene. Let Vanstrom attack you a bit which will knock you out.
* Talk to and finish the dialogue with Sarius if she didn't automatically talk to you when Vanstrom knocked you out. You must talk with Sarius until she disappears, otherwise Safalaan will say your sketches are not genuine in the next step.
* After being knocked out, go back to the south wall and finish your final sketch.
* Go south back to the ladder and climb down.
* Return to the hideout and talk to Safalaan 
** The quickest way to return is to get noticed by the Vyrewatch, get sent to the mine, and then go southeast to the hideout as before. If you are having trouble getting noticed just log out and log back in.

* Leave the hideout, push the wall, climb the stairs, jump the gap, down the ladder.
* Go out the north door, walk slightly west and then south, and open the door to a room with a fireplace. Look at the fireplace. 
*Choose knife from tool belt option to receive a Message.
* Read the message.
* Search the portrait on the south wall and slash it with the knife.
* Search the portrait again to pick up a large ornate key.
* Talk to Safalaan in the base and give him the message. 
* Leave the hideout, push the wall, climb the stairs, jump the gap, down the ladder.
* Run north through three doors.
* Head to north-east in Meiyerditch (follow the eastern wall north). There is a bright red and yellow tapestry (with a door on the east side of the room).
* Look-at the tapestry and slash it with a knife.
* Walk-through the slashed tapestry.
* Use the large ornate key on the vampyre statue.
* Go east through the door, then down the staircase, and telekinetic grab Haemalchemy (Vol. 1).
** Runes can be found by searching the broken rune case directly west of the stairs.

* Head back to the Meiyerditch Myreque base: 
** Go up the staircase, out the door, and through the tapestry.
** Run south to the previously marked building through three doors. 
** Go up the ladder, jump to the east floorboards, down the stairs.
** Push the wall, push the decorated wall, open the lumpy rug, and climb down the trap door.
* Speak to Safalaan. Be sure he hands you a sealed message and shortcut key, which the key can be added to the key ring after the completion of One Small Favour.
* Take the sealed message to Veliaf in the Burgh de Rott cellar. 
* Quest complete!

* Head to the north of Sophanem. You can use the magic carpet network south of Shantay Pass from Al Kharid to get to Nardah, and then run southwest.
* Talk to the wanderer while your cat is following you. 
** The wanderer is located a short distance north of Sophanem, east of the river but west of the Agility Pyramid.
* Open the northern door on the southern pyramid (picture of a cat).

* You will arrive inside a maze.
* Run past the initial wall crushers and walk on the denser rubble (dotted lines indicate the locations of pitfall traps).
** Alternatively follow the path shown in the image to the right.
* Avoid traps and aggressive monsters until you reach a pit.
** [Optional] Run past the wall crushers to the east and open the chest to complete Icthlarin's Little Chest.
* Jump across the pit. This requires at least 20% run energy.
* Open the doorway of the western room.
* Solve the puzzle.

* Talk to the Sphinx with your cat or kitten out. 
* Pick up your cat and talk to the High Priest, located inside the Temple of Icthlarin in the south part of the city.
* Note down the name of the canopic jar in the backpack.

* Go back to the southern pyramid and open the door.
* Go through the pyramid again. Jump across the pit and open the west doorway.
* Take the jar on the ground that has the same name as the one in the backpack previously.
* Kill the apparition that spawns. You can safe-spot it by using the table in the room (unless you have the canopic jar of Apmeken or Crondis).
* Take the jar again.
* Open the doorway to exit the room.
* Open the doorway to enter the west room again.
* Return the canopic jar by clicking the empty space with the lighting effect (the original location of your jar).
* Exit the pyramid. Opening the doorway should automatically take you to the entrance.

* Talk to the High Priest. 
* Talk to the embalmer at the spice shop, north-west of the temple.
* Talk to the carpenter at the potter's wheel, just east of the southern pyramid. 
* Talk to him again with willow logs in your inventory.
* Talk to Raetul near the Sphinx to obtain linen.
* Skip these steps if you already have salt:
** Bring an empty bucket just north of Sophanem to a small open lake (refer to map shown right).
** Collect from the salty water for a bucket of salty water.
** Head back inside Sophanem.
** Search the centre piece, located just south-east of the southern pyramid. 
** Search the centre piece for a pile of salt. 
* Talk to the embalmer.
* Talk to the carpenter for a holy symbol.
** This may take a few seconds before he finishes the symbol.

* Enter the pyramid once again and jump over the pit.
* Open the doorway of the eastern room.
* Search the first sarcophagus to your immediate west, on the northern wall, and hide the unholy symbol in it. 
** Searching other sarcophagi is optional and not recommended.
* Open the doorway to exit the room.
* Open the doorway to enter the eastern room again. Finish the dialogue with the High Priest and the wanderer.
* Kill the Possessed Priest.
* Talk to the High Priest.
* Open the doorway to exit the room to return to the temple. 
** You may be given the canopic jar again, which has no further use and can be dropped (it will turn to dust).
* Talk to the High Priest.
* Quest complete!

* Talk to Larry near the penguin enclosure in the Ardougne Zoo. 
* Talk to Larry again when carrying 10 oak planks and 10 steel nails. 
* Use an oak plank on the firm snow patch.
* Attempt to enter the bird hide structure to cover it in snow with spade. 
* Enter snowy bird hide.
* Take note of the emotes the left penguin is doing. The snowy bird hide can be re-entered to watch again if needed. You can check the quest journal later in the quest if you aren't sure. 
* Talk to Larry. 
* Travel using the nearby boat. 
* Talk to Larry once on the dock.

* Make a clockwork suit on Clockmaker's bench 3 or 4 in a player-owned house, which requires a clockwork, regular plank, and some silk.
** Making an extra suit at this point is optional for the subsequent quests.
* Return to Larry (in Ardougne Zoo or north of Fremennik Province lodestone). 
* Talk to Larry on the iceberg. 
** Accept teleport to the Ardougne Zoo.

* Unequip cape and weapons and use the tuxedo-time option on Larry.
* Enter the penguin pen and talk to the penguin.
* Use the greeting emotes from earlier. If you haven't noted down the emotes, look in your quest log after you've talked to the penguin.
* Read the mission report and exit the penguin pen.
* Talk to Larry twice.

* Go to the west section of the Lumbridge cow field by the gate and steal a cowbell from a dairy cow by using the steal-cowbell option for later on in the quest.
** Players without 15 Thieving can get a cowbell by talking to the dairy cow in Zanaris.
* Talk to Larry inside the sheep pen west of Fred the Farmer's house in Lumbridge.
* Enter penguin suit by right clicking Larry and selecting 'tuxedo time' or using the clockwork suit on Larry and talk to the penguins disguised as a sheep (the sheep with flippers).
* Do the greeting emotes.
* Talk to sheep penguin again.
* Talk to Larry twice. 
* Equip the ring of charos or have a raw cod in the inventory and use the tuxedo-time option on Larry and enter the penguin suit again once at Ardougne Zoo.
* Enter penguin pen and talk to penguin. 
* Talk to Larry twice.

* Go back to the Lumbridge sheep pen.
* Enter penguin suit by right clicking Larry and selecting 'tuxedo time' or using the clockwork suit on Larry.
* Talk to sheep penguin.
* Talk to Larry twice.
* Talk to Fred the Farmer nearby. 
** Note: Chat options may vary for some players. Choose the option for penguins.
* Enter penguin suit and talk to sheep penguin again. 
* Talk to Larry twice.

* Dismiss any pets or followers.
* Talk to Larry on the iceberg and get in the penguin suit again and talk to KGP Agent north-west of Larry.
* Do the greeting emotes.
* Talk to Noodle twice. 
* Talk to KGP Agent.
** Make sure you finish the dialogue or you won't be able to enter the penguin lair.
* Investigate avalanche just north of KGP Agent.
* Enter the first west room.
* Talk to KGP Agent.
* Exit room through the west door and then through the north door.
* Walk north to the agility course.

* Climb down the steps and into the water.
** Stepping across the checkered flag should automatically drop you in water.
* Avoid the moving ice in the water.
* Climb the stepping stone at the end.
* Jump across the next stones until you reach the other side.
* After crossing, continue on the path until you come to an arch covered in icicles. Use the tread softly option to pass. This must be repeated several times at each arch. Players who fail will be hit with a small amount of damage.
* Next, climb up the ice. This can be very annoying, as players lose 20 life points each time they fail, and the failure rate is surprisingly high. For players with low Agility levels, a small amount of food may help.
* After that, a short cutscene will play of the player sliding down a hill.
*Talk to the Agility Instructor to leave the gate.
* Leave the outpost and talk to Larry on the iceberg (twice).

* Enter the penguin suit and return to the outpost.
* Enter the second east room and talk to Ping and Pong.
* Return to Larry and exit penguin suit.
* Use a mahogany plank on the leather.
* Enter penguin suit and return to Ping and Pong.
* Talk to them again. 
* Operate the control panel in the north-west corner of the main hall.
* Enter the War Room to the east.

* Kill an Icelord and exit the pen.
* Climb the chasm to the east in the room.
* Talk to Larry.
* Quest complete!

* Talk to Larry in the south-west of the Ardougne Zoo and agree to help. 
* Go east to the south coast of Witchaven, and inspect one of the giant footprints on the western side of the southern coast. 
* Return to Larry for a cutscene.

* North-east of Rellekka (north of Fremennik lodestone), travel via the small boat to the Iceberg.
* Talk to Larry. 
** You should now be in the penguin suit. 
* North-west, investigate the avalanche, a patch of snow up against the ice wall.
* Enter the west room, speak to KGP Interrogator. 
* Talk to captured penguin and note down the three dance emotes.
* Search the crate behind you to get a conch shell, puffer, octopus, monkfish, and a ray.
** You may fail, just try again.
* Take note of which headwear the captured penguin is wearing.
** The fish hat will either be a puffer, octopus, monkfish, or ray fish.
* Talk to Ping & Pong (who are in a room north-east from interrogation room).
* Talk to the KGP Agent by the control panel to the north, he is tucked behind a corner wall.
* Return to Ping & Pong. 
* Return to the KGP Agent by the control panel. Sing him the lullaby. 
* Operate the control panel. Head north-east into the war room.
* Talk to any dwarf. 
* Speak to the dwarf again.
* Exit war room to get caught.
* Talk to Larry (twice). 
* Re-enter the hideout via the avalanche and return to the dwarves. 
* Talk to them again and give them the supplies to get a toolbox.
* Perform practice run on the engine panel north of the dwarves.
** Wrench -> wirebox.
** Wire cutter -> wirebox.
** Wire -> wirebox.
** Tape -> wirebox.
** Bellows -> pipe.
** Click bellows twice, the pressure gauge will point to the red.
** Turn valve wheel three times, the pressure gauge arrow points straight up in the green.
** Pull lever.
* Talk to a dwarf again. 
* Exit war room to get caught.
* Talk to Larry. 
* North-west, talk to Noodle. 
* Re-enter the hideout via the avalanche. Enter first room to the east (second door to the east, first is decorative).

* Navigate to the sorting table without being spotted using the picture to the right (see the full guide for more details).
* Search sorting table to get a telegram. Exit the small room and ensure the door is closed before you move further.
* Navigate back out of the office the way you came, without being spotted. Once back in the main hall, exit using the southern door. If you are caught you will lose the item and have to repeat the process.
* Return to Larry and talk to him twice.

* Southeast of Yanille, just outside the city walls, talk to Larry. 
* Enter the penguin suit and wear the fish hat the captured penguin was wearing.
* Blow the conch shell, then perform the three emotes.
* Climb up the ladder and walk all the way to the east, opening doors along the way.
* Talk to Captain Marlin behind the red curtain.
* Pick either honest or lie. 
* In the brig, walk west and search the hatstand to get an electric eel, shark tooth, crab claw, seaweed, and a swordfish.
* Open the east door.
* Inspect the engine panel.
** Crab claw -> wirebox.
** Shark tooth -> wirebox.
** Electric eel -> wirebox.
** Seaweed -> wirebox.
** Pufferfish -> pipe.
** Click pufferfish twice, the pressure gauge will point to the red.
** Octopus -> Turn valve wheel three times, the pressure gauge arrow points straight up in the green.
** Swordfish -> lever.
** Pull the lever.
* Talk to Chuck towards the east side of the island to leave the island and get a cutscene.
** If you teleport off the island, talk to Chuck at the Ardougne Zoo to get teleported back to the Desert Island and talk to him again once there.
* Quest complete!
* Talk to Brimstail in a cave west of the bank in the Gnome Stronghold . Look for dungeon link on minimap

* Inspect the singing bowl in the western portion of the cave.
* To the north, attempt to unlock Oaknock's machine and use Oaknock's exchanger.
* Talk to Brimstail.

* Talk to Hazelmere (island east of Yanille, fairy ring ) for several cutscenes. He provides you with a violet pentagon.
* Return and talk to Brimstail.

* Grind mud rune and use on bucket of sap.
* Use the magic glue and a set of maple and oak logs on Oaknock's exchanger and repair it.
* Talk to Brimstail. 
* Talk to him again three or more times to receive more discs . You will need to drop all of your discs and pick them back up after chatting to receive more discs. The more discs, the more streamlined the process in the next step becomes as you require little to no converting.

* Unlock machine to view the desired number.
* If necessary, use the exchanger to get a disc equal to your number (refer to conversion chart below, insert not more than 35 points at a time). If you have trouble converting, refer to the full guide here.
* Unlock the machine with the correct value disc. Click the small green square to submit the disc.
* Unlock the machine again to get 3 different numbers (the second unlock will require many more discs). Use the exchanger as necessary. The second number requires using 2 discs and the third requires 3 discs.
* Talk to Brimstail.

* Kill the evil creature by Brimstail and talk to him again. (1/6).
* Kill the 5 remaining evil creatures, which can be done in any order :
** (2/6) By the main gate to the stronghold (south-east from Brimstail's cave)
** (3/6) South of the spirit tree by the gnome agility course entrance.
** (4/6) In the giant tortoise pen north-west of the Grand Tree and north of the swamp.
** (5/6) Top floor of the Grand Tree, next to the small prison/by the ladder (wait for the chat response saying you killed it before using the ladder. If it doesn't count it, an evil creature should respawn at one of the locations.)
** (6/6) Near King Narnode (may need ranged, magic or necromancy as it can get stuck behind a trapdoor). Check your quest journal if your chat log does not display 6 creatures, if it says you need to talk to the king then you are finished.
* Talk to King Narnode Shareen on the of the Grand Tree.
* Quest complete!
* Talk to Herman Caranos outside the Piscatoris Fishing Colony (fairy ring code or memory strand teleport, then run northeast).
* Talk to the Wise Old Man in Draynor.

* Head back to the Piscatoris Colony. Talk to the Wise Old Man. 
* Kill the sea trolls and open the colony gate.
* Talk to Herman in the eastern building.

* Talk to Franklin Caranos near the entrance.
* In the building directly north of Franklin, use a log on the firebox (the east side of the large metal contraption in the middle of the room), then light the firebox by clicking on it.
** Logs and iron ores can be obtained just outside of the colony. The firebox is the metal box on the east side of the metal press.
* Use 5 iron bars on the Metal Press to get 5 iron sheets.
* Use the iron sheets on the broken colony walls to the west.
* Talk to Franklin. 
* Right-click on Arnold Lydspor in the bank to talk to him. 
* Catch at least five fresh monkfish to the northwest. You'll be attacked by sea trolls when fishing. This can take up to 10 minutes depending on your Fishing level.
* Cook the monkfish in the kitchen southwest. You will need to turn in five fresh monkfish; if any are burned, fish for more. To cook them, just use them on the range and don't proceed on Make-X interface.
* Talk to Arnold.

* Talk to the Wise Old Man and Herman (furthest building to the east). 
* Talk to Wizard Frumscone in the basement of the Wizards' Guild in Yanille. 
** Fetch the required supplies now, if you haven't already.
* Talk to Malignius Mortifer northwest of Port Sarim near the crossroads. 
* Talk to any Almost Master Crafter inside the Crafting Guild until one talks to you about crafting pot lids.
* Talk to Malignius Mortifer, he will teleport you to the colony, so gear up before speaking with him.

* Talk to Herman. 
* Kill the Sea Troll Queen.
** Banks recover health rapidly, and while the bank isn't functional until quest completion, you can run into the building and next to the banker to recover health.
* Talk to Herman.
* Quest complete!

* Talk to Gertrude in west edge of Varrock. 
** If you have a Hellcat out 
* Take out your cat or kitten.
* Talk to Phingspet or Grimesquit in the Varrock Sewers right next to the eastern entrance of Varrock Palace (down the manhole).
* Catch 8 rats with your cat or kitten by choosing the "interact-with" option. 
** The "Hide familiar options" setting must be off in the Gameplay settings.
* Talk to them again to obtain a rat pole.

* Talk to Jimmy Dazzler in the house in East Ardougne, directly west of the Flying Horse Inn, north-west of the Ardougne Castle. Ensure you finish the dialogue, or you will not be able to follow the next step.
* Read the "directions" scroll he gives you.

* Avoid guards whilst traversing throughout. You can use Surge or Dive to navigate quickly.
* Hide behind the hedges directly west of the mansion when the southwest guard walks toward the bridge.
* Run to the north-west corner when the guard is behind the hedges.
* Run to the hedges directly north of the mansion.
* Climb up the nearby trellis on the northern of the mansion.

* Once inside continue to avoid guards. You can hide by the potted flower on the balcony first.
* Wield your rat pole.
* Catch 1 rat with your cat in the north-west room. You may pick up your cat to prevent stuck outside. 
* Find your way into the opposite bedroom across the hall and wait (or wait for one guard to be on the balcony and the second have his back appropriately turned to dash to the next room).
* Catch 2 rats with your cat in the south-east room. 
* Go down the ladder in the north-east of this room.
* Catch 3 rats with your cat in this room and the room to the north. 
* Leave the area by using Home Teleport to Ardougne lodestone.
** You can also return to the trellis and climb down it to return directly to Jimmy.
* Talk to Jimmy Dazzler.
** You can destroy your directions scroll now.

* Talk to Hooknosed Jack in south-east Varrock, inside the fenced area past the guard.
* If you need to make the rat poison and do not have the ingredients (clean kwuarm, red spiders eggs and an empty vial) in the backpack on the first talk, talk to him again. 
* Climb up the ladder in the warehouse directly south of the Dancing Donkey Inn.
* Use rat poison on all 4 pieces of cheese.
* Use poisoned cheese on all of the rat holes.
* Talk to Hooknosed Jack. 
* Talk to the Apothecary in south-western Varrock for cat antipoison. 
** If the first option is not 'Can you make a strength potion?', 
* Talk to Hooknosed Jack. Finish the dialogue or you will not be able to progress.
* Climb up the ladder in the warehouse.
* Pick up your cat and use it on the hole in wall (not the rat holes). Make sure you finish the dialogue to start the fight, life points bars appear.
* Keep using fish on the hole in wall (not on the cat) to restore the cat's life points until the king rat dies.

* Start by speaking to Yrsa, who is located in the building just south-west of the docks. She will recall her father's stories about how V left after the Edicts of Guthix were laid down at the end of the Third Age. Instead of rebelling against Guthix, V simply understood and left after saying his farewells. Now that the Edicts no longer exist, he yearns to return to his people in Rellekka.
* Next, talk to Peer the Seer, who is situated outside the building to the south-east of Yrsa. He explains how V established the usage of basic air and water magic, and the creation of rune altars, to benefit his people. The altars have since been demolished by the Fremenniks, who couldn't see eye-to-eye with him on the introduction of magic in their community.
* Talk to Swensen the Navigator in the building just south-east of Peer the Seer. He tells you the story of when V and his companion, Knut, were fighting daggermouths; although V survived, Knut was mortally wounded trying to protect him. V constructed a cairn for him with Winter's Eye plants flowering around it.
* Talk to Sigmund the Merchant at his stall in the north-western corner of the marketplace. He explains how V protected and empowered the Fremenniks during the God Wars, despite being much weaker than the other gods. His demeanour forced the other gods to backtrack and cease the pursuing of his people.
* Talk to Brundt the Chieftain in the main hall, located near the city entrance. He notes that V always wanted to be a great hero to his people, and that is what he got. The Fremenniks do not view V as a god, but simply their personal hero.
* Talk to Manni the Reveller, also in the main hall, who tells you that V did not want a sad send-off after the Edicts were in place. Instead, taking a page from a certain monkey-goddess, he decided to host a huge victory feast before departing.
* Finally, talk to Olaf the Bard, found wandering north-east of the main hall. He tells you about the time when V, after touching the Stone of Jas, warned the Fremenniks about a "giant basilisk" who was waiting to strike at them from the shores. V then rallied his people against the creature and performed his first act of heroism, by killing the basilisk.

*Once all souls have been released, continue circling until Gielinor stops firing the beam, then shield yourself from Gielinor's attack with the ability, in order to reflect the damage onto Gielinor.
*You will have to repeat this process a few times.

* In this phase, Nomad will only be using rapid melee attacks. Kill him by any means. If using Ranged, Magic or Necromancy, then you can run around the room to avoid damage from Nomad, using Surge to gain distance. Watch out for Gielinor's attacks. Protect from Melee or Deflect Melee, especially combined with Devotion, can reduce or negate much of Nomad's damage in this phase, though the speed of his attacks can still be problematic.

* Return to Hassan in the Merchant district. 
* Quest complete!
* Before leaving the city, feel free to activate the Menaphos lodestone.

* Bring Leela to Senliten by talking to her along the fence north of the prison in Draynor Village. Agree to travel with her and you will end up in front of Senliten.
** If you sent her to Senliten without following her, travel to the Uzer Mastaba (the pyramid south of Uzer) via some other means. 
* Speak with Senliten.

* Talk to the Sphinx in Sophanem with your cat (do not wear a catspeak amulet or cramulet). 
* Talk to Jex, who is north-east of the Sphinx. 
* Return to Senliten. 
* Right click Leela to return to the surface.

* Enter the temple again but use the explore option. 
* Head north and click the ship to get the dowsing rod (Pick up relic Massive stone boat).
* Click the dowsing rod and follow the arrow to the following locations in the desert, until your character starts talking, before moving to the next location.
*:If you encounter a bug where the dowsing rod suddenly no longer functions, you must destroy it and acquire a new one from the boat inside the temple before repeating each location.
** The oasis just north-west of the temple.
** The oasis by the Camel Warriors, east of Sophanem.
** The oasis near the Bedabin Camp.
* Return to Senliten. 
* Head to the waterfall north of the Dominion Tower and climb it.
* Walk north through both sets of double doors
* Talk to the spirits (Tirrie, Nirrie, or Hallak) in the north part of the cave.

* Talk to Portmaster Kags in the Menaphos Port district on the southwest pier by the house portal. 
* Enter Crondis's pyramid.
* Talk to the High Priest of Crondis.

* You must wait until after Crondis asks for each item before gathering it or the requirement will not be satisfied.
* Catch a raw beltfish either on the northwest or southeast pier of the Menaphos Port district or in the VIP skilling area. 
** If using Bait and Switch first catch a beltfish, then obtain it via trading or bank raw.
* Return to Crondis 
* Cut two acadia logs at the acadia trees in the Menaphos Imperial district.
* Return to Crondis. 
* Collect four pyramid tops from the Agility Pyramid.
* Return to Crondis. 
* Catch eight plover birds in southern Sophanem. Any sort of double drop will not count for this. It must be 8 catches, not just 8 plover birds.
** Sophanem Slayer Dungeon teleport and run south is the fastest way to get there.
* Return to Crondis. 
* Without teleporting after buying, purchase at least 20 (preferably 24) croc ices from Rokuh in Nardah near the fountain to ensure you still have 16 left to turn in (because one croc ice is eaten automatically every 15 seconds, and teleporting with them turns them into chocolatey goo).
** Run west and Nardah magic carpet to Menaphos.
** Use the Merchant District Shifting Tombs to get to the Port District and return to Crondis' pyramid.
** They do not need to all be collected in one trip.

* Talk to Crondis. Use any chat option except 1 for all dialogue boxes. 
** If not already equipped for combat, leave the conversation just before the player yells "THAT'S ENOUGH!" to prepare for the fight.
** Talk to Crondis again to continue forward to the fight when you return. 
* Kill Ukunduka (stay out of melee distance or use Saradomin brews). There is a safe spot on the stairs leading up to Crondis.
* Talk to the High Priest of Crondis.
* Return to Senliten.
* After the cutscene, speak with Senliten. 
* Quest complete!
* Speak with Grand Vizier Hassan in the Merchant district of Menaphos.

* Speak to the faction heads, preferably ending with worker (closest to tomb)
** Speak to Grand Vizier Ehsan (Merchant) also in the same building. 
** Speak to 'Admiral' Wadud (Ports) in the Golden Scarab Inn in the Port district. 
** Speak to Commander Akhomet (Imperial) in the Imperial district. 
** Speak to Batal (Worker) in the Worker district. 
* Enter the Shifting Tombs and speak to Ozan inside.
* Exit the Shifting Tombs and use the mask you received from Ozan with the bucket of blood next to the fish stall in the Merchant district.
* Speak to Akhomet in the Imperial district. 
* Give the signets to Batal in the Worker district. 
* Give the certificate to Wadud in the Port district. 
* Speak to Ehsan in the Merchant district.

* Gear up for a battle.
* Speak to Hassan in the Merchant district. 
* Kill four level 105 Menaphos palace guards. This will be a checkpoint for the final fight.
** Use Protect from Magic prayer and finish off the ones using melee combat style first.
* Fight the Pharaoh. 
** Use Protect from Magic.
** "Kneel" or "Usurpers!" - Use the freedom ability to break free and prevent further damage.
** Move off the green fire as soon as it spawns.

* Watch the cutscene. 
* Quest complete!
* Talk to Grand Vizier Hassan in the Merchant district, south of the bank deposit box.

* Go to the Grand Library of Menaphos in the Imperial district. The entrance is next to the deposit box (bank chest).
* Talk to Kohnen the librarian, who is just north of the entrance. 
* Exit the Grand Library.
* Head north to talk to Commander Akhomet. 
* Head to Pollnivneach.
* Speak to Aristarchus, who is north-west of the south magic carpet station. 
* You will have to fight four Menaphite Thugs.
** They are level 122 and fight using melee.
** You can hide behind Aristarchus if you need a safe spot and are using ranged/magic/necromancy.
* Speak to Aristarchus again who will agree to meet you in the library. 
* Return to the Grand Library and speak to Aristarchus, who is south of the entrance inside the library.
* Go to Uzer Mastaba and enter the pyramid to trigger a cutscene. (fairy code )
* After the cutscene, enter the pyramid once more and speak to Senliten. 
* Go to Al Kharid and speak to Osman, who is in the throne room, south of the lodestone.
* Speak to Emir Ali Mirza in front of the throne.

* Leave the Palace and head north-east to Dommik's Crafting Store.
** Ignore the quest active area marked on the minimap.
* Climb the stairs on the inside of the crafting store.
* Climb the ladder south of the stairs.
* Follow these steps across the rooftops:
** Walk across the plank to the south.
** Slide down the awning to the south.
** Go through the building.
** Walk across the washing line (north-west from where you started).
** Climb the ladder to the west.
** Talk to Jabari.
** Cross the planks to the west.
** Climb the ladder to the southwest.
** Jump from the scaffold to the west.
** Climb down the rug to the south.
** Swing across the wooden frame immediately west.
** Jump from the scaffold (west) to the next building.
** Bounce on the awning (south) to the bank.
** Climb up the brickwork to the west on the wall.
** Talk to Jabari.
** Parrot drop on the rug to the south.
*** Do not shimmy across the rope.
** Run north of the bank, west of the furnace, and talk to Jabari.
** Run north-east of the Al Kharid lodestone into a tent, and talk to Jabari.
** Run north to the house near the north-east exit of Al Kharid, and talk to Jabari.
*** You can get a free heal from the Surgeon General west of this house.
* Go to Het's Oasis.

* Prepare to battle Jabari four times. He is level 112 and uses magic. He has a weakness to slash.
* Talk to Jabari. 
* Jabari will teleport you into the centre of the arena, surrounding you with his clones.
** Choosing the wrong Jabari will cause an explosion that damages the player and scales with level. 
** Find the real Jabari by attacking the odd one out. As it is random for each player, it could be any of these:
*** The only one facing backwards.
*** The only one in attack position.
*** The one with the smallest sceptre.
*** The largest one of them.
*** The one targeted by the audience.
*** The one with the correctly spelled name.
*** The one with a different robe colour.
*** The one without prayer renewal particles.
*** The one who is not translucent.
* Talk to Het.
* Talk to Emir Ali Mirza, in the Al Kharid throne room. 
* After the cutscene, talk to Emir Ali Mirza again. 
* Quest complete!

* Talk to Thorvald the Warrior north of Rellekka inside Skulgrimen's Battle Gear. 
* Climb down the ladder.

* Talk to Koschei the Deathless. 
* With the Balmung in your inventory, chop down the Blossoming tree north-west of the bridge south of Rellekka.
* Take the chest from tree stump.
* Return and talk to Koschei.
* Open the chest.

* Inspect the toy ship.
* Talk to Koschei.
* Climb up the ladder and return to Rellekka.
* Go to the well south-east of the longhall.
* Use the toy ship on the well.

* Return and talk to Koschei.
* Interact with the jewel. 
* Talk to Koschei. 
* Miniquest complete!
** For additional completion, talk to Kharshai. 
** Interact blue jewel (Requires )
** Talk to Kharshai. 
** Talk to Kharshai again. 
** Interact red jewel  (Requires )
** Talk to Kharshai. 
** Repeat the steps once again but make a new memory instead (blue) and the miniquest will be completed

* Go to the Basement of Doom, located under a house west of Edgeville bank.
* Talk to Evil Dave. 
* After the cutscene, admire the mirror to the west.
* Go upstairs and talk to Doris.

* Do your chores.
** Search the wardrobe for a broom and bed bug cleaner.
** Sweep the rug.
** Search the shelf for a bar of soap.
** Wash the dishes in the sink.
** Choose the take knife option on the sink.
** Chop the vegetables.
** Go downstairs and clean your bed.
* After the cutscene go back upstairs and talk to Doris.
* Go back downstairs and search the bookcase by the stairs. 
* Search behind the boiler in the southeast corner.
* Search the drapes by the bed.
* Investigate Dave's spellbook.
* Investigate it again to teleport to the Makeover Mage. (If you interact with Dave's spellbook again and get the message "I don't need to use the spellbook right now", interact with the drapes once more and the option to teleport to Makeover Mage will appear.)

* Talk to one of the bankers and withdraw the law rune, stew, and old rug from Dave's bank.
* Talk to one of the Grand Exchange clerks. 
* Drink the stew and refill the flask from any of the water fountains around the Grand Exchange.
* Go to one of the Exchange clerks (Clark or Kent) to exchange the water flask for an air rune.

* Teleport to the makeover mage and ask to turn into a girl. .
* After you teleport back, talk to Doris. 
* Attempt to redo the following chores.
** Sweep the rug.
** Wash the dishes.
** Chop the vegetables.
* Open the door and go north to the general store and speak to the shopkeeper. 
* Return to the house and redo all the chores again.
** Sweep the rug.
** Wash the dishes.
** Chop the vegetables.
** Go downstairs and clean your bed.
* After the cutscene, go upstairs and talk to Doris
* Open the door.

* Pickup the hand-written note in front of you.
* Search the suit of armour to the west for a knight's helmet.
* Search the crates in the west for some gunpowder.
* Use the gunpowder on the helmet.
* Use the hand-written note on the helmet.
* Use the helmet with fuse on the torch on the wall.
* Get close to the guard and throw the lit decoy bomb.
* Sneak past the guards and enter the door to the tower where you will meet a drunken Sir Amik (the easiest way is to go past them once the third guard turns east).
* Talk to Sir Amik to determine you need to give him more to drink. 
* Click the barrel to open the drinks menu and wait for the on screen prompt to show which drink you need. Take the drink and talk to Amik, as soon as the drink is removed from your inventory go back to the barrel and wait for the next on screen prompt. Repeat 5 times until Amik starts a new dialogue. (If you have trouble completing this part, take a drink, drop it, take one again and before the time runs out use loot area to grab them; you will be able to stack the drinks hence having more chance to complete this part.)
* Talk to Doris.

* Redo your chores again.
** Sweep the rug.
** Wash the dishes in the sink.
** Chop the vegetables.
** Go downstairs and clean your bed.

* Talk to Felicity or Margaret the hell-rats.
** If they appear as normal hell-rats: go up the stairs for a dialogue and go back down.
* Recruit any 3 of the other hell-rats.
* Climb up the stairs to get to Shantay Pass.
* Talk to Shantay.
* Shake the coconut tree and pick up the coconut that falls out.
* Use the coconut on Shantay.
* Click the empty shell to add a hell-rat to it.
* Climb up the rope on the northeastern wall and throw the Shell-rat.
* Climb back down and try to open the Jail door. You will then hand the Coconut drink to the Shady man inside.
* Once inside, talk to him to receive a jewel.
* Search the barrel inside of the jail cell to take one.
* Talk to the border guards to exchange the jewel for a rope.
* Use the rope on the coconut tree.
* Click the barrel in your inventory to load the last hell-rat into it.
* Use the old rug (you got from the bank earlier) on the barrel.
* Roll the barrel past the Shantay pass.
* Talk to Shantay.
* Search the hole that has a slight twinkle to it.
* As a hell-rat, enter the sparkling holes. You can also hover your mouse over the holes until you spot the hole with a little rat icon [[File:Evil Dave's Big Day Out entity icon.png]] next to it. You will have to repeat this 4 times.
* Attempt to enter the mysterious entrance as a hell-rat.
* Enter the mysterious entrance.
* Grab Dave from the empty cooking range south-east.
* Select the Clean Bed option.
* Gather 5 hell-rats. If cutscene does not begin, gather the sixth hell-rat.

* Talk to Doris.
* Quest complete!

* Enter the player-owned house portal. Postie Pete will appear and give you a letter from Bill Teach.
* Read the letter. 
* Deposit all items.
* Go to the Rimmington Customs Office without any items, then talk to the Customs Sergeant. You will be sent to the Rock.

* Talk to Bill Teach about Pieces of Hate.
* Talk to Two-Eyed Eric through barred window. 
* Use the hook on the bed, then combine the cloth with the hook.
* Go outside and use the cloth-hook on the fishing spot.
* Use the fish on the perch rock to attract a seagull.
* Use the fish on the door, then use the hook on the door.
* Push the barrels by the door to block out the guards.
* Use the hook on Bill Teach's cell door.
* Search the desk and locker. Put the customs uniform on.
* Investigate the pile of crates to take a small crate.
* Use the spoon on the crate to make a trap, then use the sandwich on it to bait it.
* Use the trap on the rat hole in Bill Teach's cell. 
* Use the guard's keys on any remaining prisoner's cell door.
* Attempt to open the door in the middle of the prison (leading to the stairs).
* Talk to Madame Shih.
* Talk to Jimmy the Parrot (one of the pirates).
* Open the door in the middle of the prison (leading to the stairs).
* Investigate the poster next to the stairs, then climb the stairs wearing the customs outfit.
**If the "investigate" option doesn't appear on the bed, make sure you have checked the poster downstairs.
* Search the lockers (to the north). Use the pineapple on the puddle of slime in the corner, then use it on Wilson (the rat).
* Use Pineapple Wilson on the door to the south room.
* Enter the room and investigate the east bed to find first floor keys.
* Open the north door between the beds.
* Right-click "Use" the 'rum' on the strange egg. 
** If you drink the 'rum' accidentally, then you can get a new one from the lockers to the east. 
* Climb up the stairs to the east.
* After the cutscene, dive off the pier.
* Speak to anyone. This is the first point where you can leave the quest and save progress.

* Sit in the chair in the north-east corner of Harpoon Joe's House of 'Rum'. 
* Speak to the Zombie pirate head. 
* Go to the west of Varrock and speak to Gertrude in her house.  (or if completed Rat Catchers)
* Talk to Philop or Kanel inside Gertrude's house.
* Go to the abandoned house northwest of the apothecary in south-west Varrock and search the jiggling crate to find Wilson.

* Travel to the Karamja lodestone and head south to the beach just north of Jiminua's Jungle Store; the head will tell you to stop. 
* Talk to the head again.  A cutscene of the sunset will start.

* Prepare for combat. Return to Harpoon Joe's House of 'Rum' and return to the Interrogation Room by sitting in the north-east chair. 
* When ready for the fight, head south-west of Harpoon Joe's House of 'Rum' and row the rowboat. 
* Enter the door to the south.
* Kill all four tentacles; a cutscene follows.
* Kill Zogoth; a cutscene follows.
** Stay within melee range to avoid a typeless damage attack from the tentacles. 
** Move away from the water jet attack to avoid being pushed to the back of the boat.
** Move away from shadows when Zogoth shields itself to avoid acid spray attacks (occurs at 50% and 25% health). The acid will follow you around until the attack ends.

* Once on Mos Le'Harmless, during Rabid Jack's Invasion, the player must clear two waves of enemies.
* Wave 1 (initial attack):
** Kill the barrelchest and zombie captains at the main gate to the north and repair the barricades.
** Kill the zombie captains up the ramp (on the western wall), then help up the pirate on the wall.
** Kill the zombie captains at the south-east coast of the town, then repair the cannons and sink the zomboats.
** Kill the zombie captains at the south-west coast of the town, then repair the cannons and sink the zomboats.
* Wave 2 (next attack):
** Kill the DKS and the zombie captains at the main gate and repair the barricades.
** Kill the zombie captains up the ramp (on the western wall), then help up the pirate on the wall.
** Kill the zombie captains at the south-east coast of the town, then repair the cannons and sink the zomboats.
** Kill the zombie captains at the south-west coast of the town, then repair the cannons and sink the zomboats.
** Kill the zombie captains at river east of the town, then destroy the makeshift bridges.
** Kill the DKS and the zombie captains at the wheat field north of the town, then destroy the cannon.
** Kill the DKS and the zombie captains at the coast north-west of the town, then destroy the grounded ship. This should be done last.
*Finish the conversation with the pirates in the invasion. You will not be able to progress without doing so.

* Head to Braindeath Island via Pirate Pete north of Port Phasmatys. You can also use the pirate spell sheet  or Dungeoneering cape. 
* Head south, and down the wooden stairs. Run west along the building and up the wooden stairs on the west of the bunkroom.
* Head through the bunkroom to the east side, then north-east. Listen at the window to the room with Captain Braindeath.
* After the dialogue, head back to the bunkroom, and talk to Davey.
* Head down the wooden stairs, put on the barrelchest disguise then talk to Captain Donnie south-east. 
* Head up the nearby wooden stairs, and talk to the Barrelchest Mk I.
* Return to Captain Donnie again to learn the passphrase 
* Head back up the wooden stairs, and once again talk with the Barrelchest Mk I. 
* Remove the disguise, for speed.
* Climb the ladder in the south-east corner of the building.
* Head west, and take the Barrels of 'rum' from on top of the crate, head north and do the same again.
* Block the pressure barrel (just south-east of the second of the barrels of 'rum'), then overload the pressure lever beside it.
* Return down the ladder, and then the stairs.
* Head north-west and pass through the gate by 66.6...% Luke.
** You cannot use the dungeoneering cape teleport here to get to the north of the island.
* Head north, up the mountain to the pool (marked with [[File:Water source map icon.png]] on the minimap) and investigate the perch rock.
* Baron von Hattenkrapper will appear. Complete the dialogue, then select Unleash! 
* Guide Baron von Hattenkrapper and hit the mysterious entrance to the south-west 3 times; a cutscene follows.
* Talk with Mi-Gor, and set sail.

* Head south and equip gear from the crate of diving gear, then head north and dive into the cracked hull. 
* Head south-west, and jump off the edge.
* Head south, then west, then north to the shimmering barrier.
**EPILEPSY WARNING: If you suffer from epilepsy, talk to the shimmering kitten to prevent aggravating symptoms.
***You need to prepare for combat for the next part.
* If well-prepared for combat, pass through the shimmering barrier; a cutscene follows.
** Note: If you choose to re-gear use the rowboat in the south-west of Mos Le'Harmless to get back to the temple.

* Reduce Jack's health to 0.
** Stand at the north, south, west, east walls or doorway to avoid being damaged and stunned by the black hand in the centre of the room.
** Use Freedom or Anticipation if stunned by Jack's stun attack. Avoid running from Jack to reduce the frequency of this attack.
** Drink 'rum' from barrels in the room to reduce "insanity". Insanity is indicated by the black cat debuff icon and will cause Jack hallucinations to spawn and the camera to spin if it becomes too high. Drink as soon as the debuff icon appears.
** If you die you can return to fight Rabid Jack by travelling back to Mos Le'Harmless and taking the small rowboat.
* Loosen an ancient chain.
* Repeat this process for the 3 other chains; a cutscene follows.
* Speak with Madame Shih. 
* Sit in the chair in Harpoon Joe's House of 'Rum' 
* Talk to Bill Teach with 6 free inventory spaces; a cutscene follows.
* Quest complete!

* Talk to the hooded pirate for a crumpled note.
* Search the open chest west of Harpoon Joe's House of 'Rum' in Mos Le'Harmless for a black coin.
* Return the black coin to the hooded pirate and he'll give you another crumpled note.
* Read the note then talk to the Odd Old Man with the crumpled note to receive the rotten journal.

* Start by talking to Vannaka near the lever teleport from Edgeville, for a To-Do list. . 
* Head to Aggie's house which is north-west of the Draynor Village bank and take the broom when Aggie is not looking at you to obtain Aggie's broom (uncharged).
* Charge the uncharged broom with 100 water runes to obtain Aggie's broom.
* Head back to Edgeville and sweep four scorch marks.
* Talk to Jeffery, who is east of the bank and near a furnace, for Jeffery's hammer. 
* Fix the following buildings by getting close to the locations and selecting the first option of the hammer in your backpack. You will need to remove them from your plank box if using that to carry them.
** The house north of the bank, requiring ten mahogany planks.
** The market stall north of the bank, requiring ten planks.
** The broken window on the north side of the bank, requiring five planks and a unit of molten glass.
** Jeffery's Armoury, east of the bank, requiring five planks.
** The guard house, north-east of the bank, requiring a marble block.
** The house across River Lum, between the river and Grand Exchange, requiring ten oak planks.
* Use five bittercap mushrooms on the fairy ring south of Quercus.
* Clear the Destroyed Roof and Destroyed Wall just west of the fairy ring.
* Consecrate or desecrate the burnt skeleton north of the bank.
* Nurture four burnt trees. Any four around Edgeville work.
* Go back to Vannaka for your reward.

* Teleport to Varrock.
** If it doesn't take you to the fountain south of the palace, talk to one of the Varrock taskmasters to change its destination.
** Enter Varrock Palace, head upstairs then up the ladder to the east.
** Head west and spam click the treasury door, as it has a low success rate of lock-picking.
** Crack the three safes.
* Teleport to Draynor with an amulet of glory or teleport to Collector Wise Old Man with master archaeologist's hat .
** Crack the safe directly at the top of the Wise Old Man's stairs.
* Wizards' Tower:
** Teleport with stardust, or use the wicked hood then descend one floor.
** Crack the north-east and south-west safes.
* Edgeville:
** Teleport using any Wilderness sword or the Edgeville lodestone.
** Climb up the ladder in the Edgeville General Store, crack the safe in the south-east corner.
* Draynor Manor:
** Teleport to the Draynor lodestone or Teleport to War's retreat and exit via Portal to Draynor.
** Head through the manor doors, crack the two safes in the west room.
* Lumbridge:
** Teleport to the Lumbridge lodestone.
** Crack the safe upstairs in Bob's Brilliant Axes.
** Teleport back to the lodestone and crack the safe upstairs in the house to the north.
*** Alternatively, running back downstairs is only a second or two slower if utilising Surge and Dive and saves a quick teleport charge.

* Teleport to Seers' Village and run north-west to McGrubor's Wood (fairy ring ).
* Enter the woods through the Loose railing.
* Attempt to chop the tree 14 paces west and 6 paces south of the crate. (Slightly different colour, and near the quest marker on the minimap)
* Read the mysterious clue scroll. 
* Talk to Reldo in the library of Varrock Palace.
* Read the mysterious clue scroll again.

* Stand in the room with Duke Horacio on the of Lumbridge Castle.
* Remove all worn items, then perform the Cry and Panic emotes (in that order). You should see a cutscene if it works.
* Go to Lumbridge cemetery. Using the mysterious clue's dig option, dig one square to the north of the largest tombstone along the southern fence. You will get a locked casket. You must complete the cutscene in order to continue.
* Teleport to Port Sarim and run west to Rimmington. Enter the POH portal in Rimmington to trigger a cutscene. 
* Teleport to Draynor, run into the Draynor Manor, and head into the first door to the west after entering the building.
* Search the bookcase in the north-western part of the room to find the casket key.
* Open the locked casket to obtain an old necklace.

* Take a rope, and go back into McGrubor's Wood. Enter the railing shortcut and stand two squares south of the crate (which is south of the building).
* Dig via the old necklace.
* Inspect and then descend into the Mysterious Hole.
* Follow the path to the end and investigate the coffin for a cutscene. 
* Talk to the double agent.
* Investigate the mantle to the east for a cutscene. 
* Talk to Uri.
* Quest complete!

* Check your bank for a .
** You may obtain one from an RPDT employee in East Ardougne or by killing creatures in the jade vine maze (at least one empty backpack space is required to obtain it as a drop).
* With the hand, head to the Wizards' Guild in Yanille and ring the bell outside on the eastern side of the guild.
* Speak to Zavistic Rarve.

* Before you begin, search your bank for already-obtained body parts listed below and withdraw them now.
* Go to the Jade vine maze on Karamja.
* Kill creatures inside the maze until you receive the six body parts. These do not show up on area loot, the pieces drop in order and you must pick up the piece prior to the next drop or duplicates drop. Ensure your backpack is never full as pieces cannot drop if it is. 
** 
** 
** 
** 
** 
**

* Go back to the Wizards' Guild and ring the bell to speak to Zavistic Rarve. 
* Search Sandy's desk to receive a locked diary.
* Click on the locked diary to unlock it.
** There is a rare chance that you may trigger a trap so it is advised you do this in a safe area as it can cause over 8,000 damage.
* Return to the Wizards' Guild and ring the bell to speak to Zavistic Rarve.

* Start off using the fairy ring code or a Phoenix Lair Teleport scroll. You can also use the teleport from the memory strand in the currency pouch. Alternatively, teleport to Eagles' Peak lodestone and run north then west.
* Run west of the Piscatoris Fishing Colony until you find a house.
* Cross the water eastward over the rocks and go east to search the Needle. 
* Search the Needle to obtain the shard of the needle.
* After the cutscene investigate the body on the ground.

* Commune with the shard.
* Enter the word fire.
* Go into the house to the north-west and interact/explore the fireplace.
** For full completion, find all of the other words listed on The Needle Skips.
* Go back to where the Needle is on the hill to the south-east and enter the temporal portal.

* Commune with the shard again and enter the word birthday.
** For full completion, find all of the other words listed on The Needle Skips.
* Descend the stairs to the east and go back to the Needle.
* Enter the temporal portal.

* Commune with the shard again and enter the word wenla.
** For full completion, find all of the other words listed on The Needle Skips.
* Go back to the Needle and search it.

* Run back towards the house and harvest the buckthorn bush near the river.
* Grind and crush both the leaf and berry.
* Go upstairs in the house and give Primrose the smelling salts .
* Go back downstairs, search the bookcase to the north-east.
* Talk to Megan and name the demon 'Metum'. 
* Use the bottle of crushed berries on the stove on the west side of the house.
* Return back to the Needle and use the buckthorn salve on Gail. Finish the dialogue and you will be teleported back to the house. 
* Finish the dialogue with Megan and go back to the Needle and pick up the note from gail.
* Read the note then return to Megan inside the house.
* Quest complete!

title: Items
list:
* Crystal Pickaxe
** An unaugmented dragon pickaxe
** 4,000 harmonic dust
* Imcando pickaxe
** A gilded dragon pickaxe
*** Mine the crust in the Lava Flow Mine in Keldagrim to fill the progress bar.
**** Talk to Foreman Jaak and observe which lane he says is blocked.
**** Go to that lane (refer to this image) and run north-south along the lane to find the segment with 50% flow and mine it.
**** When the segment moves, talk to Foreman Jack and repeat the process.
*** When the progress bar is filled, the Liquid Gold Nymph will appear and give a piece of the golden mining outfit (if not owned) when talked to.
*** Repeat the above process until all pieces of the outfit have been received. The nymph will finally offer to gild the dragon pickaxe.
**** When she asks if the players want to take the pickaxe on the tool belt, select "No" and then "use" the dragon pickaxe on her.
** All 4 Imcando pickaxe fragments.
*** Carry magic weaponry and runes for any water spell, along with the highest tier pickaxe.
*** Enter the Lava Flow Mine in Keldagrim and walk around the entire mine to find a lava geyser.
**** Hop worlds until the players find one.
*** When the players find a geyser, attack it with water spells until it turns into a solid rock.
*** Mine the solid rock to obtain an imcando pickaxe fragment.
*** Repeat the above process until all 4 pieces are obtained.
** 1,000,000 Coins
** A redberry pie
* A blast fusion hammer

* Talk to Violet found on the southern tip of White Wolf Mountain. 
* Enter the Land of Snow portal.

* Run north towards Violet and a cutscene will ensue.
* Dodge snowballs and run up the hill. You can run straight up the far east side (or far west side) of the hill and avoid getting hit by any snowballs. If you cannot make it and get hit enough, eventually, it will ask if you want to make it easier. 
* Talk to Violet.
* Knock on the door. 
* Talk to Trevor or Betty. 
* Talk to Violet in the room to the north.
* Violet requests an object based on the starting letter five times. Search various objects around the room and bring her items that begin with the letter she requested.

* Talk to Trevor or Betty.
* Exit the building. 
* Investigate the frozen bucket for an empty bucket.
* Investigate a maple tree two times to receive maple logs.
** Investigate the logs to make a spile. 
* Use the spile on the maple tree.
* Use the empty bucket on the same maple tree to receive a bucket of syrup.
* Walk north, and check four leaning trees along the path.
* Talk to Trevor to receive the firefly jar. 
* Shake multiple bushes and catch 10 fireflies. They may be difficult to see if playing on low graphics. To make this easier, right click the globe near your mini-map to toggle high contrast mode. This will make the fireflies stand out easier.
* Talk to Violet.

* Talk to Violet.
* Take icy snow from behind Violet. 
* Click on the headless golems (spam clicking works) and put all 15 heads on.
* Talk to Violet.

* Collect 75 snowballs at the pile of snow to the south.
* Continually search the abandoned crate for 3 carrots, 3 top hats, 21 coal.
* Prune a tree to the west three times for 6 branches.
* Build all melted snowmen (24 Construction XP), then talk to Violet after each snowman.
* Walk north.

* Reach into the icy water on the south-east shore to obtain a barrel.
* Talk to Violet.
* Navigate the ice maze while pushing Violet as shown in the diagram. You may move diagonally.
** The controls require precision, best to rotate your camera to give a birds eye view (top down) when trying to move diagonal. It may be helpful to think of a 3x3 square when moving diagonally, with the player character in the centre.

* Hunt for 3 memories (having sound turned on helps a lot here). 
** Move your mouse around until the orange circle rapidly pulses THREE times per second on a location, and click, as this is a correct spot. There are three speeds--you want to click at the fastest, highest-pitched ping. Repeat until all three memories are recovered.
** If only half the memory is recovered, you did not do this step correctly and as a result an unabridged tome will not be awarded, you can lobby to restart the saga.
** A pinging sound will play if game sounds are turned on: a slow hum (level 1), a moderately fast ping (level 2, indicating you are close to the correct position), and a fast, high-frequency ping that plays ~2 times a second. This is the correct location for full memory retrieval.
** The correct location does not always correspond to the centre of a memory you can see. It can also be an empty space.

1:
* Step on the portals until a room with a chest unlocks.
** If the room has a note on a recipe: If the amount of each & every ingredient can be represented with a single Roman numeral (e.g. 1000g of Bacon = "M"), those are the code. If not, the code is the first letter of each ingredient.
*** Note: Roman numerals for some of the steps below: 1=I, 5=V, 10=X, 50=L, 100=C, 500=D, 1,000=M.
** If the room has 4 random items, the code for the chest is the first letter of each item (e.g. Plank, Jute Fibres, Catfish and Diamond Bolt). Order is starting from farthest item from the chest to the closest item to the chest. If this doesn't work, try the letters in the opposite order.
** If the room has coins on the ground examine each pile, the code is the number of coins in each pile. Go clockwise, as represented in Roman numerals (e.g. 500 coins = "D").
** If there is a plaque next to the room's door, the code is the first letter of each lodestone name depicted (e.g. Lumbridge, Falador, Draynor Village and Varrock).
** If the room has only one item on the ground with a four-letter word in its name, the combination is those four letters. (e.g. Beer = BEER or Swordfish = FISH).
** If the room has a clean herb on the ground, the combination is HERB.
* When the chest is unlocked, note the order of the icons.
* Repeat for as many chests as needed until you have the full solution.
* Rearrange the slide puzzle in the middle to match the icons seen from the chests. (North side is up. If you accidentally did the puzzle upside down, just rotate the outer pieces until they are in place.)
* Step on the exit portal to the west.
