* A cutscene will follow. 
* Return to Kharid-et, talk to Azzanadra at the praetorium war table to complete the quest.
** You need 3 free backpack spaces upon quest completion for the experience lamps rewarded.

* Unlock Anachronia base camp and set the workers to gather all types of resources. Players need 50,000 of all resources types to unlock a single skilling station.
* Complete the Extinction quest.
* Enter the Dream of Iaia and create any skilling station. Then skill using the skilling stations.
* Once players have exhausted the stored XP in the skilling stations, they need to wait until the Anachronia workers gather more resources to restock the skilling stations. The Advance Time spell can be used to generate extra resources.
* Return to the Dream of Iaia and restock the skilling stations using the newly gathered resources.
* Continue skilling for a chance to get the necklace. It may take anywhere between 1-50 hours of skilling to obtain the necklace, as per player reports.

* Talk to Ali the Wise or Wizard Trindy found north west of the mysterious monolith (Archaeology Guild). 
* Move Thaerisk Cemphier, Commander Zilyana, and Helwyr south-west of the barricade.
* Press the start button to begin the battle.

* Talk to Ali the Wise.
* Move Helwyr and Nex just inside the southern barricade.
* Move Zilyana and Thaerisk just inside the northern barricade.
* Start the battle.

* Talk to Wizard Trindy or Ali the Wise. 
* Head to the Fight Kiln and enter it. 
* Return to the Archaeology Guild and talk to Ali the Wise again. 
* Move Helwyr and Commander Zilyana just outside the northern barricade of the Gower farm.
* Move Thaerisk and Nex just outside the southern barricade of the Gower Farm.
* Move the 3 TokHaar just outside the Varrock east gate.
* Start the battle.

* Talk to Ali the Wise.
* Move Helwyr to the southern barricade.
** Helwyr is located west of the south barriers.
* Move Thaerisk and Nex to the crossroads outside Varrock's east gate. (Sometimes an enemy can slip the crossroads defence and start attacking the north-western barricade.)
** Nex is located south-east of Varrock.
* Move Commander Zilyana to the northern barricade.
* Start the final battle.
* Talk to Ali the Wise for a cutscene.

* Talk to Ariane at the entrance to the Heart of Gielinor and enter the Elder Halls. 
* Talk to Charos. Go through all chat options about what to do with the eggs. 
* Talk to Azzanadra, after which a cutscene will play. 
* Talk to Charos and Ariane. 
* Go to the Archaeology Guild, upstairs onto the balcony. Talk to Dr Nabanik. 
* Teleport to Port Sarim lodestone and go north-west to the Armadyl's tower teleporter to teleport up to Armadyl's Tower. Climb to the top and talk to Armadyl.
* Go to Burthorpe Castle and climb up the stone staircase. 
* Talk to Icthlarin south-east of the table.
* Talk to Seren west of the table.
* Talk to Moia south of the table. 
* Talk to Zamorak. 
* Go to the throne room on the (east side) of the White Knights' Castle and talk to Saradomin. 
* Return to Dr Nabanik on the balcony of the main building at the Archaeology Guild.

* Enter the City of Senntisten through the ancient door to the north of the Archaeology Guild. 
* Excavate the forum entrance. (Use your grace of the elves charges to move the materials to the material storage container if you have it. Porters also work.)
* Interact with the pedestal to obtain Pontifex Maximus figurine (damaged).
* Exit via the pulley. 
* Talk to Intern Jimmy at the entrance to get materials.
* Restore the Pontifex Maximus figurine at an archaeologist's workbench. (The one south by the guild is closest.)
* Return to Azzanadra, and interact with the pedestal to place the artefact upon it.
* Follow Azzanadra to the cathedral, and speak with him. (You may go directly to the cathedral and wait for him.) 
** Alternatively, you can turn off run energy and click on him once, following him all the way to the cathedral.
* Search the bookcases, chests, crates, and pews in the cathedral, including the upstairs balconies, for a light globe (see map below). 
* Talk to Azzanadra.
* Pass through the western cathedral door.

* Within the city, put light globes on the light pedestals to illuminate the immediate area. When outside of an illuminated area, you will receive stacks of Shadows of the Empire debuff. The more stacks you have, the more damage you are dealt. Standing in an illuminated area will remove stacks of the debuff. This includes stepping into houses with lights. The ward only dims the light from the globes.
* Light globes will persist when teleporting out and additional light globes are spread through the west district of the city. You don't need to obtain all light globes to complete the quest, so it may be more beneficial to juggle them as you explore new areas.
* See the map for ward and objective locations.

* Blood ward
** Head to the blood bank (north-western building in southern section).
** Inspect the blood bottle by the interior door leading to the blood ward.
** Search the old desk.
** Search the pile of books on the table near the entrance.
** Head north to the marketplace and enter the southern house south of the colosseum gateway.
*** The correct house is marked with Bloodied Note on the map. 
** Search the ransacked desk near the chimney for the Blood Bank Ledger.
** Return to the blood bank.
** Search the shelves for bottles of blood:
*** Bottle of blood (human)
*** Bottle of blood (unicorn)
*** Bottle of blood (dragon)
*** Bottle of blood (aviansie)
** Be prepared for a dangerous boss fight immediately after finishing the puzzle. The Blood Warden will heal from any damage-over-time abilities. Additionally, its special attack will cause it to heal over time.
** Inspect the blood bottle to start the puzzle, and add blood:
*** 2/8 human blood
*** 3/8 unicorn blood
*** 1/8 dragon blood
*** 2/8 aviansie blood
** Kill the Blood Warden
** Take the ward from the pedestal.
** Activate the blood bottle near the door to exit.
** Talk to Azzanadra with the ward. 
* Ice ward
** Go down two flights of stairs from the cathedral to the west, then enter to the house immediately to the south.
** Take the ice ward from the pedestal.
** Go back to the cathedral and talk to Azzanadra with the ward. 
* Shadow ward
** Ensure you have enough healing ability with you as you will take a lot of damage while returning the shadow ward. Each open house is to lower said stacks of damage.
** Go to the northern-most building, where the ward is located, and head upstairs.
** Take the journal on the desk to get the Inquisition Profiles.
** Read the Inquisition Profiles and complete the dialogue. 
** Open the marked drawers as below. Start from the bottom and work your way up or zoom in for ease.
** Head downstairs and take the ward from the pedestal.
** Return to Azzanadra as fast as possible. Be prepared to take a lot of damage. Using a powerburst of acceleration will make this easier.
** Talk to Azzanadra with the ward. 
* Smoke ward
** The smoke ward can be found in the large building directly south of the ice ward on the map. As you approach an animation with gargoyle sentinels should play.
** Find and smash the stones to reveal the gargoyles sentinels. Smash them manually to complete the final blow, or automatically if relevant perk is available.
*** Directly outside the arsenal, the building with the ward.
*** Further west and south of the first, in a clearing in front of a house door.
*** To the north in the market, the square containing the market stalls.
*** West of the market, slightly south of the colosseum gateway.
** Return to the arsenal and take the ward from the pedestal.
** Talk to Azzanadra with the ward.
* Talk to Azzanadra and complete the dialogue.

* Make sure you are wearing your ring of visibility and your ghostspeak amulet.
* Speak to the Mysterious ghost near Glarial's tombstone northwest of the Fishing Guild. 
* This ghost will give you one of three clues which determine your entire route, which we will label Sequence 1, 2, and 3:
** Sequence 1 - He mentions pirates and a shipwreck.
** Sequence 2 - He mentions the thief being north-east of there.
** Sequence 3 - He mentions the thief being south-east of there.

* Make your way and speak to Rennard in the location given in the table above to receive Ghostly gloves. 
* Make your way and speak to Kharrim in the location given in the table above to receive Ghostly boots. 
* Make your way and speak to Lennissa in the location given in the table above to receive Ghostly robe bottom. 
* Make your way and speak to Dhalak in the location given in the table above to receive Ghostly hood. 
* Make your way and speak to Viggora in the location given in the table above to receive Ghostly cloak. 
* Miniquest complete!
* Talk to Dr Nabanik near the bank chest at Kharid-et Dig Site. He will "loan" you any of the spell scrolls that you are unable to obtain.

* Head into the prison block section of the dig site. 
*Enter the eastern door which leads to the solitary confinement area.
** If you haven't completed Time Served but you have the repaired artefact in your inventory, then just inspect the ancient mechanism to the North. Insert the artefact and then the eastern door will open.
*Go down to the southern end of the corridor, there will be an inactive dial on the west wall, just before the last empty room.
* Cast an 'Incite Fear' spell scroll whilst standing next to the dial.
* Press the ice button and enter the vault 
* Pick up the praetor's log page 1 and right click Transcribe.

* NE, E, NE', SW', S, S
* SE, SE, C, N'
* S', W, NW

* Head to the Main Fortress of the Kharid-et Dig Site (first room) and go to the south-east corner (the chapel).
* Pass the Pontifex barrier and find the inactive dial on the northern wall, directly north of the Orcus altar.
* Cast a 'Exsanguinate' spell scroll whilst standing next to the dial.
* Press the Blood button and enter the vault

* SW', C, NW, NW, SW'
* C', C', NE, SE, C'
* NE', NE', C', C', NE'
* C', SW', SE, C, SE
* C, SE, SW, C, SW'
* C, C

* Return to the main fortress of the Kharid-et Dig Site and go directly north of the Pontifex barrier, by the oven.
* Find the inactive dial on the wall immediately west of the oven.
* Cast a 'Smoke Cloud' spell scroll whilst standing next to the dial.
* Press the smoke button and enter the vault

* 5', 2, 7', 3, 3, 4' - Top row complete (all pink)
* 2, 7', 2'
* 1, 1, 8', 1', 1'
* 3, 3, 8, 3, 3 - Second row complete (all red)
* 7', 4, 8, 4' - Puzzle complete

* Return to the Main Fortress of the Kharid-et Dig Site and enter the war room by clicking the praetorium war table (middle of the Main Fortress)
* Find the inactive dial on the western wall in the small western room.
* Cast an 'Animate Dead' spell scroll whilst standing next to the dial.
* Press the Shadow button and enter the vault

* Pick up the shadow engrammeter (depleted) from the centre of the vault.
* Collect 500 divination memories (vibrant tier or higher). Recharge the Shadow engrammeter when you have an inventory full of memories to charge it. Enriched memories count as double.
* Return to the centre of the vault via any of the dials and Operate the engrammeter.
* Take Trindine's memory to Dr Nabanik. 
** You will receive the memory as a book, and be granted 25,000 Divination experience.
* Return to the vault using any of the dials.
* Speak to Praetor Trindine in the centre. This will complete The Vault of Shadows mystery.
** If the shadow anchors weren't activated, or Pylon isn't active, you will need to wear a ring of visibility or have the ability to permanently see the Shadow Realm.
* Return to and speak to Dr Nabanik.
* Speak to him again after the cutscene.

* Excavate and restore the four elemental types of funerary urns (smoke, shadow, blood and ice).
* Find Inquisitor's Memoirs page 1 and page 2 and talk to the intern Jimmy.
** Page 3 and page 4 are not required, despite page 4 giving the names.
* Activate any statue in Senntisten. For example, within the cathedral or next to the colosseum gateway. This consumes the urns. 
* Talk to the intern Jimmy.
* Go to Inquisition Headquarters north-east of the Nodon Front. The headquarters are just east of the inquisitor remains excavation hotspots. Climb up the stairs.
* Complete the drawers puzzle by opening the drawers BC, E, M, R, T, UV, and WX. When solved, the opened drawers form a smiley face.

* Board the Stormbreaker on the west side of River Salve at the Varrock Dig Site.
** You may teleport to Varrock or to the Archaeology Campus.

* Complete the intro animations until you wind up at the landing zone.
* Follow the directions on the map and investigate the bones blocking your path.
* After investigating the second bones, you will be teleported to the base camp.

* Talk to Giles in the base camp to begin the tutorial.
* Assign at least one worker to gather wood, vines and stone respectively on the base camp management interface.
* Continue talking to Giles to skip the wait.
* When the base camp management interface appears again, build the Town Hall.
* Congratulations, tutorial complete!

* Manage base camp with Giles in the Town Hall on the eastern side of the base camp. Alternatively, you may attempt to build Anachronia lodestone to open the interface.
* Unassign workers and assign 10 workers to gather clay.
* Wait for about 20 minutes. You may do anything during this period but you need to board the Stormbreaker to Anachronia if you leave the island.
* Manage base camp with Giles again.
* Once your workers have collected adequate materials, build the lodestone.

title: Rifts
list:
* Next to Icthlarin.
* North-east of the oasis. Don’t use agility course.
* South-east of the oasis.
* In the middle peninsula behind Het's statue; run across the first two fallen palm trees in the agility course. Do not climb up the pillar, as you will have to do another lap to return.
* Talk to Icthlarin at the entrance to Het's Oasis.

* Clear the fallen masonry at points along the agility course. If you have already cleared it, this will be mentioned in the chat and you can start closing the rifts.
** At the start of the course.
** At the bottom of the rope ladder next to the Statue of Het.
** On a walkway on the eastern side of the course.
** At the end of a walkway further along the southern-most part of the course to the west.
* Finish the course or teleport back to the Het's Oasis. A ring of duelling is the fastest teleport method back.
* Talk to Icthlarin.

* Close the rifts around Het's Oasis. They must be cleared in this particular order. (When closing a rift, it will direct you to the next one. Alternatively, refer to the map here.)
** Next to Icthlarin.
** North-eastern corner of the Het's Oasis.
** South-eastern corner of the Het's Oasis.
** Behind the statue of Het in the middle of Het's Oasis. (Can do the agility course to get there.)
* Finish the agility course or teleport back to the Het's Oasis with a ring of duelling.

* Talk to Icthlarin again 
* Stabilise the three unstable rifts that spawn.
* Talk to Icthlarin after stabilising the rifts.
* Pry the hidden door at the back of the statue of Het.
** Right-clicking the door brings up two options. Ensure you click just below the statue.
** Choose "Pry open hidden door".
* If you have completed Our Man in the North and have level 80 Strength, the Eye of Het can be found in the statue's left hand inside the tomb. Take the eye.
** If you don't meet these requirements, the relic will simply be placed into your inventory upon attempting to enter.
* Talk to Icthlarin at the entrance of Het's Oasis. Talking to Icthlarin at Het's statue does not work.
** Note: If you encounter a bug where Icthlarin says you still need to find the relic after you have obtained it, either teleport out or log out and back in and talk to Icthlarin near the bonfire.
* Quest complete!
* Talk to Icthlarin at the entrance to Het's Oasis.

* Talk to the stranger near the tents north-east of the oasis.
* Search the chest just outside of the tent with the bank chest to find some badly-hidden notes.
* Read the badly-hidden notes.
** Make sure to proceed through all the dialogue, or you won't be able to progress.
* Talk to Azzanadra at the Glacor Front (south of the cathedral in Senntisten). 
** Wearing the shard of Erebus will keep glacors from attacking along the way.
** You can teleport to Arch-Glacor (and Azzanadra) using an attuned boss portal at War's Retreat, or by using the grouping system.
* Head to the cathedral and talk to the gods. (You can use the pontifex shadow ring to teleport directly to the cathedral.)
** Talk to Seren. 
** Talk to Zamorak. 
** Talk to Armadyl. 
** Talk to Saradomin.

* Attempt to talk to Trindine in the following locations.
** At the northern entrance to the cathedral.
** West near Nex at the stairs near the Nodon Front.
** South beside Helwyr at the Glacor Front.
** East over the bridge at the Croesus Front. 
** North of the Senntisten Dig Site's archaeologist's workbench. 
* Talk to any god in the cathedral. (Select who you want to accuse)
* Talk to Azzanadra. (If the player logs out or teleports out during this sequence, they can speak to Azzanadra at the Glacor Front to resume it.)
* Talk to Icthlarin at the entrance to Het's Oasis again.

* Talk to Moia or Hebe outside of Senntisten, north of the Archaeology Guild. 
* Enter Senntisten via the ancient door. 
* Kill 12 TzekHaar monsters.
* Enter the cathedral door to the south.
* Talk to Moia.

* Head out of the cathedral to the east and continue east to the Croesus Front.
* Remove each fungus from the skilling node; Croesus will use mechanics from the boss fight in the following order: Yellow Smoke, Stun, Green Smoke, Blue Smoke, Slime, Red Smoke.
** You may want to bring either super restore potions or the runes for Crystal Mask.
*** If your stats get too low, Gorvek will save you by teleporting you back to the cathedral. Your fungus removal progress will be saved.
** Fishing
** Woodcutting
** Mining
** Hunter
* Return to the cathedral and talk to Saradomin. You can't teleport back, but you can lobby and re-enter Senntisten.

* Head out of the cathedral to the south. Pass through the barrier and talk to Azzanadra. This is an unsafe death.
* Light the braziers following the combinations below, after lighting, enter the portal and kill the generating glacors. You can ignore the glacytes.
** Food is advised as whilst lighting the braziers the Arch-Glacor will use similar mechanics from the boss fight.
** Light only the east brazier, then enter portal to kill the glacor.
** Extinguish the east brazier and light only the middle brazier, then enter portal to kill the glacor.
** Extinguish the middle brazier and light only the west brazier, then enter portal to kill the glacor.
** Lastly, light both the west and middle braziers, then enter portal and kill the glacor.
* Return to the Cathedral and talk to Saradomin. You can lobby to get there faster.

* Head out of the Cathedral to the west and command the abandoned siege engine.
** Click attack on each of the siege engines to destroy them, and for the two at the back, click on the floor nearby.
** Repeat this a few times until you enter another dialogue with Kerapac.
** After the dialogue, kill the remaining siege engines.
* Return to the Cathedral and talk to Seren.

* Talk to Moia. 
* Retrieve the Measure.
** If the quest Fate of the Gods is not done or if The Measure is lost, upon finishing dialogue with Vicendithas (see below), visit Mr Mordaut east of the Anachronia lodestone to reclaim it, the quest does not need to be completed. If option does not exist, talk to Vicendithas in the Effigy Incubator Lab and try again. 
** Alternatively, teleport to the World Gate and travel to the Elder Halls where it can be picked up from the north of where you teleport in.
* Teleport to the Anachronia lodestone, and head north to the Effigy Incubator laboratory.
* Enter the door under the Dragonkin statue. 
* Do the following once inside the Effigy Incubator area:
** Talk to Vicendithas.
** Talk to Vicendithas again to give him the Measure.
** Talk to Hannibus.
** Talk to Vicendithas.
** Talk to Hannibus again.
** Talk to Vicendithas again.
** Wait a moment and talk to Vicendithas again.
** Activate the communication device and talk to Moia. 
** Talk to Vicendithas.

* Go to the World Gate and talk to Moia (or one of the other NPCs). 
** Closest teleport is Sixth-Age circuit or Eagles' Peak lodestone.
;Tarddiad
* Enter the World Gate to Tarddiad and do the following once inside:
** Talk to Hannibus (or one of the other NPCs).
*Investigate the three resonating crystals:
** First crystal: to the south-east, next to Vicendithas.
** Second crystal: just north-east of the first, next to Adrasteia and Moia.
** Third crystal: in the Stone Gazebo, west of the previous crystal.
* Talk to Vicendithas (or one of the other NPCs) to the north over the bridge.
;Naragun
* Talk to Moia (or one of the other NPCs) and then enter the World Gate to Naragun and do the following:
** Talk to Hannibus (or one of the other NPCs) just inside the World Gate.
** Continue up the path and talk to Adrasteia or Hannibus.
** Continue along the path and talk to Vicendithas or Moia.
** Continue to the end of the path and talk to Adrasteia (or one of the other NPCs).
* Exit Naragun using the World Gate.
** Talk to Moia (or one of the other NPCs).
;Kethsi
* Enter the World Gate to Kethsi and do the following:
** Continue the dialogue with Kerapac. 
;Freneskae
* Enter the World Gate again to Freneskae and do the following:
** Talk to Adrasteia (or one of the other NPCs). 
** Descend ledge to the north. 
** Talk to Hannibus (or one of the other NPCs).
** Exit rock face to the west.

* Approach the dark portal.
* Descend the ledge to the north again. 
* Talk to Hannibus (or one of the other NPCs).
* Exit rock face again. 
* Talk to Moia (or one of the other NPCs) and a cutscene will play.

* When you are ready to start, approach dark portal. 
* Mine the two shadow animica rocks and crush the resulting shadow animica for a total of 8% attunement. (8% total attunement.)
* Capture the two motes of shadow anima for 8% attunement. (16% total attunement.)
* Enter the rift in the east.
* Capture the skittish mote of shadow anima for 4% attunement. (20% total attunement; you now move slightly faster.)
* Capture the telekinetic soul remnant.
* Return back to the initial area.
* Levitate the boulder using the enduring soul remnant.
* Move the boulder out of the way to open the way north.
* Mine the shadow animica rock and crush the resulting shadow animica for 4% attunement. (24% total attunement.)
* Capture the abyssal soul remnant.
* Use the abyssal soul remnant to enter the rift in the south.
* Capture the regular and skittish motes of shadow anima for 8% attunement. (32% total attunement.)
* Leave via the extra action button or wait for the time to expire

* Re-enter Erebus and re-obtain the abyssal soul remnant. The following must be done without exiting, so you may wish to re-enter again after obtaining the remnant to guarantee you have enough time.
* Capture the telekinetic soul remnant.
* Use the abyssal soul remnant to enter the rift in the west.
* Capture the regular and skittish motes of shadow anima for 8% attunement. (40% total attunement; you may now stay for a minute and 15 seconds at a time without the handicap.)
* Levitate the boulder using the enduring soul remnant.
* Move the boulder out of the way to open the way east.
* Mine the shadow animica rock and crush the resulting shadow animica for 4% attunement. (44% total attunement.)
* Capture the two regular and one skittish mote of shadow anima for 12% attunement. (56% total attunement.)
* Leave via the extra action button or wait for the time to expire

* Re-enter Erebus and re-obtain the abyssal and enduring soul remnants. The following must be done without exiting, so you may wish to re-enter again after obtaining the remnants to guarantee you have enough time.
* Use the abyssal soul remnant to enter the rift in the west.
* Levitate the boulder using the enduring soul remnant.
* Move the boulder on one of the three circles on the timeworn lodestone in the east.
* Return to the initial area and capture another telekinetic soul remnant.
* Return to the area with the three circles and levitate the boulder (which has an abyssal soul remnant underneath) using the enduring soul remnant.
* Move the boulder to another of the circles of the timeworn lodestone.
* Capture the revealed abyssal soul remnant.
* Use the abyssal soul remnant to enter the rift in the east.
* Capture the mote of shadow anima for 4% attunement. (60% total attunement; you may now run.)
* Capture the telekinetic soul remnant.
* Return to the previous area.
* Levitate the remaining boulder using the enduring soul remnant.
* Move the boulder to the last circle on the timeworn lodestone.
* Go on top of the timeworn lodestone. You will be teleported to an island and find the relic of the titans. Carrying this causes the western rift in the initial area to be active when entering Erebus, and automatically moves the three boulders on timeworn lodestone when entering any rifts.
* Mine the shadow animica rock and crush the resulting shadow animica for 4% attunement. (64% total attunement.)
* Capture the mote of shadow anima for 4% attunement. (68% total attunement.)
* Leave via the extra action button or wait for the time to expire

* Re-enter Erebus and re-obtain the abyssal and enduring soul remnants. The following must be done without exiting, so you may wish to re-enter again after obtaining the remnants to guarantee you have enough time.
* Navigate back to the island through the timeworn lodestone, ensuring you still have the soul remnants.
* Use the dark shadow anima bridge to traverse to the next island. (The anima bridges are one-way only.)
* Capture the two motes of shadow anima for 8% attunement. (76% total attunement.)
* Levitate the boulder next to the Boiling Rift using the enduring soul remnant.
* Move the boulder to open the way to the inactive rift.
* Enter the rift using the abyssal soul remnant.
* Mine the shadow animica rock and crush the resulting shadow animica for 4% attunement. (80% total attunement; you may now stay for a minute and 30 seconds at a time without the handicap.)
* Capture the two motes of shadow anima for 8% attunement. (88% total attunement.)
* Use the dark shadow anima bridge to traverse to the next island.
* Capture the three motes of shadow anima for 12% attunement. (100% total attunement.)
* Harvest the font of unimaginable memories to receive an unimaginable memory.
* Re-enter Erebus and re-obtain an abyssal soul remnant.
* Navigate back to the Boiling Rift.
* Give the unimaginable memory to the Boiling Rift to transform it into a soul geyser.
* Activate the soul geyser to travel to the next island.
* Use the abyssal soul remnant to activate the inactive rift and travel through it.
* Activate the Idol of the Leviathan.
* A cutscene will play.

* Talk to Moia (or one of the other NPCs).
* Take the 5 needle shards on the floor.
* Talk to Hannibus.
* Descend ledge to the north. 
* Talk to Hannibus (or one of the other NPCs). 
* Teleport through the portal.
* Talk to Moia (or one of the other NPCs).
* Talk to Elder Chahoua to the south.
* Talk to the Pastkeeper (north of Elder Chahoua, next to Hannibus).
* Talk to the Plantkeeper (north of Seren).
** Take 4 different seeds from around Iaia.
*** Just north-east of the Plantkeeper - flowering marsh plant.
*** West of the Plantkeeper - roundleaf marsh plant (slightly south and before the path continues west).
*** South-west of the Plantkeeper - marsh-fire plant.
*** Just east of Elder Chahoua - longleaf marsh plant.
** Talk to the Plantkeeper.
* Talk to the Pondkeeper (north-east of the Plantkeeper).
** Catch 4 fish in the fishing spot just north.
** Talk to the Pondkeeper.
* Talk to the Craftmaster (south-east of the Pondkeeper).
** Collect the 3 Ilujankan tools nearby to the east.
** Talk to the Craftmaster.

* This is the final boss fight. Deaths are unsafe, so focus on surviving.
** Each phase serves as a checkpoint, so if you teleport or die during the fight, you will resume from the start of the phase you left off at.
** Re-gear if necessary and teleport back to the World Gate to resume, . Enter the World Gate twice.
* Talk to Moia.
* Talk to Seren.
* Talk to Vicendithas.
* Place 2 Needle shards on any of the marked spots.
** Kill the small shadows that spawn to gain a light core.
** Attack the Dark Lord while having a light core in your inventory and repeat.
** After the Dark Lord is dead, move the unstable energy to the Light Lord until it also dies.
* Place another Needle shard on any marked spot.
** Kill the Small, Large, and Enraged muspahs; after each wave, damage Mah's Core (Mah wisp).
*** Avoid the fire walls (magic damage), lightning and fire balls (typeless damage).

The stone spirits will be consumed, but no ore will be obtained during this process. You can inspect the ensouled moonstone to check progress. To make it require less effort, use a perfect plus potion or perfect juju mining potion. If you haven't completed the Everything is Oresome achievement by mining 100 of each of the same rocks, you may want to continue mining until you reach 100 of each of the following ores.
**** Mine copper rocks to consume 50 copper stone spirits. One place to do this is the Varrock south-east mine for proximity to the lodestone and also so you can mine tin, mithril, and adamantite in one place.

Earth and Song only needs to be wielded on the swing that receives the ore. Primal stone spirits are not required to progress but will speed up the process by a minimum of 2x. The Paradox spell can also be used to speed up the process by up to 2.5x (up to a combined 3.5x if using both stone spirits and paradox). A maximum of 500 stone spirits can be used with some coming back if using the perfect plus potion or perfect juju mining potion. Dwarven ramhammers set to double damage will speed up the process, but at the cost of any experience gained. A primal ore box is recommended to store the primal ores. ** Begin the encounter. Staying south of the moonstone conduits will make learning The Gate of Elidinis encounter easier.

This will spawn pillars to help the player jump up to The Gate of Elidinis, consuming all the cleansed statue shards on them and applying a damage bonus depending on how quick the player performed all the jumps. Corruption stacks decrease by the amount of cleansed statue shards consumed with the jump.
** Stand within Icthlarin's protective shield after performing all the jumps. Icthlarin's shield will mitigate the incoming attack. The attack also depletes all the barrier strength from the moonstone conduits.
** Keep collecting cleansed statue shards by transmuting corrupt shards of Elidinis and mining cleansed shards of Elidinis, using the action button as needed, repairing the moonstone conduits as needed, and clicking on summoned feline akhs to throw moonstone fragments at them.

title: Items to inspect
list:
* Talking to Zoob, you learned that the star sprites have been using their shooting stars a lot lately.
* Inspecting all three mysterious decays (one on the north of the main island, one on the south, and one on the north-easternmost island), you learned that parts of the planet are dying. (Essential)
* Talking to Rox (south-east on main island), you learned that star sprites only eat for leisure.
* Attempting to enter the cave entrance on the west side of the main island, you learned there is a cave in the centre of the planet. (Essential)
* Giving Zag (in a small room on the south-east side of the main island) a large starbloom picked from the small island immediately south-east of the main island, you learned that star sprites consider starblooms a delicacy.
* Talking to Glorp (north side on main island), you learned that the star sprites have visited many worlds on their stars.
* Investigating the rocky bed in a house south-east of Wizard Rosalina, you learned that star sprites like to snack on their bedding.
* Inspecting the hollowed-out star on the southernmost island, you learned that a shooting star is worth more than a partyhat.
* Lifting the woven rug in the southernmost house and talking to Nuub, you learned that the cave is where their power source can be found. (Essential)
* Having learned from the cave entrance and by talking to Blip (Blip is standing next to Rosalina), you learned the cave is their previous elder's resting place. (Essential)
* Looking at the glowing crystal in the northernmost house and talking to Fuz, you learned that the star sprites have dinner parties by crystal-light.
* Talking to Eetee or Zorb on the south-west island, you learned that shooting stars can fit multiple star sprites in them.

* Northern island
* North-west side of the main island, near Glorp, west of the mysterious decay
* East side of the main island, south of the meteorites
* South side of the main island (next to the southern ledge)
* South-eastern island

* Talk to the crashed star west of the Piscatoris Fishing Colony. 
* Mine the crashed star and finish the dialogue.

* Go to the south side of the of the Wizard's Tower and talk to Wizard Rosalina. 
*: Players can quickly teleport to her with stardust.
* Return to the crashed star west of Piscatoris.
* Talk to Wizard Rosalina to hand her your cosmic and astral runes and the Wizard Blizzard drink. Finish the cutscene.
* Head to the desert goebie camp, north-west of Menaphos.
*: Players can use Leela's favour to get to the Merchant District (option 2) and exit through the north Menaphos gate.
* Talk to Wizard Chambers. 
* Return to the Piscatoris crash site and talk to Wizard Chambers or Wizard Rosalina.
* Talk to them again.
* Shoo away fireflies to keep them away from the crashed star until the portal progress at the top of your screen reaches 50.
* Talk to them again.

* Teleport to Zolarea with the portal.
* Unequip any items in your main/off-hand slots and jump the rocky edge to the east.
* Fly to the large island to the east and jump to the rocky edge to land.
*: Players can Surge and Dive during flight.
* Head to the giant crystal towards the centre and talk to Wizard Rosalina. 
* Jump the rocky edge on the northernmost side of the main island.
* Head to the north-easternmost island and inspect the mysterious decay.
* Return to the main island and then inspect the mysterious decay south of the rocky edge and west of the flower patch.
* Attempt to enter the cave entrance to the west of the giant crystal. (1/12)
* Head to the south side of the main island and inspect the mysterious decay (2/12), then talk to Rox. (3/12)
* Head west to the southernmost house and lift the woven rug, then talk to Nuub. (4/12)
* Talk to Blip near Wizard Rosalina. (5/12)
* Talk to Wizard Rosalina. 
*: If the necessary chat options display "???", you missed a clue.
*: If done correctly, you receive a wrinkly scroll.

* Head to the observatory west of Tree Gnome Village and north of Castle Wars.
*: The fastest teleport is 'Chipped' Watchtower teleport made by Dave's spellbook.
*: See other ways of getting there.
* Climb the rope outside the north side of the observatory, then go up the stairs.
* Talk to the Observatory professor on the . 
* After the cutscene, return to Zolarea via the portal at the crash site west of Piscatoris.
* Talk to Wizard Rosalina in the centre of the island.
* Enter the cave entrance to the west.
* Talk to Wizard Rosalina.
* Exit the cave.
* Gather the dark star wisps that have appeared. Wisps are visible on the minimap as a yellow dot:
** A bit north of the cave, west of the mysterious decay. (1/5)
** Jump the rocky edge to the north and gather the wisp on the small, north-north-western island. (2/5)
** Return to the east side of the main island and gather the wisp near the meteorites. (The mining symbol on your minimap) (3/5)
** Go to the south side of the island and gather the wisp near the rocky edge. (4/5)
** Jump the rocky edge to the south and gather the wisp on the south-easternmost island. (5/5)
* Return to the cave and talk to Wizard Rosalina. 
* Select the star sprites in the following order:
** Wave 1: Glorp, Bop, Rox
** Wave 2: Zag, Fuz, Nuub, Zorb
** Wave 3: Zig, Eetee, Bop, Eetee, Glorp
* Exit the cave and talk to Wizard Rosalina in the centre. 
* Talk to Wizard Rosalina back at the crash site.
* Quest complete!

* Talk to Guy at the bonfire in Harvest Hollow. 
* Talk to Dolly on the southern docks of City of Um, just east of Buried Bargains.
* Talk to Guy at the bonfire.
* Talk to Doyle on the western side of Harvest Hollow.
* Deposit at the harvest cart next to Doyle.
* Talk to Doyle. 
* Talk to Guy at the bonfire.
* Quest complete!

* Talk to the Queen of Snow at the snowball arena in Christmas Village. 
* Talk to her again. 
* Continue through the dialogue. 
* Inspect each of the three snowmen and go through all the options for all three. 
* Talk to the Queen of Snow again.
* Inspect each of the three snowmen again.
* Talk to the Queen of Snow again and go through all the options. 
* Leave Cold Front using the quest marker.

* Use the chisel of conditional worth on the coal and make five pieces of 'perfect' coal.
* Take 20 carrots from the bucket o' carrots near the hungry reindeer on the south-western wall outside of Diango's Workshop.
* Use the chisel of conditional worth on the carrots to make a 'perfect' carrot.
* Gather 10 branches by chopping fir trees.
* Use the chisel of conditional worth on the branches to make two 'perfect' branches.
* Return and talk to the Queen of Snow 
* Talk to the Queen of Snow again in the centre of the snowball arena.

* Make a snowball with one of the piles of snow and push it to the marked spot at the top of the hill. The snowball needs to be pushed so that it becomes a large snowball precisely when reaching the reticule on the top of the hill, requiring a total of eight pushes. 
** You can't push diagonally, nor south from under the Queen of Snow.
** At any point, you can break the snowball down, and the pile of snow will reappear in the spot where you broke it down.
* Repeat with another pile of snow to make an enormous snowball positioned next to the large snowball, requiring a total of 10 pushes.
* Repeat with the remaining pile of snow to make an average snowball positioned next to the previous snowballs, requiring a total of five pushes.
* Continue through the dialogue. 
* Quest complete!

* Talk to Rodney in the kitchen of Fort Forinthry. 
** If Princess does not follow you, talk to Princess one square west of Rodney. 
* Talk to Aster at Fort Forinthry 
* Talk to Overseer Siv in the Command Centre 
* Exit the Command Centre and stand west of it, just by the wooden barrels.
* Talk to Princess to obtain a lost sausage.
* Talk to the Cook in the Jolly Boar Inn. 
* Head north to the Wilderness wall just outside the inn and talk to Princess to obtain a half-eaten meat pie.
* Go to the small cabbage patch south of the Blue Moon Inn within Varrock and talk to Princess. 
* After the cutscene, talk to Princess again. Pick up the raw beef nearby if you don't have one.

* Get the ingredients for the dinner:
** Use a hammer on raw meat to obtain tenderised meat.
** Pick the redberry bush south of Varrock, near the elder tree. Do this after the conversation with Princess, otherwise you won't get the juiciest redberries. 
** With a free inventory space, talk to Gertrude in her house about the secret ingredient. 
*** If you have started Rat Catchers, 
** Use the raw salmon on the range in Gertrude's house to make a gently smoked salmon. 
*  Use a bowl of water on any of the ingredients to make an uncooked dog's dinner.
* Cook the uncooked dog's dinner on the range to obtain an unseasoned dog's dinner.
* Use the finest doogle leaves on it to make a perfect dog's dinner.
* Talk to Princess to show her the completed perfect dog's dinner.
*Go back to the cabbage patch near the south entrance of Varrock and talk to Princess there. She will lead you back in the direction of the Jolly Boar Inn.
* Go back to the Jolly Boar Inn. Stand inside, west of the kitchen, and talk to Princess. 
* After the cutscene, talk to Princess.
* Go directly north, and talk to the stray dog outside the inn (the dog is just south of the wilderness wall).
* Talk to Rodney at Fort Forinthry.

* Talk to Bill. 
* Talk to Bill again with the materials in the backpack. 
* Choose a name for the dog to finish the quest.

* Take a vial from the vial cabinet.
* Fill it with oil from the vat of oil.
* Sterilise the vial of oil at the fireplace.
* Take hedgehog spines from the bucket of hedgehog spines and grind them.
** Mix the crushed hedgehog spines with the vial of oil (s).
* Take a Wendlewick poppy from the sack of flowers and press it on the table.
** Mix the pressed Wendlewick poppy with the vial of oil (crushed hedgehog spine).
* Take wolf's tongue from the sack of mushrooms and weigh out 30g on the desk.
** Mix the wolf's tongue (30g) with the vial of oil (crushed hedgehog spine, pressed Wendlewick poppy)
* You should now have antisanguine. If at any point you have a black ruined potion, repeat. One step would have been done wrong.
* Talk to Esther.

* Talk to the Bartender at the Rusty Anchor tavern in Port Sarim. 
* Drink the dragonfire mead.
* After the cutscene, go downstairs via the door on the east side of the room.
* Talk to the Bartender. 
* Talk to 'Shady' Sullivan by the entrance of the tavern. 
* Talk to Captain Lorris on the Port Sarim docks just east of the lodestone.

* Talk to Old Man Jocko on the dock. 
* Head east towards the city of Wendlewick, then speak to Adam in the building north of the well in the centre of the village. 
* Head south and then south-east towards the Shrine of Inanna and talk to Shrine Tender Joanna.
* Pray at the Altar of Inanna west of the summoning obelisk.
* Talk to Shrine Tender Joanna.
* Return and talk to Adam.

* Talk to Zeke in the building east of the well.
* Head west to the beach and kill 10 juvenile boulder crab. Pick up the limestone they drop.
** You must kill the crabs, but you can bring your own limestone bricks to Zeke.
* Return to Zeke.
** If you do not have level 12 Crafting, now it is time to give the limestone to Adam so that he can turn those limestone into bricks.
** If you want to convert them yourself and have the skill to do it, you may do so now.
* Run south across the first bridge, through the lighthouse and out the back door. From the outside go up the stairs.
* Talk to Esther.
* Go back downstairs, walk north, and build at the Lodestone hotspot just across the river.
* Quest complete!

* Talk to Adam in his house in Wendlewick, north of the well. 
* Go north-east into the Highweald Forest and talk to Raz in her cabin at the bottom of the river. 
* Go north along the east side of the river and inspect the dead bear.
* Talk to Raz.

* Talk to Bartender Gefen inside the Burnt Lobster Tavern south-east of the Wendlewick lodestone. 
* Buy a Wendlewick ale from the bartender.
* Talk to Matthew. He is sitting alone at the table in the north-western corner of the tavern. Give him a Wendlewick ale. 
* Talk to Miriam, the musician outside.
* Talk to Jacob, sitting alone outside. 
* Talk to Bartender Gefen. 
* Go back and talk to Adam.

* Go south-east to the Eastfold Farm (further south-east than Marigold Farm) and talk to Farmer Rachel. 
* Investigate the bloodsplatter to the north at the broken fence.
* Follow the blood trail to the north-east and enter the cave entrance.
* Talk to Anya. 
* Teleport to the Wendlewick lodestone, go to the of the lighthouse, and talk to Esther.  
** Be sure to finish the second set of dialogue with Esther before continuing.

* Go south-east, then west up the hill and pick the poppies next to the stone structure at the top to obtain a Wendlewick poppy.
* To the south-west of the Shrine of Inanna, near the jackalope burrows, kill a hedgehog and pick up the hedgehog spines.
* East of the shrine, pick the wolf's tongue mushrooms near the fairy ring to obtain wolf's tongue.
* Return to Esther. 
* Take a vial from the vial cabinet.
* Fill it with oil from the vat of oil.
* Sterilise the vial of oil at the fireplace.
* Take hedgehog spines from the bucket of hedgehog spines, grind them, and mix the crushed hedgehog spines with the vial of oil (s).
* Take a Wendlewick poppy from the sack of flowers, press it on the table, and mix the pressed Wendlewick poppy with the vial of oil (crushed hedgehog spine).
* Take wolf's tongue from the sack of mushrooms, weigh out 30g on the desk, and mix the wolf's tongue (30g) with the vial of oil (crushed hedgehog spine, pressed Wendlewick poppy).
* You should now have antisanguine.
** If at any point you have a black ruined potion, repeat the process from the beginning.
* Talk to Esther. 
* Go to the lake south of the Shrine of Inanna and test antisanguine on the hedgehog (only the non-attackable hedgehog in this area will work).
** Kill it.
* Go to the other side of the spring-fed pond (on the east side of the stepping stones) and test antisanguine on the duck.
* Go north-east and test antisanguine on the badger.

* Go back to Wendlewick and talk to Liat inside the smithy to the east. If someone left the door open, she may wander outside.
* Go to the Highweald Forest mine (head directly north from the smithy) and talk to Gidon.
** Mine 10 copper ores and 10 tin ores if you do not have any in the backpack.
* Return to Wendlewick and give Liat 10 copper ores and 10 tin ores, both need to be un-noted.
* Return to the mine and enter the cave entrance.
* Talk to Gidon.
* Mine 4 havensilver ore.
* Return and talk to Liat.
* Smelt the ores at the furnace into havensilver bars.
* Smith them at the forge and anvil into a havensilver greatsword.

* Equip the Havensilver greatsword.
** Unequip armour that decreases melee accuracy (e.g. necromancy armour) or use melee armour.

** Canoe station option 2 is a nearby quick travel spot to the cave.
* Enter the cave, drink the antisanguine.
** You may reclaim it from Anya.
* Attack the Sanguine heart.
** It will spawn sanguine tumours 3 times during the fight which will make the heart immune to damage until they are destroyed.
** It will periodically launch an exploding pustule to the tile you are standing on, you need to move before it explodes to avoid damage and removal of antisanguine protection effect.
** It may be beneficial to take additional doses of antisanguine during the fight if damaged. 
** Death here is safe, placing you outside the cave.
* Once the heart reaches 1 life point, attack it again.
* Leave the cave exit and talk to Anya again. 
* Return to Wendlewick and talk to Adam. 
* Quest complete!

* Read the Village Noticeboard in Wendlewick, just north of the pub. 
* Talk to Grocer Hannah in the Wendlewick food shop, east of the bank. 
* Talk to Shelly, the crab in the store.
* Follow the crab, talking to it every time it stops.
* Enter the cave to the east and talk to Hermit inside to the north-west.
* Kill one of the crabs for a fresh crab claw, craft it into an crab amulet (unstrung), and use it on a ball of wool to make a crab amulet.
* Talk to Hermit again. 
* Equip the crabulet and talk to Shelly.
* Return to Wendlewick, go back to the food shop, and talk to Shelly.
* South of the Shrine of Inanna, go to the beach and talk to any of the crabs (Finn, Sandy, or Kai).
** (Optional) Travel via the canoe station on the dock next to the Burnt Lobster Tavern and then go south-west.
* Return to Wendlewick and talk to Adam (in the northern building). 
* Talk to Zeke in the building to the east. 
* Talk to Esther upstairs in the lighthouse. 
* Talk to 5 different villagers around Wendlewick to get them to sign the planning permission form. The shop and stall owners work for this. 
* Talk to either Adam, Esther, or Zeke again. 
* Go back to the southern beach and talk to one of the crab leaders.
** Seaweed can be collected to the west on the same beach.
** You also need to bring 3 ropes. If you have the Lorehound pet quest supplies track unlocked you can obtain from there.
* Build the three piles of driftwood on the beach into their huts.
* Talk to Finn, Sandy, or Kai.
* Quest complete!

* Talk to Ben at Marigold Farm in Havenhythe. 
* Talk to him again to give him the runes. 
* Talk to him again to continue the quest.

* Cast the Wendlewick Teleport spell, and talk to him again.
* Enter the windmill to the north, climb up the ladder to the top floor, and talk to him.
* Go back to the bottom floor and talk to him outside.

* Go to the farmhouse to the south and take the flowers off the counter in the eastern room.
* Place the flowers on the stool east of Ben, then cast Telekinetic Grab on them.
* Place the flowers back on the stool and talk to Ben.

* If you don't already have bones, head to the western side of the farmhouse and dig in the dirt mound for 2 sets of crow bones.
* Place a bone on the stool near Ben, then cast the Bones to Bananas spell.

** If unlocked, the teleport option on stardust in the currency pouch places you near Archmage Sedridor.
* Go down one floor and talk to Wizard Isidor to the west. 
* Return to Ben and talk to him or Wizard Isidor. 
* Quest complete!
